const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"shutdown--en-turnaround-playbooks-digitaliseren-met-mixed-reality-veiligere-snellere-slimmere-uitvoering",children:["Shutdown- en turnaround-playbooks digitaliseren met mixed reality: veiligere, snellere, slimmere uitvoering",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#shutdown--en-turnaround-playbooks-digitaliseren-met-mixed-reality-veiligere-snellere-slimmere-uitvoering",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-shutdowns-en-turnarounds-een-high-stakes-uitdaging-blijven",children:["Waarom shutdowns en turnarounds een high-stakes uitdaging blijven",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-shutdowns-en-turnarounds-een-high-stakes-uitdaging-blijven",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële shutdowns en turnarounds behoren tot de meest complexe, resource-intensieve gebeurtenissen in elke fabriek of faciliteit. Ze vereisen zorgvuldige planning, precieze uitvoering en foutloze coördinatie over operations, onderhoud, contractanten en HSE-teams. Zelfs een kleine misstap kan uitmonden in kostbare vertragingen, veiligheidsincidenten of compliance-hiaten."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Desondanks vertrouwen veel organisaties nog steeds op papieren playbooks, statische PDF's of losgekoppelde spreadsheets om hun kritieke shutdown- en turnaround-procedures te beheren. Dit creëert serieuze risico's:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Procedures zijn moeilijk bij te werken en te distribueren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Technici kunnen verouderde stappen gebruiken of recente wijzigingen missen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Kennis is gesegmenteerd in de hoofden van enkele experts."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Training is inconsistent, vooral voor contract- of tijdelijk personeel."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Real-time voortgangsvolging is beperkt of niet-bestaand."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Het resultaat: hogere veiligheidsrisico's, langzamere uitvoering, meer herwerk en verloren kansen om te leren van elk evenement."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-het-digitaliseren-van-shutdown--en-turnaround-playbooks-nu-belangrijk-is",children:["Waarom het digitaliseren van shutdown- en turnaround-playbooks nu belangrijk is",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-het-digitaliseren-van-shutdown--en-turnaround-playbooks-nu-belangrijk-is",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"De druk op industriële operaties blijft groeien. Fabrieken draaien dichter bij capaciteit, regelgevingscontrole stijgt en de ervaren workforce vergrijst. Tegelijkertijd nemen de schaal en complexiteit van shutdowns en turnarounds toe."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Van besluitvormers wordt verwacht:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Downtime te minimaliseren en assets snel weer online te krijgen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance te bewijzen aan regelgevers en auditors."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ervoor te zorgen dat elke technicus, operator en contractant de juiste procedures volgt, elke keer."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lessen geleerd vast te leggen en te verbeteren met elke cyclus."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Papieren playbooks en traditionele digitale documenten kunnen simpelweg niet bijhouden. Ze zijn moeilijk bij te werken, omslachtig om in het veld te gebruiken en bieden weinig zichtbaarheid in real-time uitvoering."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Mixed reality—combinatie van augmented reality (AR) en kunstmatige intelligentie (AI)—verandert deze vergelijking. Door shutdown- en turnaround-playbooks te digitaliseren met mixed reality kunnen industriële leiders meetbare verbeteringen stimuleren in veiligheid, productiviteit en kennisoverdracht."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"hoe-mixed-reality-shutdown--en-turnaround-playbooks-transformeert",children:["Hoe mixed reality shutdown- en turnaround-playbooks transformeert",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-mixed-reality-shutdown--en-turnaround-playbooks-transformeert",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Mixed reality stelt u in staat digitale informatie—zoals stap-voor-stap instructies, diagrammen, checklists en live data—direct over de fysieke werkomgeving te leggen, met AR-headsets, tablets of slimme brillen. Wanneer gecombineerd met AI, kunnen deze tools instructies in real-time aanpassen, stappen valideren en data automatisch vastleggen."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Zo helpen AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"1-digitale-werkvoorschriften-altijd-actueel",children:["1. Digitale werkvoorschriften, altijd actueel",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-digitale-werkvoorschriften-altijd-actueel",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Procedures worden gemaakt en bijgewerkt in een centraal platform."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates zijn direct beschikbaar voor elke technicus en operator, of in het veld of op de werkvloer."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Versiecontrole zorgt ervoor dat iedereen de nieuwste stappen volgt, wat het risico op fouten vermindert."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"2-visuele-begeleiding-in-het-veld",children:["2. Visuele begeleiding in het veld",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-visuele-begeleiding-in-het-veld",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"AR SOPs tonen de exacte stap, diagram of veiligheidswaarschuwing over de echte apparatuur."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Operators zien wat te doen, waar te doen en hoe te doen—handenvrij, zelfs in PBM."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Complexe taken (lockout/tagout, klepsequencing, besloten ruimte toegang) worden opgedeeld in duidelijke, visuele stappen."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"3-real-time-validatie-en-gegevenscapture",children:["3. Real-time validatie en gegevenscapture",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-real-time-validatie-en-gegevenscapture",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Technici bevestigen voltooiing van elke stap met spraakcommando's, foto's of barcodes scannen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AI kan gemiste stappen of afwijkingen markeren, wat directe corrigerende actie vraagt."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Alle acties worden gelogd voor audittrails, compliance en toekomstige verbetering."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"4-remote-support-en-samenwerking",children:["4. Remote support en samenwerking",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-remote-support-en-samenwerking",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Veldteams kunnen verbinden met experts via live video en AR-annotatie."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Complexe troubleshooting of last-minute wijzigingen worden ondersteund zonder te wachten op een expert die op locatie arriveert."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Contractant onboarding en supervisie zijn eenvoudiger, veiliger en consistenter."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"5-continue-verbetering-en-kennisbehoud",children:["5. Continue verbetering en kennisbehoud",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-continue-verbetering-en-kennisbehoud",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["

",n(t.li,{children:"AI analyseert deze data om patronen te identificeren en verbeteringen aan playbooks voor te stellen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Institutionele kennis wordt behouden en gedeeld, zelfs naarmate ervaren personeel met pensioen gaat of verder gaat."}),"
"]}),"

",i(t.h3,{id:"scenario-1-turnaround-kleponderhoud",children:["Scenario 1: Turnaround kleponderhoud",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#scenario-1-turnaround-kleponderhoud",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Een raffinaderij plant een kritieke turnaround met honderden kleppen. Het traditionele playbook is een 200-pagina binder, met updates gedistribueerd via e-mail. In het veld vertrouwen technici op geheugen en handgeschreven notities."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Met digitale werkvoorschriften geleverd via AR-headsets:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Elke technicus ziet de juiste klep, procedure en sequentie, visueel overlegd op het asset."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Stappen worden in real-time afgevinkt, met automatische fotodocumentatie."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supervisors volgen voortgang in een centraal dashboard en grijpen in wanneer afwijkingen optreden."}),"
"]}),"

const{Fragment:n,jsx:e,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(n,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks-with-mixed-reality-safer-faster-smarter-execution",children:["Digitizing shutdown and turnaround playbooks with mixed reality: safer, faster, smarter execution",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks-with-mixed-reality-safer-faster-smarter-execution",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-shutdowns-and-turnarounds-remain-a-high-stakes-challenge",children:["Why shutdowns and turnarounds remain a high-stakes challenge",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-shutdowns-and-turnarounds-remain-a-high-stakes-challenge",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Industrial shutdowns and turnarounds are among the most complex, resource-intensive events in any plant or facility. They demand careful planning, precise execution, and flawless coordination across operations, maintenance, contractors, and HSE teams. Even a minor misstep can cascade into costly delays, safety incidents, or compliance gaps."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Despite this, many organizations still rely on paper-based playbooks, static PDFs, or disconnected spreadsheets to manage their critical shutdown and turnaround procedures. This creates serious risks:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Procedures are hard to update and distribute."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Technicians may use outdated steps or miss recent changes."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Knowledge is siloed in the heads of a few experts."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Training is inconsistent, especially for contract or temporary staff."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Real-time progress tracking is limited or non-existent."}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"The result: higher safety risks, slower execution, more rework, and lost opportunities to learn from each event."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks-matters-now",children:["Why digitizing shutdown and turnaround playbooks matters now",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks-matters-now",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"The pressure on industrial operations continues to grow. Plants are running closer to capacity, regulatory scrutiny is rising, and the experienced workforce is aging. At the same time, the scale and complexity of shutdowns and turnarounds are increasing."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Decision makers are expected to:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Minimize downtime and get assets back online quickly."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Prove compliance to regulators and auditors."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Ensure every technician, operator, and contractor follows the correct procedures, every time."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Capture lessons learned and improve with each cycle."}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Paper-based playbooks and traditional digital documents simply cannot keep up. They are hard to update, cumbersome to use in the field, and offer little visibility into real-time execution."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Mixed reality—combining augmented reality (AR) and artificial intelligence (AI)—is changing this equation. By digitizing shutdown and turnaround playbooks with mixed reality, industrial leaders can drive measurable improvements in safety, productivity, and knowledge transfer."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-mixed-reality-transforms-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks",children:["How mixed reality transforms shutdown and turnaround playbooks",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-mixed-reality-transforms-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Mixed reality allows you to overlay digital information—such as step-by-step instructions, diagrams, checklists, and live data—directly onto the physical work environment, using AR headsets, tablets, or smart glasses. When combined with AI, these tools can adapt instructions in real time, validate steps, and capture data automatically."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Here's how AI and AR–guided work instructions help:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"1-digital-work-instructions-always-current",children:["1. Digital work instructions, always current",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-digital-work-instructions-always-current",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Procedures are authored and updated in a central platform."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Updates are instantly available to every technician and operator, whether in the field or on the shop floor."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Version control ensures everyone follows the latest steps, reducing the risk of error."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"2-visual-guidance-in-the-field",children:["2. Visual guidance in the field",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-visual-guidance-in-the-field",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"AR SOPs display the exact step, diagram, or safety warning over the real equipment."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Operators see what to do, where to do it, and how to do it—hands-free, even in PPE."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Complex tasks (lockout/tagout, valve sequencing, confined space entry) are broken into clear, visual steps."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"3-real-time-validation-and-data-capture",children:["3. Real-time validation and data capture",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-real-time-validation-and-data-capture",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Technicians confirm completion of each step with voice commands, photos, or scanning barcodes."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"AI can flag missed steps or deviations, prompting immediate corrective action."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"All actions are logged for audit trails, compliance, and future improvement."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"4-remote-support-and-collaboration",children:["4. Remote support and collaboration",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-remote-support-and-collaboration",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Field teams can connect with experts via live video and AR annotation."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Complex troubleshooting or last-minute changes are supported without waiting for an expert to arrive on site."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Contractor onboarding and supervision are easier, safer, and more consistent."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"5-continuous-improvement-and-knowledge-retention",children:["5. Continuous improvement and knowledge retention",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-continuous-improvement-and-knowledge-retention",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Every shutdown or turnaround generates data: what worked, what didn't, and where delays or incidents occurred."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"AI analyzes this data to identify patterns and suggest improvements to playbooks."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Institutional knowledge is preserved and shared, even as experienced staff retire or move on."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"concrete-use-cases-digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks",children:["Concrete use cases: digitizing shutdown and turnaround playbooks",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#concrete-use-cases-digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"scenario-1-turnaround-valve-maintenance",children:["Scenario 1: Turnaround valve maintenance",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#scenario-1-turnaround-valve-maintenance",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"A refinery schedules a critical turnaround involving hundreds of valves. The traditional playbook is a 200-page binder, with updates distributed via email. In the field, technicians rely on memory and handwritten notes."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"With digital work instructions delivered through AR headsets:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Each technician sees the correct valve, procedure, and sequence, visually overlaid on the asset."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Steps are checked off in real time, with automatic photo documentation."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Supervisors track progress in a central dashboard and intervene when deviations occur."}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Result: Fewer errors, faster completion, and a complete digital record for compliance."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"scenario-2-shutdown-safety-procedures-and-permit-to-work",children:["Scenario 2: Shutdown safety procedures and permit-to-work",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#scenario-2-shutdown-safety-procedures-and-permit-to-work",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"A chemical plant's shutdown involves dozens of contractors, each with their own procedures. Ensuring everyone follows the correct lockout/tagout and confined space entry protocols is a constant challenge."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"With AI and AR–guided work instructions:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Every team accesses the same, up-to-date safety procedures on their smart devices."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Critical checkpoints (gas testing, isolation points, PPE checks) are confirmed with photos and sensor data."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"HSE managers have real-time visibility into who has completed each step."}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Result: Improved safety compliance, reduced risk of incidents, and simplified audit preparation."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"scenario-3-contractor-onboarding-and-training",children:["Scenario 3: Contractor onboarding and training",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#scenario-3-contractor-onboarding-and-training",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"During a major turnaround, hundreds of temporary contractors join the site. Traditional training is rushed and inconsistent."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"With AR SOPs and digital work instructions:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Contractors receive interactive, step-by-step onboarding—at the equipment, not in a classroom."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Key procedures are demonstrated visually, and understanding is verified before work begins."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Supervisors can identify gaps and provide targeted support."}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Result: Faster onboarding, fewer errors, and more confident teams."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"results-and-proof-measurable-impact-of-mixed-reality-for-shutdowns",children:["Results and proof: measurable impact of mixed reality for shutdowns",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-and-proof-measurable-impact-of-mixed-reality-for-shutdowns",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Organizations that have digitized their shutdown and turnaround playbooks with mixed reality report clear, quantifiable benefits:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Reduced unplanned downtime:"})," Digital instructions and real-time validation help teams complete tasks right the first time, minimizing rework and delays. For example, a major European oil and gas operator reported a 25% reduction in shutdown duration after implementing AR-guided SOPs (source: ",e(r.a,{href:"https://www.accenture.com/us-en/insights/energy/extended-reality-oil-gas",children:"Accenture, 2022"}),")."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Improved safety and compliance:"})," Real-time verification and automated audit trails reduce the risk of missed steps and regulatory violations. The U.S. Chemical Safety Board highlights that procedural deviations remain a leading cause of process safety incidents—digital work instructions directly address this risk."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Faster onboarding and knowledge transfer:"})," New technicians become productive sooner, and experienced staff can easily share expertise, reducing the impact of retirements and turnover."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Higher quality and consistency:"})," Every procedure is followed exactly as intended, every time, regardless of who is performing the work."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"addressing-real-world-barriers-what-to-know-before-digitizing",children:["Addressing real-world barriers: what to know before digitizing",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-real-world-barriers-what-to-know-before-digitizing",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Adopting mixed reality and digitizing shutdown playbooks does require careful planning and governance. Here are key points to address:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Hardware selection:"})," Choose AR devices that are durable, intrinsically safe (where required), and comfortable for all-day use."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Content creation:"})," Invest in capturing expert knowledge and converting procedures into clear, visual digital instructions."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Involve technicians and supervisors early, provide hands-on training, and show quick wins."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Integration:"})," Ensure digital work instructions connect with your existing EAM, CMMS, and permit-to-work systems."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Data security:"})," Protect sensitive operational data and comply with relevant regulations."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"ActARion works with industrial clients to assess readiness, pilot solutions, and scale up at a pace that fits operational realities."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-your-shutdown-and-turnaround-digitization",children:["What ActARion brings to your shutdown and turnaround digitization",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-your-shutdown-and-turnaround-digitization",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"ActARion specializes in helping industrial organizations digitize complex procedures and playbooks using AI and AR–guided work instructions. Our expertise covers:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Mapping and digitizing existing shutdown and turnaround playbooks."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Developing interactive AR SOPs for critical tasks and assets."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Integrating digital work instructions with your maintenance, safety, and training systems."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Supporting change management, from pilot to full rollout."}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Enabling continuous improvement through data analytics and lessons learned."}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Our approach is grounded in industrial reality—focused on measurable results, workforce engagement, and operational safety."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"explore-what-digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks-looks-like-in-your-organization",children:["Explore what digitizing shutdown and turnaround playbooks looks like in your organization",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-what-digitizing-shutdown-and-turnaround-playbooks-looks-like-in-your-organization",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Digitizing your shutdown and turnaround playbooks with mixed reality can help your teams work safer, faster, and more consistently—even in the most demanding environments. title: Error free assembly with AR: reducing rework and scrap in complex production
description: How AI and AR–guided work instructions enable error free assembly, cut rework, and reduce scrap in complex manufacturing environments.

image.alt: Error free assembly with AR: reducing rework and scrap in complex production

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"error-free-assembly-with-ar-reducing-rework-and-scrap-in-complex-production",children:["Error free assembly with AR: reducing rework and scrap in complex production",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#error-free-assembly-with-ar-reducing-rework-and-scrap-in-complex-production",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Assembly errors drive up costs and risk in complex manufacturing. High-value sectors—such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, and industrial equipment—face pressure to deliver flawless products, on time and within budget. Yet, even experienced teams struggle to eliminate mistakes during intricate assembly tasks. As product complexity grows, so do risks of rework, scrap, and quality escapes."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions now offer a concrete path to error free assembly. By digitizing and visualizing each step, these technologies help technicians work smarter, safer, and faster—cutting rework and scrap in even the most demanding production environments."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"complex-assembly-where-errors-start-and-why-they-multiply",children:["Complex assembly: where errors start and why they multiply",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#complex-assembly-where-errors-start-and-why-they-multiply",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Assembly operations in advanced manufacturing are never simple. Components are diverse, tolerances are tight, and the sequence of operations is critical. Small mistakes—misaligned parts, missed fasteners, or incorrect torque—can cascade into expensive failures."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key drivers of error and waste in complex assembly include:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Manual process variation:"})," Even skilled technicians interpret paper SOPs differently, leading to inconsistent results."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management gaps:"})," Engineering changes, updated work instructions, or new materials are not always communicated or adopted in real time."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Training limitations:"})," Ramp-up for new hires or transfers is slow, and tribal knowledge is hard to transfer."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Verification bottlenecks:"})," Manual checks are prone to oversight and do not always catch subtle deviations."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["These pain points are well documented. The ",n(a.em,{children:"International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology"})," found that human error accounts for over 20% of assembly-related defects in high-mix, low-volume production (). For every error detected late, the cost to rework or scrap the assembly rises exponentially."]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-traditional-approaches-fall-short-in-todays-production",children:["Why traditional approaches fall short in today’s production",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-traditional-approaches-fall-short-in-todays-production",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most manufacturers rely on a mix of paper SOPs, static digital documents, and peer-to-peer training. While these methods are familiar, they have clear limitations:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Paper-based SOPs:"})," Prone to wear, misplacement, and misinterpretation. Updates are slow and adoption is inconsistent."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Digital PDFs and checklists:"})," Reduce some errors, but lack contextual guidance and real-time feedback."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Shadowing and mentoring:"})," Useful for onboarding, but hard to scale and dependent on individual trainers."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For decision makers, the result is persistent rework rates (often 5–10% in complex lines), unpredictable scrap, and high costs for quality assurance. As product variants multiply and regulatory demands tighten, these legacy approaches cannot keep up."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-enable-error-free-assembly",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions enable error free assembly",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-enable-error-free-assembly",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions tackle the root causes of assembly errors by making procedures digital, interactive, and context-aware. Here’s how:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"visualizing-each-step-eliminating-ambiguity",children:["Visualizing each step, eliminating ambiguity",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#visualizing-each-step-eliminating-ambiguity",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"With AR SOPs, technicians see work instructions overlaid directly onto the physical workspace—via smart glasses or tablets. Instead of flipping through manuals, they follow clear, visual cues showing:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Exact part placement and orientation"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Correct tool selection and usage"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Real-time prompts for torque, sequencing, and inspection points"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This removes guesswork and ensures every operator follows the same best practice, every time."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"real-time-validation-and-error-prevention",children:["Real-time validation and error prevention",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-time-validation-and-error-prevention",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI-powered systems can monitor progress and verify critical steps. For example:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Computer vision checks for correct component fit before allowing the next step"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Sensors confirm torque or fastener engagement"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"The system blocks advancement if a key process is skipped"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This approach prevents errors at the source, not just after the fact."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"dynamic-updates-and-instant-change-management",children:["Dynamic updates and instant change management",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#dynamic-updates-and-instant-change-management",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Engineering changes are pushed instantly to all workstations. AR SOPs ensure that everyone—regardless of shift or role—uses the latest, validated process. This is essential for regulatory compliance and for rapid response to quality issues."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"accelerated-onboarding-and-skills-transfer",children:["Accelerated onboarding and skills transfer",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#accelerated-onboarding-and-skills-transfer",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"New technicians can reach proficiency faster with step-by-step AR guidance. AI and AR–guided work instructions break down complex tasks and reduce reliance on peer shadowing. This supports workforce flexibility and reduces the impact of turnover."}),"

AR guided checklists are now enabling safer, more reliable field service, reducing errors and downtime while supporting workforce readiness."}),"
",n(a.h2,{id:"why-energy-and-utilities-field-service-needs-a-new-approach-to-safety",children:["Why energy and utilities field service needs a new approach to safety",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-energy-and-utilities-field-service-needs-a-new-approach-to-safety",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

Mistakes can put safety, compliance, and uptime at risk."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Key challenges for field service leaders:"}),"

",i(a.li,{children:"High incident risk: Electrical, chemical, and mechanical hazards are routine."}),"

",i(a.li,{children:"Workforce turnover: New technicians need rapid onboarding and reliable guidance."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Regulatory scrutiny: Auditable proof of compliance is essential."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Unplanned downtime: Errors or missed steps can halt operations."}),"
"]}),"

",n(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Aging workforce and skills gap:"})," Experienced technicians are retiring, and new hires need faster, more effective onboarding and upskilling."]}),"
",n(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Remote and distributed assets:"})," Field teams are spread across wide geographies, often without direct supervision."]}),"
",n(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Regulatory and ESG pressure:"})," Authorities demand traceability for every intervention, and incident reporting is under greater scrutiny."]}),"
",n(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Digital transformation mandates:"})," Boards and regulators are pushing for real-time data, process digitization, and measurable improvements in safety and compliance."]}),"
"]}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Wartung und Reparatur:"})," Techniker greifen auf schrittweise AR-SOPs vor Ort zu, reduzieren Fehler und Ausfallzeiten. Ein Lebensmittelverarbeiter reduzierte beispielsweise ungeplante Stopps um 30% nach Umstellung auf AR-gestützte Wartung."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Sicherheitskritische Aufgaben:"})," HSE-Teams verwenden digitale Checklisten und AR-Overlays, um PSA, Lockout/Tagout und enge Räume Zugang zu verifizieren, verbessern Compliance und Audit-Bereitschaft."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Onboarding und Schulung:"})," Neue Operatoren folgen geführten digitalen Arbeitsanweisungen während Live-Aufgaben, reduzieren Schulungszeit und gewährleisten Best Practices ab Tag eins."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Qualitätsinspektionen:"})," Inspektoren verwenden digitale Workflows, um Ergebnisse zu protokollieren, Fotos zu erfassen und Nichtkonformitäten in Echtzeit zu dokumentieren—ermöglicht schnellere Reaktion und Rückverfolgbarkeit."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Diese Anwendungsfälle zeigen, dass digitale Arbeitsanweisungen nicht nur ein Technologie-Upgrade sind—sie sind ein praktisches Tool für messbare Verbesserung."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"häufige-barrieren-für-sop-digitalisierung-überwinden",children:["Häufige Barrieren für SOP-Digitalisierung überwinden",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#häufige-barrieren-für-sop-digitalisierung-überwinden",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Der Wechsel von Papier zu digitalen und AR-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen wirft Bedenken für viele Industrielleiter auf. So adressieren Sie die häufigsten Barrieren:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hardware-Investition:"})," Beginnen Sie mit bestehenden Tablets oder Smartphones, bevor Sie auf dedizierte AR-Geräte skalieren. Viele Plattformen sind geräteagnostisch."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content-Erstellungsaufwand:"})," Konzentrieren Sie sich zuerst auf wirkungsvolle SOPs. Moderne Plattformen und KI-Tools machen es schneller, Anweisungen zu digitalisieren und zu aktualisieren."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change Management:"})," Beziehen Sie Techniker, Supervisoren und Trainer früh ein. Verwenden Sie Feedback von Piloten, um Workflows zu verfeinern und Buy-in aufzubauen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datensicherheit und Compliance:"})," Wählen Sie Plattformen mit robusten Datenkontrollen, Audit-Trails und regulatorischer Compliance (z.B. ISO, OSHA, FDA)."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Der Schlüssel ist, SOP-Digitalisierung als phasierte, verwaltete Veränderung zu behandeln—nicht als Übernacht-Umschaltung."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"was-actarion-zu-ihrer-digitalen-arbeitsanweisungsreise-beiträgt",children:["Was ActARion zu Ihrer digitalen Arbeitsanweisungsreise beiträgt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-actarion-zu-ihrer-digitalen-arbeitsanweisungsreise-beiträgt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion arbeitet mit Industrielleitern zusammen, um den Übergang von Papier-SOPs zu KI- und AR-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen praktisch und nachhaltig zu gestalten. Unser Ansatz konzentriert sich auf:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Schnelle SOP-Digitalisierung:"})," Wir helfen Ihnen, Ihre höchstpriorisierten Anweisungen abzubilden, zu standardisieren und zu digitalisieren—oft in Tagen, nicht Monaten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Maßgeschneiderte AR-Workflows:"})," Unsere Plattform unterstützt benutzerdefinierten Content, visuelle Overlays und Integration mit Ihrer bestehenden Ausrüstung und Datenquellen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change Management-Unterstützung:"})," Wir führen Ihre Teams durch Piloten, Schulung und Rollout—gewährleisten Adoption und messbare Ergebnisse."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Industrie-Grade-Compliance:"})," ActARions Lösung liefert vollständige Audit-Trails, Versionskontrolle und Analytics, unterstützt Ihre Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsziele."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Mit ActARion gehen Sie über statische PDFs und Papier hinaus zu geführten, datengesteuerten Workflows, die jeden Techniker sicherer, schneller und konsistenter machen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"erkunden-sie-wie-digitalisierte-arbeitsanweisungen-in-ihrer-organisation-aussehen-könnten",children:["Erkunden Sie, wie digitalisierte Arbeitsanweisungen in Ihrer Organisation aussehen könnten",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#erkunden-sie-wie-digitalisierte-arbeitsanweisungen-in-ihrer-organisation-aussehen-könnten",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die Digitalisierung von Arbeitsanweisungen mit KI und AR ist ein praktischer, bewährter Weg, Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu steigern—ob Sie in Operations, HSE, Wartung oder Trainingsführung sind."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Vereinbaren Sie einen Discovery Call, um zu sehen, wie ActARion Ihnen helfen kann, von Papier-SOPs zu AR-Workflows für einen Prozess Ihrer Wahl zu wechseln. Es ist explorativ, keine Verpflichtung. Sie erhalten eine praktische Roadmap und real-world Beispiele, die auf Ihre Umgebung zugeschnitten sind."}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:["Erfahren Sie mehr über ",n(t.a,{href:"/de/use-cases/ar-work-instructions-corporate-memory",children:"digitale Arbeitsanweisungen für industrielle Sicherheit"})]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["Sehen Sie, wie ",n(t.a,{href:"/de/use-cases/ar-training-and-onboarding-for-industrial-teams",children:"AR-Onboarding für Techniker"})," Kompetenztransfer beschleunigt"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["Für einen tiefen Einblick in AR in der Produktion siehe ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/industry/manufacturing/augmented-reality-digital-transformation-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloittes AR in der Produktion Bericht"})]}),"
"]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Van papieren SOP naar AR-workflow: hoe werkvoorschriften stap voor stap te digitaliseren
description: Een praktische gids voor industriële leiders over het verplaatsen van papieren SOPs naar AR-workflows, met bewezen stappen om veiligheid, kwaliteit en efficiëntie te verbeteren.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"van-papieren-sop-naar-ar-workflow-hoe-werkvoorschriften-stap-voor-stap-te-digitaliseren",children:["Van papieren SOP naar AR-workflow: hoe werkvoorschriften stap voor stap te digitaliseren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#van-papieren-sop-naar-ar-workflow-hoe-werkvoorschriften-stap-voor-stap-te-digitaliseren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Papieren SOPs zijn decennia lang de ruggengraat van industriële operaties geweest. Maar naarmate teams strengere compliance, complexere apparatuur en workforce verloop onder ogen zien, kunnen papieren processen niet bijhouden. Werkvoorschriften digitaliseren met AI- en AR-workflows helpt operations-, veiligheids- en trainingsleiders veiligere, snellere en consistentere resultaten te leveren—zonder de knelpunten en risico's van papier."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-papieren-sops-industriële-teams-tegenhouden",children:["Waarom papieren SOPs industriële teams tegenhouden",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-papieren-sops-industriële-teams-tegenhouden",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Papieren SOPs (standard operating procedures) zijn vertrouwd en gemakkelijk te maken. Maar ze komen met duidelijke nadelen die kostbaarder worden naarmate operaties schalen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Updates zijn traag en moeilijk te volgen. Teams gebruiken vaak verouderde instructies, wat kwaliteit en compliance riskeert."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Informatie is statisch en moeilijk te visualiseren. Operators interpreteren tekst en diagrammen verschillend, wat leidt tot inconsistente uitvoering."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Training van nieuwe technici is tijdrovend. Onboarding vertrouwt op shadowing en handmatige controles, niet altijd op best practice."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance audits zijn handmatig en foutgevoelig. Compliance bewijzen betekent handtekeningen en fysieke records achtervolgen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veel industriële leiders worden nu verwacht meetbare verbetering te demonstreren in veiligheid, kwaliteit en productiviteit. Vertrouwen op papieren instructies maakt dit moeilijk, vooral naarmate apparatuur en regelgevingsvereisten toenemen."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Volgens een rapport uit 2023 van McKinsey kan het digitaliseren van kernprocessen productiviteit met 20–30% verbeteren en compliance-incidenten met tot 50% verminderen in industriële settings ()."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-nu-het-moment-is-om-werkvoorschriften-te-digitaliseren",children:["Waarom nu het moment is om werkvoorschriften te digitaliseren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-nu-het-moment-is-om-werkvoorschriften-te-digitaliseren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"De verschuiving van papieren SOPs naar digitale, AR-geleide workflows versnelt over productie, energie, nutsbedrijven en andere asset-intensieve sectoren. Verschillende factoren drijven deze verandering:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Vergrijzende workforce en vaardigheidsgat:"})," Ervaren technici gaan met pensioen, nemen ongeschreven know-how mee. Nieuwe medewerkers hebben duidelijke, visuele begeleiding nodig—snel."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Toenemende complexiteit:"})," Apparatuur, processen en regelgeving zijn veeleisender. Visuele en interactieve werkvoorschriften verminderen fouten en trainingstijd."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote en gedistribueerde teams:"})," Operaties moeten consistentie waarborgen over locaties, ploegen en talen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Audit- en compliance-druk:"})," Digitale records en real-time tracking vereenvoudigen bewijs van compliance en continue verbetering."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële leiders die digitalisatie uitstellen riskeren hogere incidentpercentages, langzamere onboarding en gemiste kansen voor procesoptimalisatie."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"hoe-ai--en-ar-geleide-werkvoorschriften-veelvoorkomende-uitdagingen-oplossen",children:["Hoe AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften veelvoorkomende uitdagingen oplossen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ai--en-ar-geleide-werkvoorschriften-veelvoorkomende-uitdagingen-oplossen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Digitale werkvoorschriften—vooral die geleverd via AR-headsets, tablets of slimme brillen—bieden praktische voordelen ten opzichte van papieren SOPs:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Stap-voor-stap visuele begeleiding:"})," Operators zien precies wat te doen, met afbeeldingen, animaties en 3D-modellen overlegd op echte apparatuur."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Real-time data en AI-ondersteuning:"})," Instructies kunnen zich aanpassen aan machinestatus, omgevingscondities of operator input."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Directe updates en versiecontrole:"})," Alle teams hebben toegang tot de nieuwste SOPs, en wijzigingen worden automatisch getrackt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Ingebouwde compliance en traceerbaarheid:"})," Digitale logs vangen op wie wat deed, wanneer en hoe—wat audits en root cause analyse ondersteunt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Snellere onboarding en bijscholing:"})," Nieuwe technici leren door te doen, met hands-on ondersteuning en contextuele feedback."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Deze voordelen stimuleren meetbare verbeteringen in veiligheid, kwaliteit en productiviteit. Een wereldwijde chemicaliënfabrikant reduceerde bijvoorbeeld kritieke onderhoudsfouten met 40% na digitalisatie van SOPs met AR-begeleiding (",n(t.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/industry/manufacturing/augmented-reality-digital-transformation-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloitte, 2022"}),")."]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"stap-voor-stap-verplaatsen-van-papieren-sop-naar-ar-workflow",children:["Stap voor stap: verplaatsen van papieren SOP naar AR-workflow",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#stap-voor-stap-verplaatsen-van-papieren-sop-naar-ar-workflow",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Werkvoorschriften digitaliseren is niet alleen het scannen van documenten. Het vereist een gestructureerde aanpak die procesanalyse, contentdigitalisatie, change management en technologie-integratie combineert. Zo doet u het:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"1-map-bestaande-sops-en-prioriteer",children:["1. Map bestaande SOPs en prioriteer",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-map-bestaande-sops-en-prioriteer",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Inventariseer alle huidige papieren SOPs, werkvoorschriften en checklists."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Identificeer high-impact processen: veiligheidskritieke, high-frequency of foutgevoelige taken."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Prioriteer processen waar digitale begeleiding de meeste waarde zal leveren (bijv. onderhoudsprocedures, apparatuur-omschakelingen, inspecties)."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"2-standaardiseer-en-structureer-content",children:["2. Standaardiseer en structureer content",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-standaardiseer-en-structureer-content",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Review SOPs op duidelijkheid, nauwkeurigheid en volledigheid."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Breek instructies op in duidelijke, actiegerichte stappen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verwijder ambiguïteit—gebruik precieze taal, foto's en diagrammen waar mogelijk."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"3-kies-het-juiste-digitale-platform",children:["3. Kies het juiste digitale platform",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-kies-het-juiste-digitale-platform",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:["Selecteer een platform dat AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften ondersteunt. Zoek naar:","
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Gemakkelijke content authoring en updates"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ondersteuning voor afbeeldingen, video, 3D-modellen en IoT-integratie"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Apparaatflexibiliteit (tablets, AR-headsets, smartphones)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance-tracking en analytics"}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Opmerking:"})," ActARions platform is doelgericht gebouwd voor industriële teams, ondersteunt snelle SOP-digitalisatie en AR-workflow-implementatie."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"4-converteer-sops-naar-digitaal-en-ar-formaat",children:["4. Converteer SOPs naar digitaal en AR-formaat",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-converteer-sops-naar-digitaal-en-ar-formaat",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Digitaliseer tekst, diagrammen en foto's van papieren SOPs."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Creëer stap-voor-stap digitale instructies, voeg AR-overlays of animaties toe waar ze duidelijkheid toevoegen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Gebruik AI-functies om verbeteringen voor te stellen, vertalingen te automatiseren of ontbrekende stappen te markeren."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"5-pilot-met-een-kernteam",children:["5. Pilot met een kernteam",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-pilot-met-een-kernteam",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Selecteer een pilotgroep (bijv. onderhoudstechnici, HSE-leiders) om de digitale werkvoorschriften te testen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verzamel feedback over bruikbaarheid, duidelijkheid en volledigheid."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Monitor op reductie in fouten, snellere taakvoltooiing of verbeterde compliance."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"6-train-en-rol-uit",children:["6. Train en rol uit",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#6-train-en-rol-uit",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Bied hands-on training voor operators, supervisors en trainers."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Gebruik digitale werkvoorschriften voor onboarding van nieuwe medewerkers."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Rol uit over aanvullende teams en processen op basis van pilotresultaten."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"7-monitor-verbeter-en-schaal",children:["7. Monitor, verbeter en schaal",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#7-monitor-verbeter-en-schaal",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Gebruik analytics om adoptie, taakvoltooiingstijden en compliance te volgen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Update en verbeter instructies continu op basis van veldfeedback."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schaal de AR-workflow-aanpak naar meer locaties, lijnen of functies."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"use-cases-ar-sops-en-digitale-werkvoorschriften-in-actie",children:["Use cases: AR SOPs en digitale werkvoorschriften in actie",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-ar-sops-en-digitale-werkvoorschriften-in-actie",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Het digitaliseren van SOPs met AI en AR levert al resultaten op in operations, onderhoud, HSE en training over industrieën:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Onderhoud en reparatie:"})," Technici hebben toegang tot stap-voor-stap AR SOPs on-site, wat fouten en downtime vermindert. Een voedingsverwerker reduceerde bijvoorbeeld ongeplande stops met 30% na verplaatsing naar AR-geleid onderhoud."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Veiligheidskritieke taken:"})," HSE-teams gebruiken digitale checklists en AR-overlays om PBM, lockout/tagout en besloten ruimte toegang te verifiëren, wat compliance en auditbereidheid verbetert."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Onboarding en training:"})," Nieuwe operators volgen begeleide digitale werkvoorschriften tijdens live taken, wat trainingstijd vermindert en best practices vanaf dag één waarborgt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Kwaliteitsinspecties:"})," Inspecteurs gebruiken digitale workflows om resultaten vast te leggen, foto's te maken en non-conformances in real-time te documenteren—wat snellere respons en traceerbaarheid mogelijk maakt."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Deze use cases tonen aan dat digitale werkvoorschriften niet alleen een technologie-upgrade zijn—ze zijn een praktisch tool voor meetbare verbetering."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"veelvoorkomende-barrières-voor-digitaliseren-van-sops-overwinnen",children:["Veelvoorkomende barrières voor digitaliseren van SOPs overwinnen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#veelvoorkomende-barrières-voor-digitaliseren-van-sops-overwinnen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Overschakelen van papier naar digitale en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften roept zorgen op voor veel industriële leiders. Zo adresseert u de meest voorkomende barrières:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hardware-investering:"})," Begin met bestaande tablets of smartphones voordat u opschaalt naar toegewijde AR-apparaten. Veel platforms zijn apparaatagnostisch."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Contentcreatie workload:"})," Focus eerst op high-impact SOPs. Moderne platforms en AI-tools maken het sneller om instructies te digitaliseren en bij te werken."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Betrek technici, supervisors en trainers vroeg. Gebruik feedback van pilots om workflows te verfijnen en buy-in op te bouwen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Gegevensbeveiliging en compliance:"})," Kies platforms met robuuste gegevenscontroles, audittrails en regelgevingscompliance (bijv. ISO, OSHA, FDA)."]}),"

title: From paper SOP to AR workflow: how to digitise work instructions step by step
description: A practical guide for industrial leaders on moving from paper SOPs to AR workflows, with proven steps to improve safety, quality, and efficiency.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:n,jsx:i,jsxs:e}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return e(n,{children:[e(a.h1,{id:"from-paper-sop-to-ar-workflow-how-to-digitise-work-instructions-step-by-step",children:["From paper SOP to AR workflow: how to digitise work instructions step by step",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#from-paper-sop-to-ar-workflow-how-to-digitise-work-instructions-step-by-step",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Paper SOPs have been the backbone of industrial operations for decades. But as teams face stricter compliance, more complex equipment, and workforce turnover, paper-based processes can't keep up. Digitising work instructions with AI and AR workflows helps operations, safety, and training leaders deliver safer, faster, and more consistent results—without the bottlenecks and risks of paper."}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"why-paper-sops-are-holding-industrial-teams-back",children:["Why paper SOPs are holding industrial teams back",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-paper-sops-are-holding-industrial-teams-back",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Paper-based SOPs (standard operating procedures) are familiar and easy to create. But they come with clear downsides that grow more costly as operations scale:"}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Updates are slow and hard to track. Teams often use outdated instructions, risking quality and compliance."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Information is static and hard to visualise. Operators interpret text and diagrams differently, leading to inconsistent execution."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Training new technicians is time-consuming. Onboarding relies on shadowing and manual checks, not always on best practice."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Compliance audits are manual and error-prone. Proving adherence means chasing signatures and physical records."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Many industrial leaders are now expected to demonstrate measurable improvement in safety, quality, and productivity. Relying on paper instructions makes this difficult, especially as equipment and regulatory demands increase."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"According to a 2023 McKinsey report, digitising core processes can improve productivity by 20–30% and reduce compliance incidents by up to 50% in industrial settings ()."}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"why-now-is-the-time-to-digitise-work-instructions",children:["Why now is the time to digitise work instructions",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-is-the-time-to-digitise-work-instructions",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"The shift from paper SOPs to digital, AR-guided workflows is accelerating across manufacturing, energy, utilities, and other asset-intensive sectors. Several factors are driving this change:"}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Aging workforce and skills gap:"})," Experienced technicians are retiring, taking unwritten know-how with them. New hires need clear, visual guidance—fast."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Increasing complexity:"})," Equipment, processes, and regulations are more demanding. Visual and interactive work instructions reduce errors and training time."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Remote and distributed teams:"})," Operations need to ensure consistency across sites, shifts, and languages."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Audit and compliance pressure:"})," Digital records and real-time tracking simplify proof of compliance and continuous improvement."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Industrial leaders who delay digitisation risk higher incident rates, slower onboarding, and missed opportunities for process optimisation."}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-solve-common-challenges",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions solve common challenges",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-solve-common-challenges",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Digital work instructions—especially those delivered via AR headsets, tablets, or smart glasses—offer practical advantages over paper SOPs:"}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Step-by-step visual guidance:"})," Operators see exactly what to do, with images, animations, and 3D models overlaid on real equipment."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Real-time data and AI support:"})," Instructions can adapt to machine status, environmental conditions, or operator input."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Instant updates and version control:"})," All teams access the latest SOPs, and changes are tracked automatically."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Built-in compliance and traceability:"})," Digital logs capture who did what, when, and how—supporting audits and root cause analysis."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Faster onboarding and upskilling:"})," New technicians learn by doing, with hands-on support and contextual feedback."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.p,{children:["These benefits drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, and productivity. For example, a global chemicals manufacturer reduced critical maintenance errors by 40% after digitising SOPs with AR guidance (",i(a.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/industry/manufacturing/augmented-reality-digital-transformation-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloitte, 2022"}),")."]}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"step-by-step-moving-from-paper-sop-to-ar-workflow",children:["Step-by-step: moving from paper SOP to AR workflow",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-by-step-moving-from-paper-sop-to-ar-workflow",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Digitising work instructions is not just about scanning documents. It requires a structured approach that combines process analysis, content digitisation, change management, and technology integration. Here's how to do it:"}),"
",e(a.h3,{id:"1-map-existing-sops-and-prioritise",children:["1. Map existing SOPs and prioritise",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-map-existing-sops-and-prioritise",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Inventory all current paper SOPs, work instructions, and checklists."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Identify high-impact processes: safety-critical, high-frequency, or error-prone tasks."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Prioritise processes where digital guidance will deliver the most value (e.g., maintenance procedures, equipment changeovers, inspections)."}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.h3,{id:"2-standardise-and-structure-content",children:["2. Standardise and structure content",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-standardise-and-structure-content",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Review SOPs for clarity, accuracy, and completeness."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Break down instructions into clear, actionable steps."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Remove ambiguity—use precise language, photos, and diagrams where possible."}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.h3,{id:"3-choose-the-right-digital-platform",children:["3. Choose the right digital platform",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-choose-the-right-digital-platform",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",e(a.li,{children:["Select a platform that supports AI and AR–guided work instructions. Look for:","
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Easy content authoring and updates"}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Support for images, video, 3D models, and IoT integration"}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Device flexibility (tablets, AR headsets, smartphones)"}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Compliance tracking and analytics"}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.blockquote,{children:["
",e(a.p,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," ActARion's platform is purpose-built for industrial teams, supporting rapid SOP digitisation and AR workflow deployment."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.h3,{id:"4-convert-sops-to-digital-and-ar-format",children:["4. Convert SOPs to digital and AR format",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-convert-sops-to-digital-and-ar-format",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Digitise text, diagrams, and photos from paper SOPs."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Create step-by-step digital instructions, adding AR overlays or animations where they add clarity."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Use AI features to suggest improvements, automate translations, or flag missing steps."}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.h3,{id:"5-pilot-with-a-core-team",children:["5. Pilot with a core team",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-pilot-with-a-core-team",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Select a pilot group (e.g., maintenance technicians, HSE leads) to test the digital work instructions."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Gather feedback on usability, clarity, and completeness."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Monitor for reduction in errors, faster task completion, or improved compliance."}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.h3,{id:"6-train-and-roll-out",children:["6. Train and roll out",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#6-train-and-roll-out",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Provide hands-on training for operators, supervisors, and trainers."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Use digital work instructions for onboarding new hires."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Roll out across additional teams and processes based on pilot results."}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.h3,{id:"7-monitor-improve-and-scale",children:["7. Monitor, improve, and scale",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#7-monitor-improve-and-scale",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:"Use analytics to track adoption, task completion times, and compliance."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Continuously update and improve instructions based on field feedback."}),"
",i(a.li,{children:"Scale the AR workflow approach to more sites, lines, or functions."}),"
"]}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"use-cases-ar-sops-and-digital-work-instructions-in-action",children:["Use cases: AR SOPs and digital work instructions in action",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-ar-sops-and-digital-work-instructions-in-action",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Digitising SOPs with AI and AR is already delivering results in operations, maintenance, HSE, and training across industries:"}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Maintenance and repair:"})," Technicians access step-by-step AR SOPs on-site, reducing errors and downtime. For example, a food processor cut unplanned stoppages by 30% after moving to AR-guided maintenance."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Safety-critical tasks:"})," HSE teams use digital checklists and AR overlays to verify PPE, lockout/tagout, and confined space entry, improving compliance and audit readiness."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Onboarding and training:"})," New operators follow guided digital work instructions during live tasks, reducing training time and ensuring best practices from day one."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Quality inspections:"})," Inspectors use digital workflows to record results, capture photos, and document non-conformances in real time—enabling faster response and traceability."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"These use cases show that digital work instructions are not just a technology upgrade—they're a practical tool for measurable improvement."}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"overcoming-common-barriers-to-digitising-sops",children:["Overcoming common barriers to digitising SOPs",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#overcoming-common-barriers-to-digitising-sops",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Switching from paper to digital and AR-guided work instructions brings up concerns for many industrial leaders. Here's how to address the most common barriers:"}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Hardware investment:"})," Start with existing tablets or smartphones before scaling to dedicated AR devices. Many platforms are device-agnostic."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Content creation workload:"})," Focus first on high-impact SOPs. Modern platforms and AI tools make it faster to digitise and update instructions."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Involve technicians, supervisors, and trainers early. Use feedback from pilots to refine workflows and build buy-in."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Data security and compliance:"})," Choose platforms with robust data controls, audit trails, and regulatory compliance (e.g., ISO, OSHA, FDA)."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"The key is to treat SOP digitisation as a phased, managed change—not an overnight switch."}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-your-digital-work-instruction-journey",children:["What ActARion brings to your digital work instruction journey",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-your-digital-work-instruction-journey",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"ActARion partners with industrial leaders to make the shift from paper SOPs to AI and AR–guided work instructions practical and sustainable. Our approach focuses on:"}),"
",e(a.ul,{children:["
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Rapid SOP digitisation:"})," We help you map, standardise, and digitise your highest-priority instructions—often in days, not months."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Tailored AR workflows:"})," Our platform supports custom content, visual overlays, and integration with your existing equipment and data sources."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Change management support:"})," We guide your teams through pilots, training, and rollout—ensuring adoption and measurable results."]}),"
",e(a.li,{children:[i(a.strong,{children:"Industrial-grade compliance:"})," ActARion's solution delivers complete audit trails, version control, and analytics, supporting your quality and safety goals."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"With ActARion, you move beyond static PDFs and paper to guided, data-driven workflows that make every technician safer, faster, and more consistent."}),"
",e(a.h2,{id:"explore-what-digitised-work-instructions-could-look-like-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore what digitised work instructions could look like in your organisation",i(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-what-digitised-work-instructions-could-look-like-in-your-organisation",children:i(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Digitising work instructions with AI and AR is a practical, proven way to boost safety, quality, and productivity—whether you're in operations, HSE, maintenance, or training leadership."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:"Schedule a discovery call to see how ActARion can help you move from paper SOPs to AR workflows for a process of your choice. It's exploratory, not a commitment. You'll get a practical roadmap and real-world examples tailored to your environment."}),"

",e(a.li,{children:["Learn more about ",i(a.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-work-instructions-corporate-memory",children:"digital work instructions for industrial safety"})]}),"

title: Von Text und Video zu 3D und AR: warum das Format von Anweisungen Sicherheit und Qualität beeinflusst
description: Entdecken Sie, warum das Format von Arbeitsanweisungen—Text, Video, 3D oder AR—direkte Auswirkungen auf Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität für industrielle Teams hat.

image.alt: Von Text und Video zu 3D und AR: warum das Format von Anweisungen Sicherheit und Qualität beeinflusst

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"von-text-und-video-zu-3d-und-ar-warum-das-format-von-anweisungen-sicherheit-und-qualität-beeinflusst",children:["Von Text und Video zu 3D und AR: warum das Format von Anweisungen Sicherheit und Qualität beeinflusst",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#von-text-und-video-zu-3d-und-ar-warum-das-format-von-anweisungen-sicherheit-und-qualität-beeinflusst",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Das Format von Arbeitsanweisungen—ob Text, Video, 3D-Modelle oder Augmented Reality—beeinflusst direkt, wie sicher und genau Teams kritische Aufgaben ausführen. Für Industrielle Operations Manager, HSE-Leiter, Wartungssupervisoren und L&D-Profis ist die Wahl des richtigen Formats nicht nur eine Frage der Bequemlichkeit. Es ist eine strategische Entscheidung, die Sicherheit, Compliance, Produktivität und Wissenstransfer in großem Maßstab prägt."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-das-format-von-arbeitsanweisungen-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:["Warum das Format von Arbeitsanweisungen jetzt wichtig ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-das-format-von-arbeitsanweisungen-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Umgebungen stehen unter zunehmendem Druck, hohe Sicherheitsstandards aufrechtzuerhalten, Ausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und sich an Workforce-Veränderungen anzupassen. Viele Organisationen verlassen sich noch immer auf statische Dokumente, PDFs oder Legacy-Videos für Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Aber während Prozesse komplexer werden und erfahrene Techniker in Rente gehen, werden die Einschränkungen dieser Formate deutlicher."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Schlüsselherausforderungen für Entscheidungsträger:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Komplexe Maschinen und sich entwickelnde Compliance-Anforderungen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vielfältige Teams mit unterschiedlichen Erfahrungsniveaus und Muttersprachen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Hohe Kosten von Fehlern, Nacharbeit und Non-Compliance"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schwierigkeit, Neueinstellungen schnell und sicher onboarden"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Forschung aus dem ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0169814119300117",children:"International Journal of Industrial Ergonomics"})," zeigt, dass unklare oder schlecht formatierte Anweisungen eine Hauptursache vermeidbarer Vorfälle in Produktions- und Prozessindustrien sind. ",n(t.p,{children:"Moderne industrielle Operationen stehen vor einer anhaltenden Herausforderung: sicherstellen, dass jeder Techniker, Operator und Feldingenieur Zugang zu klaren, genauen und aktuellen Arbeitsanweisungen hat—unabhängig von ihrer Sprache oder ihrem Standort. KI-gestützte Lösungen machen es nun möglich, alltägliche Fotos und Videos direkt in mehrsprachige, schrittweise digitale Arbeitsanweisungen umzuwandeln und die Art und Weise zu transformieren, wie technisches Wissen erfasst, geteilt und ausgeführt wird."}),"

title: Hoe AI foto's en video's kan omzetten in meertalige werkvoorschriften

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"hoe-ai-fotos-en-videos-kan-omzetten-in-meertalige-werkvoorschriften",children:["Hoe AI foto's en video's kan omzetten in meertalige werkvoorschriften",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ai-fotos-en-videos-kan-omzetten-in-meertalige-werkvoorschriften",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Moderne industriële operaties staan voor een aanhoudende uitdaging: ervoor zorgen dat elke technicus, operator en veldengineer toegang heeft tot duidelijke, accurate en up-to-date werkvoorschriften—ongeacht hun taal of locatie. Naarmate teams diverser worden en taken complexer worden, schieten traditionele tekstgebaseerde handleidingen en statische PDF's tekort. AI-gedreven oplossingen maken het nu mogelijk om alledaagse foto's en video's direct om te zetten in meertalige, stap-voor-stap digitale werkvoorschriften, wat de manier transformeert waarop technische kennis wordt vastgelegd, gedeeld en uitgevoerd."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"waarom-industriële-teams-nu-betere-werkvoorschriften-nodig-hebben",children:["Waarom industriële teams nu betere werkvoorschriften nodig hebben",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-industriële-teams-nu-betere-werkvoorschriften-nodig-hebben",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'Operations managers, HSE-leiders en trainingsprofessionals weten dat veilig en efficiënt werk afhangt van duidelijke instructies. Toch vertrouwen velen nog steeds op verouderde documentatie of informele "shadowing," wat leidt tot:'}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Inconsistente taakuitvoering en verhoogde foutpercentages"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Langdurige onboarding en trage vaardigheidsoverdracht"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Hiaten in compliance, traceerbaarheid en auditbereidheid"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Taalbarrières binnen multinationale teams"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'De industriële workforce verandert. Volgens het European Agency for Safety and Health at Work zijn taalbarrières een belangrijke bijdrage aan ongevallen onder migrantenwerkers in productie en bouw (EU-OSHA, 2021). Ondertussen creëren hoge verloop en pensionering van ervaren personeel een "kennisverlies" dat niet alleen door PDF's of statische SOPs kan worden opgevuld.'}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"De behoefte om werkvoorschriften te digitaliseren, standaardiseren en lokaliseren is urgent—vooral voor organisaties die productiviteit willen verhogen, downtime willen verminderen en strenge veiligheids- en kwaliteitsstandaarden willen halen."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Legacy-documentatiemethoden kunnen het tempo van verandering van vandaag niet bijhouden:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Papieren handleidingen en PDF's zijn moeilijk bij te werken, te distribueren en te volgen."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Video-tutorials zijn nuttig, maar moeilijk te doorzoeken, te vertalen of op te delen in actiegerichte stappen."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Handmatige vertaalprocessen zijn traag, kostbaar en foutgevoelig, vaak missend technische nuance."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:'Informele kennisoverdracht ("kijk hoe ik het een keer doe") is inconsistent en laat geen audittrail achter.'}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Deze hiaten leiden tot verloren productiviteit, veiligheidsincidenten en compliancerisico's. Multinationale teams staan in het bijzonder voor extra hindernissen wanneer werkvoorschriften alleen beschikbaar zijn in één taal of visuele context missen."}),"

title: Hoe AR en AI helpen expertkennis vast te leggen voordat deze de deur uitloopt
description: Industriële leiders: zie hoe AR- en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften expertkennis vastleggen, trainingstijd verminderen en kwaliteit beschermen naarmate ervaren personeel met pensioen gaat.
