const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"hoe-ar-en-ai-helpen-expertkennis-vast-te-leggen-voordat-deze-de-deur-uitloopt",children:["Hoe AR en AI helpen expertkennis vast te leggen voordat deze de deur uitloopt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ar-en-ai-helpen-expertkennis-vast-te-leggen-voordat-deze-de-deur-uitloopt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële bedrijven staan voor een kritiek risico: ervaren technici en engineers gaan met pensioen of vertrekken, en nemen decennia aan praktische kennis mee. Het vastleggen van deze expertise voordat deze de deur uitloopt is nu een topprioriteit voor operations-, onderhouds- en HSE-leiders. AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften bieden een directe, praktische manier om expertkennis te digitaliseren, onboardingtijden te verminderen en veiligheids- en productiviteitsstandaarden te handhaven naarmate teams veranderen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-expertkennisverlies-een-urgente-operationele-risico-is",children:["Waarom expertkennisverlies een urgente operationele risico is",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-expertkennisverlies-een-urgente-operationele-risico-is",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veel industriële sectoren—productie, energie, chemicaliën, nutsbedrijven—zien een golf van pensioneringen en verloop. Volgens het US Bureau of Labor Statistics is bijna 25% van de productieworkforce ouder dan 55, en de trend is vergelijkbaar in Europa en Azië. Naarmate ervaren personeel vertrekt, is het risico niet alleen langzamere onboarding voor nieuwe medewerkers. Bedrijven staan voor:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Verhoogde veiligheidsincidenten door hiaten in stilzwijgende kennis"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lagere productiviteit naarmate minder ervaren teams worstelen met troubleshooting"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Meer downtime door vermijdbare fouten of gemiste stappen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verminderde compliance met kritieke procedures (SOPs, kwaliteitscontroles, veiligheidsroutines)"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Verbale overdracht, papieren checklists en job shadowing zijn niet langer genoeg. De complexiteit en variabiliteit van industriële operaties vereisen een robuustere, schaalbare aanpak."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wat-verandert-nieuwe-druk-en-verwachtingen",children:["Wat verandert: nieuwe druk en verwachtingen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wat-verandert-nieuwe-druk-en-verwachtingen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Drie trends maken kennisvastlegging urgenter en uitdagender:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hogere verloop en vaardigheidsgaten:"}),' Jongere technici hebben andere verwachtingen voor leren, en minder willen jarenlang "leren door osmose" doorbrengen.']}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Complexere assets en processen:"})," Moderne apparatuur en compliancestandaarden vereisen precieze, up-to-date procedures."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Regelgevings- en klantvereisten:"})," Controleerbare, gestandaardiseerde SOPs zijn nu basisverwachtingen in de meeste gereguleerde industrieën."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Tegelijkertijd is digitale transformatie niet langer optioneel. Operations managers en L&D-leiders worden verwacht meetbare verbeteringen te demonstreren in trainingstijd, foutpercentages en compliance."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Conventionele aanpakken—mentoring, shadowing, geschreven SOPs—laten kritieke hiaten:"}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Stilzwijgende kennis wordt niet vastgelegd:"}),' Experts kennen de "waarom" en "hoe" achter elke stap, maar dit komt zelden in handleidingen terecht.']}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Procedures raken verouderd:"})," Papieren SOPs zijn moeilijk bij te werken en op schaal te distribueren."]}),"

"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:'Deze hiaten zijn zichtbaar in onboarding-metrics, incidentrapporten en kwaliteitsaudits. Bedrijven hebben een manier nodig om niet alleen het "wat" maar ook het "hoe" en "waarom" van expertwerk te digitaliseren.'}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"AI-gedreven contentcreatie:"})," Gebruik AI-tools om SOPs te transcriberen, structureren en bij te werken op basis van expertinput, automatisch hiaten of inconsistenties markeren."]}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Continue feedbackloops:"})," Data van voltooide werkvoorschriften voedt terug in AI-modellen, wat helpt SOPs te verfijnen en nieuwe inzichten van ervaren personeel vast te leggen."]}),"
"]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Een chemische fabriek staat voor het pensioen van zijn hoofdcompressortechnicus. In plaats van te vertrouwen op shadowing, rust het bedrijf de expert uit met AR-brillen. Terwijl de technicus een complexe afdichtingsvervanging uitvoert, neemt het systeem audio, video en geannoteerde stappen op. AI-tools transcriberen en structureren dit in een digitale SOP, die wordt gereviewd en gevalideerd door de expert. title: How AR and AI help capture expert knowledge before it walks out of the door
description: Industrial leaders: see how AR and AI-guided work instructions capture expert knowledge, reduce training time, and protect quality as experienced staff retire.

image.alt: How AR and AI help capture expert knowledge before it walks out of the door

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"how-ar-and-ai-help-capture-expert-knowledge-before-it-walks-out-of-the-door",children:["How AR and AI help capture expert knowledge before it walks out of the door",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-and-ai-help-capture-expert-knowledge-before-it-walks-out-of-the-door",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial companies face a critical risk: experienced technicians and engineers are retiring or moving on, taking decades of practical knowledge with them. Capturing this expertise before it walks out of the door is now a top priority for operations, maintenance, and HSE leaders. AI and AR-guided work instructions offer a direct, practical way to digitize expert knowledge, reduce onboarding times, and maintain safety and productivity standards as teams change."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-expert-knowledge-loss-is-an-urgent-operational-risk",children:["Why expert knowledge loss is an urgent operational risk",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-expert-knowledge-loss-is-an-urgent-operational-risk",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Many industrial sectors—manufacturing, energy, chemicals, utilities—are seeing a wave of retirements and turnover. According to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics, almost 25% of the manufacturing workforce is over 55, and the trend is similar in Europe and Asia. As experienced staff leave, the risk isn’t just slower onboarding for new hires. Companies face:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Increased safety incidents due to gaps in tacit knowledge"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Lower productivity as less experienced teams struggle to troubleshoot"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"More downtime from avoidable errors or missed steps"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduced compliance with critical procedures (SOPs, quality checks, safety routines)"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Verbal handover, paper checklists, and job shadowing are no longer enough. The complexity and variability of industrial operations demand a more robust, scalable approach."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"whats-changing-new-pressures-and-expectations",children:["What’s changing: new pressures and expectations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#whats-changing-new-pressures-and-expectations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Three trends make knowledge capture more urgent and challenging:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Higher turnover and skill gaps:"})," Younger technicians have different expectations for learning, and fewer want to spend years “learning by osmosis.”"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"More complex assets and processes:"})," Modern equipment and compliance standards require precise, up-to-date procedures."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Regulatory and customer demands:"})," Auditable, standardized SOPs are now baseline expectations in most regulated industries."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"At the same time, digital transformation is no longer optional. Operations managers and L&D leaders are expected to demonstrate measurable improvements in training time, error rates, and compliance."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-limits-of-traditional-knowledge-transfer-methods",children:["The limits of traditional knowledge transfer methods",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-limits-of-traditional-knowledge-transfer-methods",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Conventional approaches—mentoring, shadowing, written SOPs—leave critical gaps:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Tacit knowledge isn’t captured:"})," Experts know the “why” and “how” behind each step, but this rarely makes it into manuals."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Procedures become outdated:"})," Paper SOPs are hard to update and distribute at scale."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Learning is slow and inconsistent:"})," New hires must absorb information passively, leading to variable results."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"These gaps are visible in onboarding metrics, incident reports, and quality audits. Companies need a way to digitize not just the “what” but also the “how” and “why” of expert work."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-ar-help-capture-and-transfer-expert-knowledge",children:["How AI and AR help capture and transfer expert knowledge",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-ar-help-capture-and-transfer-expert-knowledge",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR-guided work instructions directly address these challenges. Here’s how:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) SOPs:"})," Capture expert workflows as step-by-step visual instructions, overlaid directly on equipment or workspaces via smart glasses or tablets. Each step can include photos, videos, or annotations recorded by experts in real time."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"AI-powered content creation:"})," Use AI tools to transcribe, structure, and update SOPs based on expert input, automatically flagging gaps or inconsistencies."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Contextual guidance:"})," Teams see exactly what to do next, reducing ambiguity and reliance on memory or informal notes."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Continuous feedback loops:"})," Data from completed work instructions feeds back into AI models, helping refine SOPs and capture new insights from experienced staff."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This approach turns expertise into living, digital assets—available to every technician, on demand."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"example-digitizing-a-critical-maintenance-procedure",children:["Example: digitizing a critical maintenance procedure",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#example-digitizing-a-critical-maintenance-procedure",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A chemical plant faces the retirement of its lead compressor technician. Instead of relying on shadowing, the company equips the expert with AR glasses. As the technician performs a complex seal replacement, the system records audio, video, and annotated steps. AI tools transcribe and structure this into a digital SOP, which is reviewed and validated by the expert. The result: a detailed, visual guide available to every team member, reducing onboarding time and errors."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"key-benefits-of-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-for-knowledge-capture",children:["Key benefits of AR and AI–guided work instructions for knowledge capture",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-benefits-of-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-for-knowledge-capture",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR-guided work instructions provide clear, measurable advantages for industrial teams:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Faster onboarding:"})," New hires can follow expert-validated, step-by-step AR SOPs, reducing time to competency by 30–50% (source: ",n(a.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/manufacturing/articles/digital-manufacturing-enterprise.html",children:"Deloitte, 2023 Digital Manufacturing Report"}),")."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Fewer errors and incidents:"})," Guided instructions and contextual prompts help teams avoid common mistakes, supporting higher safety and quality standards."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Up-to-date procedures:"})," AI tools make it easy to update SOPs as equipment or regulations change, ensuring compliance."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Retention of tacit knowledge:"})," Video, audio, and AR overlays capture the “tricks of the trade” that are lost in written documents."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Auditability:"})," Digital work instructions create a traceable record of who did what, when, and how—supporting regulatory and customer audits."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"practical-use-cases-across-industrial-environments",children:["Practical use cases across industrial environments",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-use-cases-across-industrial-environments",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR-guided work instructions are already delivering results in diverse sectors:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"maintenance-and-asset-reliability",children:["Maintenance and asset reliability",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#maintenance-and-asset-reliability",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Capture expert troubleshooting and repair routines for complex equipment"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Standardize PM tasks with visual, step-by-step AR SOPs"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduce downtime from avoidable errors as teams change"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"health-safety-and-environment-hse",children:["Health, safety, and environment (HSE)",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#health-safety-and-environment-hse",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Digitize safety-critical procedures, such as lockout/tagout or confined space entry"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Provide real-time guidance and documentation to meet compliance requirements"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Support incident investigations with detailed, time-stamped work records"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"quality-assurance-and-audits",children:["Quality assurance and audits",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#quality-assurance-and-audits",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Ensure all operators follow the same validated process for critical quality checks"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Streamline preparation for ISO, FDA, or customer audits with digital SOPs and training records"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"training-and-workforce-development",children:["Training and workforce development",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-and-workforce-development",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Create immersive onboarding experiences for new technicians"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Enable “just-in-time” learning with AR overlays in the field"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduce reliance on classroom-based or paper-based training"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"addressing-common-challenges-hardware-change-management-and-content-creation",children:["Addressing common challenges: hardware, change management, and content creation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-common-challenges-hardware-change-management-and-content-creation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Implementing AI and AR-guided work instructions requires practical planning and governance. Common questions include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"What hardware is required?"})," Most solutions work with standard tablets or smartphones, and many industrial AR platforms support smart glasses for hands-free use. It’s important to pilot hardware options in real environments."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"How is expert content captured?"})," Experts can record procedures as they work, using video, voice, and photos. AI tools help structure and tag this content, making it searchable and easy to update."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"What about change management?"})," Success depends on involving experienced staff early, demonstrating value, and providing support as teams adapt to new tools. Clear governance and KPIs are critical."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"How secure is the data?"})," Digital work instructions must be stored securely, with access controls and audit trails to protect intellectual property and support compliance."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," For a detailed look at AR onboarding, see ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-training-and-onboarding-for-industrial-teams",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-the-table",children:["What ActARion brings to the table",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-the-table",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion works with industrial companies to deploy AI and AR-guided work instruction platforms tailored to real operational needs. Our approach includes:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Industry-specific templates:"})," Pre-built AR SOPs and workflows for maintenance, safety, and quality scenarios"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Expert-driven content capture:"})," Simple tools for recording and structuring expert knowledge, with AI-powered suggestions"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Integration with existing systems:"})," Connect digital work instructions to your EHS, CMMS, or ERP platforms"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management support:"})," Proven frameworks to engage teams, measure impact, and ensure adoption"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data security and compliance:"})," Robust controls to protect sensitive procedures and support audits"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"We focus on practical, measurable outcomes—shorter onboarding, fewer errors, and preserved expertise as teams change."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"explore-what-this-looks-like-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore what this looks like in your organisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-what-this-looks-like-in-your-organisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"If you want to see how AI and AR-guided work instructions could help your team capture expert knowledge, reduce onboarding time, and maintain quality as experienced staff retire, schedule an exploratory discovery call. There’s no commitment—just a practical look at what’s possible in your setting."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:n(a.a,{href:"/en/about",children:"Learn more about ActARion’s approach"})}),"
",n(a.li,{children:n(a.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-guided-assembly-for-error-free-production",children:"See how digital work instructions support compliance"})}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"For more on knowledge management, see Harvard Business Review: Retaining Institutional Knowledge."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Let’s make sure your organisation’s expertise stays where it delivers value—on the shop floor, not walking out the door."}),"
",n(a.hr,{}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"go-deeper",children:["Go deeper",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#go-deeper",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This article is part of our knowledge base on AI and AR–guided work instructions. For a comprehensive overview, read our whitepaper:"}),"
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:n(a.a,{href:"/en/whitepapers/ai-and-ar-guided-work-instructions",children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions: a practical guide for operations teams"})})," — Covers what these technologies are, why they are becoming viable now, and how operations teams can apply them to reduce errors, shorten onboarding, and preserve critical know-how."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",h4:"h4",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"how-to-measure-the-roi-of-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:["How to measure the ROI of AR and AI guided work instructions",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-measure-the-roi-of-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Understanding the return on investment (ROI) for AR and AI guided work instructions is a top priority for operations managers, HSE leaders, maintenance heads, and L&D professionals in industrial environments. With budgets under scrutiny and safety, productivity, and workforce readiness at stake, decision makers need clear methods to justify investments in digital work instructions. This guide provides a practical framework for measuring ROI, using real-world examples and proven metrics."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Unlike software with simple license metrics, AR and AI guided work instructions impact a complex mix of tangible and intangible factors. Key challenges include:"}),"

description: Entdecken Sie, wie Remote-Experten-Support mit AR industrielle Teams befähigt, Ausfallzeiten schneller zu lösen, Qualität aufrechtzuerhalten und Kosten zu reduzieren, ohne Spezialisten einzufliegen.

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"remote-experten-support-mit-ar-ausfallzeiten-lösen-ohne-spezialisten-einzufliegen",children:["Remote-Experten-Support mit AR: Ausfallzeiten lösen, ohne Spezialisten einzufliegen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-experten-support-mit-ar-ausfallzeiten-lösen-ohne-spezialisten-einzufliegen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ungeplante Ausfallzeiten sind eine kritische Herausforderung für industrielle Operationen. Wenn Systeme ausfallen oder komplexe Wartung erforderlich ist, bedeutet der schnellste Weg zur Lösung oft, einen externen Spezialisten einzubringen—zu erheblichen Kosten, Verzögerung und Risiko für Produktivität. Remote-Experten-Support mit AR (Augmented Reality) ändert diese Gleichung. Durch Ermöglichen von Echtzeit-, On-Site-Anleitung von Experten überall auf der Welt helfen KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen Ihren Teams, Ausfallzeiten schneller zu lösen, Qualität und Sicherheit aufrechtzuerhalten und die Notwendigkeit zu vermeiden, Spezialisten einzufliegen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"ausfallzeiten-und-spezialistenabhängigkeit-warum-veränderung-dringend-ist",children:["Ausfallzeiten und Spezialistenabhängigkeit: warum Veränderung dringend ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ausfallzeiten-und-spezialistenabhängigkeit-warum-veränderung-dringend-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Standorte—ob Produktionsanlagen, Energieeinrichtungen oder Logistik-Hubs—verlassen sich auf reibungslosen, ununterbrochenen Betrieb komplexer Ausrüstung. Wenn etwas schiefgeht, sind die Konsequenzen unmittelbar:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Produktionslinien stoppen, verursachen Verlust von Output und Umsatz."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sicherheitsrisiken steigen, besonders wenn unbekannte Teams dringende Reparaturen versuchen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance und Qualität können beeinträchtigt werden, wenn unqualifizierte Interventionen vorgenommen werden."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionell war die Lösung, einen Lieferanten oder technischen Spezialisten anzurufen. Laut einem ARC Advisory Group-Bericht von 2023 kosten ungeplante Ausfallzeiten Hersteller geschätzte 50 Milliarden Dollar pro Jahr weltweit, wobei bis zu 42% der Vorfälle externe Intervention erfordern. Reiseverzögerungen, Visa-Prozesse und Spezialisten-Verfügbarkeit können Ausfallzeiten leicht von Stunden auf Tage ausdehnen."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dieser Ansatz ist zunehmend unhaltbar:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Steigende Reisekosten und Lieferkettenstörungen machen das Einfliegen von Experten teurer und weniger zuverlässig."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Qualifikationsengpässe bedeuten, dass weniger Spezialisten verfügbar sind, besonders für Legacy- oder maßgeschneiderte Ausrüstung."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Umwelt- und ESG-Ziele drängen Unternehmen, unnötige Reisen zu minimieren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams müssen aufrüsten und selbstständiger werden, um Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit aufrechtzuerhalten."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"die-lücke-warum-on-site-teams-mit-komplexen-problemen-kämpfen",children:["Die Lücke: warum On-Site-Teams mit komplexen Problemen kämpfen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#die-lücke-warum-on-site-teams-mit-komplexen-problemen-kämpfen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Selbst mit starken internen Wartungs- und Operationsteams verhindern mehrere Barrieren schnelle Lösung komplexer Probleme:"}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Wissenstransfer ist inkonsistent, besonders bei Personalfluktuation und Pensionierungen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Remote-Support-Anrufe über Telefon oder Video fehlt der Kontext und Klarheit, die für präzise Fehlerbehebung benötigt wird."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sprachbarrieren und Misskommunikation führen zu Fehlern und Nacharbeit."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Für Entscheidungsträger ist das Ergebnis ein schwieriger Kompromiss: akzeptieren Sie kostspielige Ausfallzeiten oder akzeptieren Sie die Risiken unvollständiger oder falscher Reparaturen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-remote-experten-support-mit-ar-funktioniert",children:["Wie Remote-Experten-Support mit AR funktioniert",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-remote-experten-support-mit-ar-funktioniert",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote-Experten-Support mit AR überbrückt diese Lücken, indem Live-, Echtzeit-Kommunikation mit digitalen Overlays, schrittweisen AR-SOPs und KI-gestützter Anleitung kombiniert wird. So funktioniert es in der Praxis:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["

title: Remote expert support met AR: downtime oplossen zonder specialisten in te vliegen
description: Ontdek hoe remote expert support met AR industriële teams in staat stelt downtime sneller op te lossen, kwaliteit te handhaven en kosten te verminderen zonder specialisten in te vliegen.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"remote-expert-support-met-ar-downtime-oplossen-zonder-specialisten-in-te-vliegen",children:["Remote expert support met AR: downtime oplossen zonder specialisten in te vliegen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-expert-support-met-ar-downtime-oplossen-zonder-specialisten-in-te-vliegen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ongeplande downtime is een kritieke uitdaging voor industriële operaties. Wanneer systemen falen of complex onderhoud vereist is, betekent de snelste weg naar oplossing vaak het binnenhalen van een externe specialist—tegen aanzienlijke kosten, vertraging en risico voor productiviteit. Remote expert support met AR (augmented reality) verandert die vergelijking. Door real-time, on-site begeleiding van experts overal ter wereld mogelijk te maken, helpen AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften uw teams downtime sneller op te lossen, kwaliteit en veiligheid te handhaven en de behoefte om specialisten in te vliegen te vermijden."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"downtime-en-specialistafhankelijkheid-waarom-verandering-urgent-is",children:["Downtime en specialistafhankelijkheid: waarom verandering urgent is",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#downtime-en-specialistafhankelijkheid-waarom-verandering-urgent-is",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële sites—of het nu productiefabrieken, energie-installaties of logistieke hubs zijn—vertrouwen op soepele, ononderbroken operatie van complexe apparatuur. Wanneer iets misgaat, zijn de gevolgen onmiddellijk:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Productielijnen stoppen, wat verlies van output en omzet veroorzaakt."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Veiligheidsrisico's nemen toe, vooral wanneer onbekende teams urgente reparaties proberen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance en kwaliteit kunnen worden aangetast als ongekwalificeerde interventies worden gemaakt."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditioneel is de oplossing geweest om een leverancier of technische specialist in te schakelen. Volgens een rapport uit 2023 van ARC Advisory Group kosten ongeplande downtime fabrikanten naar schatting $50 miljard per jaar wereldwijd, waarbij tot 42% van de incidenten externe interventie vereist. Reisvertragingen, visaprocessen en specialistbeschikbaarheid kunnen downtime gemakkelijk van uren naar dagen rekken."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Deze aanpak is steeds onhoudbaarder:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Stijgende reiskosten en supply chain-verstoringen maken het invliegen van experts duurder en minder betrouwbaar."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vaardigheidstekorten betekenen dat minder specialisten beschikbaar zijn, vooral voor legacy of op maat gemaakte apparatuur."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Milieu- en ESG-doelen duwen bedrijven om onnodige reizen te minimaliseren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams moeten upskillen en zelfredzamer worden om uptime en veiligheid te handhaven."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"de-kloof-waarom-on-site-teams-worstelen-met-complexe-problemen",children:["De kloof: waarom on-site teams worstelen met complexe problemen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#de-kloof-waarom-on-site-teams-worstelen-met-complexe-problemen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Zelfs met sterke interne onderhouds- en operationsteams voorkomen verschillende barrières snelle oplossing van complexe problemen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"OEM-handleidingen en SOPs zijn vaak statisch, generiek en moeilijk te volgen onder druk."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Kennisoverdracht is inconsistent, vooral met personeelsverloop en pensioneringen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Remote support-oproepen via telefoon of video missen de context en duidelijkheid nodig voor precieze troubleshooting."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Taalbarrières en miscommunicatie leiden tot fouten en herwerk."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Voor besluitvormers is het resultaat een moeilijke afweging: accepteer kostbare downtime, of accepteer de risico's van incomplete of incorrecte reparaties."}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Verminderde kosten:"})," Het elimineren van reizen en het verminderen van herhaalde sitebezoeken bespaart directe en indirecte kosten."]}),"

Live AR-overlays verminderen ambiguïteit, waarborgen nauwkeurigheid en minimaliseren het risico op non-compliance."}),"

title: Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists
description: Discover how remote expert support with AR enables industrial teams to resolve downtime faster, maintain quality, and reduce costs without flying in specialists.

image.alt: Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"remote-expert-support-with-ar-resolving-downtime-without-flying-in-specialists",children:["Remote expert support with AR: resolving downtime without flying in specialists",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-expert-support-with-ar-resolving-downtime-without-flying-in-specialists",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Unplanned downtime is a critical challenge for industrial operations. When systems fail or complex maintenance is required, the fastest path to resolution often means bringing in an external specialist—at significant cost, delay, and risk to productivity. Remote expert support with AR (augmented reality) is changing that equation. By enabling real-time, on-site guidance from experts anywhere in the world, AI and AR–guided work instructions help your teams resolve downtime faster, maintain quality and safety, and avoid the need to fly in specialists."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"downtime-and-specialist-dependence-why-change-is-urgent",children:["Downtime and specialist dependence: why change is urgent",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#downtime-and-specialist-dependence-why-change-is-urgent",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial sites—whether manufacturing plants, energy facilities, or logistics hubs—rely on the smooth, uninterrupted operation of complex equipment. When something goes wrong, the consequences are immediate:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Production lines stop, causing loss of output and revenue."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Safety risks increase, especially when unfamiliar teams attempt urgent repairs."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance and quality can be compromised if unqualified interventions are made."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionally, the solution has been to call in a vendor or technical specialist. According to a 2023 ARC Advisory Group report, unplanned downtime costs manufacturers an estimated $50 billion per year globally, with up to 42% of incidents requiring external intervention. Travel delays, visa processes, and specialist availability can easily stretch downtime from hours to days."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This approach is increasingly unsustainable:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Rising travel costs and supply chain disruptions make flying in experts more expensive and less reliable."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Skills shortages mean fewer specialists are available, especially for legacy or bespoke equipment."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Environmental and ESG goals push companies to minimize unnecessary travel."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams need to upskill and become more self-reliant to maintain uptime and safety."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"the-gap-why-on-site-teams-struggle-with-complex-issues",children:["The gap: why on-site teams struggle with complex issues",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-gap-why-on-site-teams-struggle-with-complex-issues",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Even with strong in-house maintenance and operations teams, several barriers prevent rapid resolution of complex problems:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"OEM manuals and SOPs are often static, generic, and hard to follow under pressure."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Knowledge transfer is inconsistent, especially with staff turnover and retirements."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Remote support calls via phone or video lack the context and clarity needed for precise troubleshooting."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Language barriers and miscommunication lead to errors and rework."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For decision makers, the result is a difficult trade-off: accept costly downtime, or accept the risks of incomplete or incorrect repairs."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-remote-expert-support-with-ar-works",children:["How remote expert support with AR works",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-remote-expert-support-with-ar-works",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote expert support with AR bridges these gaps by combining live, real-time communication with digital overlays, step-by-step AR SOPs, and AI-powered guidance. Here’s how it works in practice:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"On-site technicians use AR-enabled devices (smart glasses, tablets, or phones) to connect with remote experts."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"The expert sees exactly what the technician sees, in real time, through a secure video feed."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Using AR, the expert can annotate the technician’s field of view—highlighting components, drawing arrows, or overlaying instructions directly onto the equipment."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions provide relevant SOPs, checklists, and troubleshooting steps, customized for the specific asset and scenario."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Documentation and session recording ensure compliance and knowledge capture for future reference."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This setup transforms remote support from a passive phone call to an interactive, context-rich collaboration."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"key-benefits-of-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:["Key benefits of remote expert support with AR",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-benefits-of-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Organizations adopting AR-based remote support realize measurable improvements in several areas:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Faster resolution of downtime:"})," Teams can begin troubleshooting immediately, without waiting for travel or scheduling."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Improved safety and compliance:"})," Step-by-step AR SOPs reduce risk of error and ensure adherence to procedures."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reduced costs:"})," Eliminating travel and reducing repeat site visits saves direct and indirect costs."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Workforce upskilling:"})," On-site teams gain confidence and expertise by working through issues under expert guidance."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Better documentation:"})," Every session can be captured for audit, training, and continuous improvement."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A 2022 Capgemini study found that companies using AR remote assistance reduced machine downtime by 30–50%, with a similar reduction in travel-related costs."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"practical-use-cases-in-industrial-environments",children:["Practical use cases in industrial environments",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-use-cases-in-industrial-environments",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote expert support with AR is already delivering results in sectors such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, and logistics. Here are some concrete scenarios:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"complex-equipment-troubleshooting",children:["Complex equipment troubleshooting",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#complex-equipment-troubleshooting",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A packaging line in a food processing plant goes down due to a sensor fault. The maintenance team connects with a remote OEM specialist using AR smart glasses. The expert guides the team through diagnostics, highlights wiring and sensor locations in the technician’s field of view, and confirms the fix—all without leaving their office."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"commissioning-and-calibration",children:["Commissioning and calibration",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#commissioning-and-calibration",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A new automated inspection system must be calibrated to meet regulatory standards. Instead of waiting for a vendor representative, the plant’s quality engineer uses AR-enabled instructions and connects with a remote calibration expert. Live AR overlays reduce ambiguity, ensure accuracy, and minimize the risk of non-compliance."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"emergency-response-and-safety-incidents",children:["Emergency response and safety incidents",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#emergency-response-and-safety-incidents",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A chemical plant experiences an alarm on a critical valve. The HSE manager initiates a remote support session with a process safety expert, who walks the on-site team through isolation procedures using AR overlays and digital checklists. The incident is resolved safely, with full documentation for follow-up."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"training-and-onboarding",children:["Training and onboarding",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-and-onboarding",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"New technicians join a wind farm maintenance team with limited hands-on experience. By pairing AI and AR–guided work instructions with remote mentoring, the team accelerates onboarding and ensures that every step is performed correctly—even during their first solo intervention."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"whats-needed-for-effective-remote-expert-support",children:["What’s needed for effective remote expert support",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#whats-needed-for-effective-remote-expert-support",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"To realize the benefits of AR remote support, organizations should address several practical considerations:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Device compatibility:"})," Ensure AR solutions work with existing devices (smart glasses, tablets, rugged smartphones) and can operate in challenging environments (gloves, PPE, variable lighting)."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Network reliability:"})," Industrial sites must provide secure, stable connectivity—ideally with offline fallback for critical instructions."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content readiness:"})," Digital SOPs and AI–guided instructions must be accurate, up-to-date, and tailored to assets and processes."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Data security:"})," All remote sessions and data transfers should comply with company and regulatory standards for privacy and cybersecurity."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Teams need training, support, and clear governance to adopt new workflows and maximize ROI."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Note:"})," While AR remote support reduces the need for specialist travel, it does not eliminate the need for on-site expertise in all cases. Some interventions (e.g., high-voltage work, hazardous materials) may still require certified specialists on site."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-actarion-enables-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:["How ActARion enables remote expert support with AR",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-actarion-enables-remote-expert-support-with-ar",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion partners with industrial organizations to deploy remote expert support that is robust, scalable, and tailored to operational realities. Our approach combines:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions:"})," We digitize your SOPs and asset-specific procedures for real-time use in the field."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Seamless remote session management:"})," Secure video, annotation, and documentation tools integrate with your existing systems."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Governance and compliance:"})," We help you manage access, recordkeeping, and audit trails for every support session."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change enablement:"})," Our experts support your teams through onboarding, training, and continuous improvement."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This means your teams are empowered to resolve downtime and complex issues, safely and efficiently—without waiting for external specialists to arrive on site."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"results-measurable-impact-on-productivity-and-cost",children:["Results: measurable impact on productivity and cost",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-measurable-impact-on-productivity-and-cost",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Organizations using ActARion’s remote expert support with AR report:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"30–60% reduction in average downtime per incident"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"40% drop in travel-related support costs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Improved first-time fix rates and reduced repeat visits"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Higher technician engagement and skills retention"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Enhanced compliance and traceability for critical interventions"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["These outcomes are supported by real-world deployments across manufacturing, energy, and logistics sectors. For more details, see our ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/use-cases",children:"case studies and use cases"}),"."]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"explore-remote-expert-support-for-your-organisation",children:["Explore remote expert support for your organisation",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-remote-expert-support-for-your-organisation",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Remote expert support with AR enables your teams to resolve downtime quickly, maintain quality, and reduce costs—without flying in specialists. To explore how this looks for your specific assets, sites, and teams, schedule a discovery call with ActARion. This is an exploratory conversation, not a commitment."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/use-cases",children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions"}),", or see how ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/use-cases/ar-training-and-onboarding-for-industrial-teams",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"})," accelerates skills transfer. For industry trends and best practices, see the ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.weforum.org/agenda/2022/11/augmented-reality-manufacturing-industry/",children:"World Economic Forum on AR in industry"}),"."]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"go-deeper",children:["Go deeper",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#go-deeper",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This article is part of our knowledge base on connected worker solutions. For a comprehensive overview, read our whitepaper:"}),"
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:n(t.a,{href:"/en/whitepapers/connected-worker-platforms",children:"Connected worker platforms: enabling knowledge transfer and operational support"})})," — Covers remote expert support and other key use cases enabled by connected worker platforms."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

",i(t.ul,{children:["

",n(t.li,{children:"Kompetenzlücken oder abgelaufene Zertifizierungen können Sicherheit, Qualität und Reputation gefährden"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Regulierungsbehörden wie OSHA, ISO und lokale Behörden verlangen dokumentierten Nachweis der Workforce-Kompetenz. ",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Teams stehen regelmäßig vor Verfahren, die, obwohl selten, erhebliches Risiko tragen. Komplexe Umstellungen, Notabschaltungen, enge Räume Zugang und kritische Wartungsaufgaben erfordern absolute Präzision. Dennoch, weil diese Verfahren selten durchgeführt werden, können selbst erfahrene Techniker und Operatoren Schwierigkeiten haben, sich an genaue Schritte zu erinnern, was das Risiko von Fehlern, Vorfällen und Ausfallzeiten erhöht."}),"

",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Techniker haben möglicherweise keine wiederholte Exposition zu den Schritten, also verblasst das Gedächtnis."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Papierbasierte SOPs können übersehen, falsch interpretiert oder veraltet sein."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verbale Übergaben verlieren Details, besonders über Schichten oder Teams."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Hochriskante Aufgaben erfordern oft schnelle, korrekte Aktion unter Druck."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Auditoren und Sicherheitsleiter benötigen klaren Nachweis von Compliance und Schulung."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Zum Beispiel führt eine Chemieanlage möglicherweise nur einmal im Jahr eine vollständige Behälterdekontamination durch. In diesen Fällen kann ein einzelner Fehler zu Verletzungen, Umweltvorfällen oder kostspieligen Ausfallzeiten führen."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Forschung der Institution of Chemical Engineers (IChemE) hebt hervor, dass seltene Verfahren unverhältnismäßig in Vorfallberichten vertreten sind, größtenteils aufgrund von Gedächtnislücken, unklaren Anweisungen oder unvollständigen Übergaben (",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.icheme.org/",children:"IChemE, 2020"}),")."]}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"warum-jetzt-regulatorische-und-workforce-trends-erhöhen-den-bedarf-an-standardisierung",children:["Warum jetzt: regulatorische und Workforce-Trends erhöhen den Bedarf an Standardisierung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-jetzt-regulatorische-und-workforce-trends-erhöhen-den-bedarf-an-standardisierung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

"]}),"

title: Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures
description: How AR work instructions help operations, HSE, and training teams standardise rare or high risk procedures for safer, more consistent outcomes.

image.alt: Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:["Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial teams regularly face procedures that, while rare, carry significant risk. Complex changeovers, emergency shutdowns, confined space entries, and critical maintenance tasks demand absolute precision. Yet, because these procedures are performed infrequently, even experienced technicians and operators can struggle to recall exact steps, increasing the risk of errors, incidents, and downtime."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) work instructions offer a practical, proven way to standardise these rare or high risk procedures—making work safer, more consistent, and easier to audit."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:["Why rare and high risk procedures remain a challenge",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most industrial sites have robust standard operating procedures (SOPs) for daily tasks. But rare or high risk procedures create unique challenges:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Technicians may not have repeated exposure to the steps, so memory fades."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Paper-based SOPs can be overlooked, misinterpreted, or outdated."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Verbal handovers lose detail, especially across shifts or teams."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"High risk tasks often require rapid, correct action under pressure."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Auditors and safety leads need clear evidence of compliance and training."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For example, a chemical plant may only perform a full vessel decontamination once a year. A water utility might only isolate major pipelines during emergency repairs. In these cases, a single mistake can lead to injuries, environmental incidents, or costly downtime."}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["Research from the Institution of Chemical Engineers (IChemE) highlights that rare procedures are disproportionately represented in incident reports, largely due to lapses in memory, unclear instructions, or incomplete handovers (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.icheme.org/",children:"IChemE, 2020"}),")."]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:["Why now: regulatory and workforce trends increase the need for standardisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Several trends are converging to make standardisation of rare and high risk procedures a top priority:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Stricter regulatory requirements"})," for evidence-based training and procedural compliance."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Aging workforce"})," and increased turnover, leading to loss of institutional knowledge."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"More complex equipment"})," and interconnected systems, raising the stakes for error."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Digital transformation"})," mandates, requiring traceable, auditable processes."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For operations managers, HSE leads, and training professionals, relying on static documents or informal coaching is no longer enough. Digital solutions that deliver guidance at the point of work—and capture proof of execution—are now essential for operational excellence."}),"

description: How AR and AI boost accuracy, compliance, and productivity for quality inspections and audits in regulated industries. For operations, quality, HSE, and training leaders.

",n(r.p,{children:"Quality inspections and audits in regulated industries demand precision, consistency, and documented proof. ",i(r.h2,{id:"regulated-industries-face-rising-pressure-on-quality-and-compliance",children:["Regulated industries face rising pressure on quality and compliance",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#regulated-industries-face-rising-pressure-on-quality-and-compliance",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

At the same time, the workforce is changing, with experienced technicians retiring and new hires needing rapid onboarding."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Key challenges include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Ensuring every inspection and audit step is performed consistently"}),"

",n(r.li,{children:"Incomplete or illegible records"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Missed steps or skipped verifications"}),"

",n(r.li,{children:"High training burden for complex procedures"}),"

Regulators worldwide are increasing expectations for digital traceability, real-time reporting, and proactive risk management."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"The workforce challenge compounds this: as experienced staff retire, new hires may lack deep process knowledge. Standardizing complex inspections is essential to ensure a consistent level of quality and safety."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-enable-smarter-inspections",children:["How AR and AI–guided work instructions enable smarter inspections",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-enable-smarter-inspections",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions transform inspections and audits from error-prone manual tasks into efficient, auditable digital processes. Here’s how:"}),"

",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"AR (augmented reality)"})," overlays digital instructions, checklists, and visual cues on real-world equipment using smart glasses, tablets, or mobile devices."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"AI"})," analyzes images, sensor data, and technician input in real time, flagging anomalies, verifying steps, and automating documentation."]}),"
"]}),"

",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Line clearance and cleaning validation: AR checklists ensure every step is performed and documented before batch startup."}),"

"]}),"

",i(r.ul,{children:["

",n(r.li,{children:"Allergen control audits: Step-by-step AR instructions ensure critical points are checked and recorded, supporting traceability."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"chemical-plants-and-energy",children:["Chemical plants and energy",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#chemical-plants-and-energy",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Safety-critical inspections: AR-guided walkdowns standardize checks on valves, pumps, and containment systems, with AI flagging anomalies."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Permit-to-work validation: AI verifies that all required steps and signatures are completed before work begins."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"aerospace-and-medical-devices",children:["Aerospace and medical devices",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#aerospace-and-medical-devices",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Pre-flight or pre-production inspections: AR overlays highlight inspection points, while AI confirms correct assembly or configuration."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Regulatory evidence capture: Digital records provide clear, time-stamped proof for FAA, EASA, or FDA auditors."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"measurable-results-compliance-quality-and-productivity-gains",children:["Measurable results: compliance, quality, and productivity gains",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#measurable-results-compliance-quality-and-productivity-gains",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Companies implementing AR and AI for quality inspections and audits report:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:["30–50% faster inspection cycles (source: Capgemini, ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www.capgemini.com/research/augmented-and-virtual-reality-in-operations/",children:"Augmented and Virtual Reality in Operations"}),")"]}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"40–60% reduction in documentation errors and missing evidence"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Improved first-time-right rates and reduced rework"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Faster onboarding for new technicians and inspectors"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Easier, less disruptive audits with complete digital trails"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.blockquote,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Note:"})," Results depend on process complexity, team readiness, and integration with existing systems. A pilot phase is recommended to validate impact in your specific environment."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"addressing-obstacles-hardware-change-management-and-governance",children:["Addressing obstacles: hardware, change management, and governance",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-obstacles-hardware-change-management-and-governance",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Adopting AR and AI–guided inspections requires clear planning and change management. Common concerns include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Hardware selection:"})," Smart glasses, tablets, and mobile devices must be rugged, compatible with PPE, and approved for use in regulated zones. ActARion advises on device selection and validation."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Content creation:"})," Digital SOPs and AR checklists must reflect current approved procedures. ActARion works with quality teams to digitize and validate content, ensuring regulatory alignment."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"User adoption:"})," Technicians may be wary of new tools. Early involvement, clear training, and phased rollout support adoption."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Data security and integration:"})," Inspection records must be secure and accessible for audits. ActARion integrates with MES, QMS, and ERP systems to support compliance."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Governance:"})," Change control, versioning, and audit trails are built into the solution, supporting GxP, FDA, or ISO requirements."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"ActARion’s approach combines proven technology with practical support for change management and regulatory compliance."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-regulated-industry-inspections",children:["What ActARion brings to regulated industry inspections",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-regulated-industry-inspections",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"ActARion specializes in AI and AR–guided work instructions for industrial teams in regulated environments. Our platform:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Digitizes and standardizes inspections, audits, and SOPs"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Delivers visual, step-by-step AR guidance on any device"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Uses AI to validate evidence and automate documentation"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Integrates with your quality and compliance systems"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Supports change management, user training, and governance"}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Clients see faster inspections, fewer errors, easier audits, and a more confident, compliant workforce. We work with operations, quality, HSE, and training leaders to tailor solutions to site-specific needs."}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["You can read more about our ",n(r.a,{href:"/explainer/digital-work-instructions",children:"approach to digital work instructions"})," or see ",n(r.a,{href:"/use-cases/ar-sops",children:"real-world use cases for AR SOPs"}),"."]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"explore-ar-and-aiguided-inspections-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore AR and AI–guided inspections in your organisation",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-ar-and-aiguided-inspections-in-your-organisation",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

For industry benchmarks and regulatory trends, review the ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/part-11-electronic-records-electronic-signatures-scope-and-application",children:"FDA’s guidelines on electronic records and signatures"}),"."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Take the first step toward error-free, audit-ready inspections with ActARion."}),"
",n(r.hr,{}),"

title: Business Case für AR aufbauen: Ausfallzeiten, Qualität, Sicherheit und Schulungszeit
description: Wie Operations- und HSE-Leiter Investitionen in AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen rechtfertigen können, indem sie Auswirkungen auf Ausfallzeiten, Qualität, Sicherheit und Schulungseffizienz quantifizieren.
