author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"business-case-für-ar-aufbauen-ausfallzeiten-qualität-sicherheit-und-schulungszeit",children:["Business Case für AR aufbauen: Ausfallzeiten, Qualität, Sicherheit und Schulungszeit",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#business-case-für-ar-aufbauen-ausfallzeiten-qualität-sicherheit-und-schulungszeit",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Leiter stehen unter ständigem Druck, Verfügbarkeit zu verbessern, Fehler zu reduzieren, Sicherheit sicherzustellen und Schulungen zu beschleunigen. Der Aufbau des Business Case für AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen bedeutet, sich auf messbare Vorteile zu konzentrieren: weniger Ausfallzeiten, höhere Qualität, weniger Sicherheitsvorfälle und schnelleres Onboarding. Entscheidungsträger benötigen klare Beweise und praktische Schritte, um Investitionen in KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen zu rechtfertigen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-der-business-case-für-ar-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:["Warum der Business Case für AR jetzt wichtig ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-der-business-case-für-ar-jetzt-wichtig-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Produktion, Energie und Prozessindustrien stehen unter zunehmendem Druck. Ausrüstung ist komplexer, qualifizierte Techniker sind knapp und Compliance-Anforderungen werden verschärft. Wenn ungeplante Ausfallzeiten, Qualitätslücken oder Sicherheitsvorfälle auftreten, sind die Kosten unmittelbar und erheblich."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Laut der International Society of Automation können ungeplante Ausfallzeiten Hersteller bis zu 260.000 $ pro Stunde kosten (",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.isa.org/intech-home/2022/august-2022/features/how-much-does-unplanned-downtime-cost",children:"ISA, 2022"}),"). Selbst kurze Verzögerungen bei Schulung oder Onboarding können Wochen verlorener Produktivität bedeuten. Währenddessen sind Sicherheitsvorfälle nicht nur ein menschliches Risiko, sondern auch eine große Bedrohung für Reputation und Compliance."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Operations-, Wartungs-, HSE- und L&D-Leiter schauen zunehmend auf digitale Tools, um diese Risiken anzugehen. Traditionelle Dokumentation und klassenbasierte Schulungen halten nicht mit der Komplexität und Geschwindigkeit moderner Operationen Schritt. Das Ergebnis: anhaltende Qualifikationslücken, wiederkehrende Fehler und langsame Reaktion auf operative Veränderungen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"die-einschränkungen-aktueller-ansätze",children:["Die Einschränkungen aktueller Ansätze",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#die-einschränkungen-aktueller-ansätze",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Viele Organisationen verlassen sich auf papierbasierte SOPs, statische PDFs oder veraltete Schulungsmodule. Diese schaffen mehrere Herausforderungen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Verfahren sind schwer zu aktualisieren und zu verteilen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Techniker können Schritte falsch interpretieren, besonders in unbekannten oder hochstressigen Situationen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schulung ist zeitaufwändig und inkonsistent."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Kritisches Wissen geht oft verloren, wenn erfahrene Mitarbeiter in Rente gehen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Digitale Arbeitsanweisungen und KI-gestützte Wissensdatenbanken helfen, erfordern aber immer noch, dass Techniker vom Werk wegschauen oder nach dem richtigen Dokument suchen. Dies verlangsamt Fehlerbehebung, erhöht das Risiko übersprungener Schritte und lässt Raum für Fehler."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-ar-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-kern-business-treiber-adressieren",children:["Wie AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen Kern-Business-Treiber adressieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ar-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-kern-business-treiber-adressieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen bieten einen Schrittwechsel in der operativen Leistung. Durch Überlagern interaktiver, kontextbewusster Anweisungen direkt auf Ausrüstung oder Arbeitsplätze helfen AR-SOPs Technikern, schneller, sicherer und genauer zu arbeiten."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Schlüsselfunktionen für den Business Case:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Ausfallzeiten:"})," AR-gestützte Fehlerbehebung und Wartung reduzieren die mittlere Reparaturzeit (MTTR), indem sie Echtzeit-, handenfreie Anleitung bieten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Qualität:"})," Standardisierte, visuelle Anweisungen minimieren Fehler und Nacharbeit, verbessern First-Time-Right-Raten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Sicherheit:"})," Kontextuelle Prompts und Checklisten helfen sicherzustellen, dass Compliance mit Sicherheitsprotokollen bei jedem Schritt gewährleistet wird."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Schulungszeit:"})," On-the-Job-AR-Onboarding ermöglicht es neuen Technikern, schneller Kompetenz zu erreichen, reduziert Zeit bis Autonomie."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hinweis:"})," Diese Vorteile sind nicht theoretisch. Ein Capgemini-Bericht von 2023 ergab, dass Organisationen, die AR für Operationen verwenden, eine Reduzierung der Schulungszeit um 30–50% und einen Rückgang der Fehlerraten um 25–40% sahen (Capgemini research)."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"ausfallzeitreduzierung-mit-ar-sops-quantifizieren",children:["Ausfallzeitreduzierung mit AR-SOPs quantifizieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ausfallzeitreduzierung-mit-ar-sops-quantifizieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ungeplante Ausfallzeiten sind ein wichtiger Kostentreiber für industrielle Operationen. Ursachen reichen von Ausrüstungsausfällen bis zu Prozessabweichungen oder menschlichen Fehlern. Der Business Case für AR beginnt damit, zu quantifizieren, wie digitale, AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen diese Grundursachen adressieren."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"ar-gestützte-fehlerbehebung-und-wartung",children:["AR-gestützte Fehlerbehebung und Wartung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-gestützte-fehlerbehebung-und-wartung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Techniker greifen auf schrittweise Verfahren zu, die auf dem Asset überlagert sind, reduzieren Zeit, die mit der Suche nach Handbüchern verbracht wird."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"KI-gestützte Diagnostik schlägt wahrscheinliche Ursachen und nächste Aktionen basierend auf Sensordaten und vorherigen Vorfällen vor."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Remote-Experten können sehen, was der Techniker sieht, und Live-Anleitung bieten, beschleunigen komplexe Reparaturen."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Beispiel:"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Ein globaler Verpackungshersteller implementierte AR-SOPs für routinemäßige Ausrüstungsumstellungen. Die durchschnittliche Ausfallzeit pro Umstellung sank von 50 Minuten auf 30 Minuten—eine Verbesserung von 40%. Bei 200 Umstellungen pro Jahr sparte dies über 65 Stunden verlorener Produktion jährlich."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"die-auswirkungen-berechnen",children:["Die Auswirkungen berechnen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#die-auswirkungen-berechnen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Pro Jahr gesparte Ausfallzeitstunden"})," = (alte Umstellungszeit – neue Umstellungszeit) × Ereignishäufigkeit"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Kosteneinsparungen"})," = gesparte Ausfallzeitstunden × durchschnittliche Kosten pro Ausfallzeitstunde"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Für eine Linie mit 8.000 $ stündlichen Ausfallzeitkosten übersetzen sich 65 gesparte Stunden in 520.000 $ jährliche Einsparungen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"qualität-verbessern-und-fehler-reduzieren",children:["Qualität verbessern und Fehler reduzieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#qualität-verbessern-und-fehler-reduzieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Qualitätslücken, Nacharbeit und Ausschuss sind anhaltende Herausforderungen, besonders wenn Prozesse komplexer werden oder zu Teams mit weniger Erfahrung wechseln."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"ar-sops-für-standardisierte-ausführung",children:["AR-SOPs für standardisierte Ausführung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-sops-für-standardisierte-ausführung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Visuelle Prompts und Animationen klären jeden Schritt, reduzieren Mehrdeutigkeit."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"KI-adaptive Anweisungen passen sich an Produktvarianten oder Echtzeit-Prozessdaten an."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Eingebaute Prüfungen verhindern, dass Techniker kritische Schritte überspringen oder falsche Teile verwenden."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Beispiel:"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Ein Automobilzulieferer führte AR-SOPs für eine hochpräzise Montagelinie ein. Fehlerraten sanken von 2,5% auf 1,2% innerhalb von drei Monaten, halbierten Ausschusskosten."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"qualitätsbezogene-einsparungen-schätzen",children:["Qualitätsbezogene Einsparungen schätzen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#qualitätsbezogene-einsparungen-schätzen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Fehlerratenreduzierung"})," = (Baseline-Fehlerrate – Post-AR-Fehlerrate) × jährliches Produktionsvolumen"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Kostenvermeidung"})," = verhinderte Fehler × durchschnittliche Kosten pro Fehler (Nacharbeit, Ausschuss, Garantie)"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In High-Mix-, High-Value-Umgebungen können selbst 1% Fehlerreduzierung Hunderttausende pro Jahr einsparen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"sicherheits-compliance-und-vorfallprävention-verbessern",children:["Sicherheits-Compliance und Vorfallprävention verbessern",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#sicherheits-compliance-und-vorfallprävention-verbessern",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Sicherheit ist nicht verhandelbar. Selbst kleine Lücken können zu Verletzungen, regulatorischen Bußgeldern und Reputationsschäden führen. Traditionelle Sicherheitschecklisten und Schulungen stellen oft kein konsistentes Verhalten im Feld sicher."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"ar-für-echtzeit-sicherheitseinhaltung",children:["AR für Echtzeit-Sicherheitseinhaltung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-für-echtzeit-sicherheitseinhaltung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Sicherheitskritische Schritte werden im Kontext hervorgehoben, mit visuellen Warnungen, wenn übersprungen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR kann digitale Freigaben für Lock-Out/Tag-Out, PSA-Prüfungen und gefährliche Schritte erzwingen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vorfallberichterstattung und Near-Miss-Erfassung sind in den Workflow integriert, machen Compliance leichter zu dokumentieren."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Beispiel:"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Eine Chemieanlage pilotierte AR-gestützte Lock-Out/Tag-Out-Verfahren. Near-Miss-Vorfälle sanken um 60% in sechs Monaten, und Audit-Bereitschaft verbesserte sich durch automatische digitale Aufzeichnungen."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"sicherheits-roi-berechnen",children:["Sicherheits-ROI berechnen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#sicherheits-roi-berechnen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Vorfallreduzierung"})," = (Baseline-Vorfälle – Post-AR-Vorfälle) × durchschnittliche Kosten pro Vorfall (medizinisch, regulatorisch, Ausfallzeiten)"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Compliance-Verbesserung"})," = weniger fehlgeschlagene Audits, reduzierte Zeit für Dokumentation"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Diese Verbesserungen unterstützen direkt HSE- und Operations-KPIs sowie ISO- und rechtliche Compliance-Anforderungen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"schulung-und-onboarding-mit-ar-beschleunigen",children:["Schulung und Onboarding mit AR beschleunigen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schulung-und-onboarding-mit-ar-beschleunigen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Workforce-Fluktuation und Qualifikationsengpässe machen schnelles, effektives Onboarding zu einem Business-Imperativ. Traditionelle Klassen- und Job-Schatten-Ansätze sind langsam und ressourcenintensiv."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"ar-onboarding-für-neue-techniker",children:["AR-Onboarding für neue Techniker",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-onboarding-für-neue-techniker",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Neueinstellungen folgen interaktiven, schrittweisen AR-Anweisungen bei der Arbeit."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sofortiges Feedback und KI-gestützte Tipps helfen ihnen, Fehler in Echtzeit zu vermeiden."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schulungsinhalte werden sofort aktualisiert, wenn sich Verfahren ändern, reduzieren das Risiko veralteten Wissens."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Beispiel:"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Eine Lebensmittelverarbeitungsanlage verwendete AR, um Saisonpersonal zu onboarden. Die durchschnittliche Zeit bis autonome Arbeit sank von 10 Tagen auf 4 Tage—eine Reduzierung von 60%. Erfahrene Mitarbeiter verbrachten weniger Zeit mit Überwachung, befreiten sie für höherwertige Aufgaben."]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"schulungszeit-einsparungsberechnung",children:["Schulungszeit-Einsparungsberechnung",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schulungszeit-einsparungsberechnung",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Pro Einstellung gesparte Schulungszeit"})," = (alte Onboarding-Zeit – neue Onboarding-Zeit) × Anzahl der Einstellungen"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Produktivitätsgewinn"})," = mehr Personal erreicht vollständige Produktivität schneller"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In High-Turnover-Umgebungen rechtfertigen diese Gewinne schnell Investitionen in AR-SOPs."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"häufige-einwände-und-voraussetzungen-adressieren",children:["Häufige Einwände und Voraussetzungen adressieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#häufige-einwände-und-voraussetzungen-adressieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Entscheidungsträger fragen oft nach praktischen Barrieren für AR-Adoption. Das Adressieren dieser Bedenken ist kritisch für einen glaubwürdigen Business Case."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"hardware-und-it-integration",children:["Hardware und IT-Integration",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hardware-und-it-integration",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Moderne AR-Lösungen laufen auf Standard-Smart Glasses, Tablets oder sogar Smartphones."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integration mit bestehenden Asset-Management-, ERP- oder Lernsystemen ist über APIs möglich."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutzstandards werden unterstützt, um Unternehmensanforderungen zu erfüllen."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"content-erstellung-und-change-management",children:["Content-Erstellung und Change Management",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#content-erstellung-und-change-management",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Die anfängliche Erstellung digitaler Arbeitsanweisungen erfordert Aufwand; Beginn mit wirkungsvollen Verfahren ist am besten."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"KI-gestützte Authoring-Tools und Vorlagen beschleunigen Content-Entwicklung."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Change-Management-Unterstützung—Schulung, Kommunikation und Pilotprojekte—hilft, Adoption voranzutreiben."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"skalierung-und-governance",children:["Skalierung und Governance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#skalierung-und-governance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Beginnen Sie mit einem Pilot für einen klar definierten Anwendungsfall (z.B. Umstellungen, sicherheitskritische Aufgaben)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Messen Sie Ergebnisse, verfeinern Sie Inhalte und bauen Sie interne Champions auf."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Erweitern Sie auf zusätzliche Standorte, Assets oder Prozesse, sobald der Wert nachgewiesen ist."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hinweis:"})," Für eine Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung zum Pilotieren von AR-SOPs siehe ",n(t.a,{href:"/de/explainer/ar-pilot-checklist",children:"wie man einen erfolgreichen AR-Pilot durchführt"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"was-actarion-zu-ihrem-ar-business-case-beiträgt",children:["Was ActARion zu Ihrem AR-Business Case beiträgt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-actarion-zu-ihrem-ar-business-case-beiträgt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion arbeitet mit Industrielleitern zusammen, um messbare Ergebnisse aus KI- und AR-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen zu liefern. Unser Ansatz konzentriert sich auf:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Mapping geschäftskritischer Prozesse, um zu identifizieren, wo AR den höchsten ROI liefert"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schnelle Content-Erstellung und Bereitstellung mit bewährten Vorlagen und KI-gestütztem Authoring"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integration mit Ihren bestehenden Workflows, Asset-Management und Compliance-Systemen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Change-Management-Unterstützung, vom Pilot bis zur vollständigen Einführung"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Transparente Metriken und Berichterstattung, um einen datengesteuerten Business Case aufzubauen"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Unser Team bringt jahrzehntelange industrielle, HSE- und digitale Transformationserfahrung mit. Wir verstehen die Drucke, denen Sie ausgesetzt sind—Ausfallzeiten, Qualität, Sicherheit und Qualifikationen—und helfen Ihnen, einen Business Case aufzubauen, der der Prüfung standhält."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"erkunden-sie-was-ar-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-für-ihre-operation-liefern-könnten",children:["Erkunden Sie, was AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen für Ihre Operation liefern könnten",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#erkunden-sie-was-ar-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-für-ihre-operation-liefern-könnten",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Wenn die Reduzierung von Ausfallzeiten, Verbesserung der Qualität, Verhinderung von Sicherheitsvorfällen oder Beschleunigung des Onboardings Prioritäten sind, ist es Zeit, AR-SOPs für Ihr Unternehmen zu bewerten.",n(t.br,{}),"
","Vereinbaren Sie einen Discovery Call, um zu erkunden, wie ActARion Ihnen helfen kann, die Auswirkungen von KI- und AR-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen auf Ihre spezifischen Prozesse zu quantifizieren—keine Verpflichtung erforderlich."]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:["Sehen Sie, wie ",n(t.a,{href:"/de/use-cases/digital-maintenance-instructions",children:"digitale Arbeitsanweisungen Ergebnisse in der Wartung vorantreiben"}),"."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["Erfahren Sie mehr über ",n(t.a,{href:"/de/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR-Onboarding für neue Techniker"}),"."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["Für eine externe Perspektive siehe Capgeminis ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.capgemini.com/research/augmented-reality-in-operations/",children:"AR in Operationen Forschung"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Lassen Sie uns besprechen, wie AR zu Ihren Business-Prioritäten passt und gemeinsam einen glaubwürdigen, datengesteuerten Business Case aufbauen."})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Business case bouwen voor AR: downtime, kwaliteit, veiligheid en trainingstijd
description: Hoe operations- en HSE-leiders investering in AR-geleide werkvoorschriften kunnen rechtvaardigen door impact te kwantificeren op downtime, kwaliteit, veiligheid en trainingsefficiëntie.

image.alt: Business case bouwen voor AR: downtime, kwaliteit, veiligheid en trainingstijd

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"business-case-bouwen-voor-ar-downtime-kwaliteit-veiligheid-en-trainingstijd",children:["Business case bouwen voor AR: downtime, kwaliteit, veiligheid en trainingstijd",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#business-case-bouwen-voor-ar-downtime-kwaliteit-veiligheid-en-trainingstijd",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industriële leiders staan voor constante druk om uptime te verbeteren, fouten te verminderen, veiligheid te waarborgen en training te versnellen. Het bouwen van de business case voor AR-geleide werkvoorschriften betekent focussen op meetbare voordelen: minder downtime, hogere kwaliteit, minder veiligheidsincidenten en snellere onboarding. Besluitvormers hebben duidelijk bewijs en praktische stappen nodig om investering in AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften te rechtvaardigen."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"waarom-de-business-case-voor-ar-nu-belangrijk-is",children:["Waarom de business case voor AR nu belangrijk is",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-de-business-case-voor-ar-nu-belangrijk-is",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Productie, energie en procesindustrieën staan onder toenemende druk. Apparatuur is complexer, vaardige technici zijn schaars en compliance-vereisten worden aangescherpt. Wanneer ongeplande downtime, kwaliteitslekken of veiligheidsincidenten optreden, zijn de kosten onmiddellijk en aanzienlijk."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["Volgens de International Society of Automation kan ongeplande downtime fabrikanten tot $260.000 per uur kosten (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.isa.org/intech-home/2022/august-2022/features/how-much-does-unplanned-downtime-cost",children:"ISA, 2022"}),"). Zelfs korte vertragingen in training of onboarding kunnen weken van verloren productiviteit betekenen. Ondertussen zijn veiligheidsincidenten niet alleen een menselijk risico maar ook een grote bedreiging voor reputatie en compliance."]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Operations-, onderhouds-, HSE- en L&D-leiders kijken steeds meer naar digitale tools om deze risico's aan te pakken. Traditionele documentatie en klaslokaalgebaseerde training houden niet bij met de complexiteit en snelheid van moderne operaties. Het resultaat: aanhoudende vaardigheidsgaten, terugkerende fouten en trage respons op operationele veranderingen."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"de-beperkingen-van-huidige-aanpakken",children:["De beperkingen van huidige aanpakken",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#de-beperkingen-van-huidige-aanpakken",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Veel organisaties vertrouwen op papiergebaseerde SOPs, statische PDF's of verouderde trainingsmodules. Deze creëren verschillende uitdagingen:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Procedures zijn moeilijk bij te werken en te distribueren."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Technici kunnen stappen verkeerd interpreteren, vooral in onbekende of hoogstress-situaties."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Training is tijdrovend en inconsistent."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Kritieke kennis gaat vaak verloren naarmate ervaren personeel met pensioen gaat."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digitale werkvoorschriften en AI-gedreven kennisbases helpen, maar vereisen nog steeds dat technici wegkijken van het werk of zoeken naar het juiste document. Dit vertraagt troubleshooting, verhoogt het risico op gemiste stappen en laat ruimte voor fouten."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"hoe-ar-geleide-werkvoorschriften-kernbusiness-drijvers-adresseren",children:["Hoe AR-geleide werkvoorschriften kernbusiness-drijvers adresseren",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ar-geleide-werkvoorschriften-kernbusiness-drijvers-adresseren",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI- en AR-geleide werkvoorschriften bieden een stapverandering in operationele prestaties. Door interactieve, contextbewuste instructies direct over apparatuur of werkruimtes te leggen, helpen AR SOPs technici sneller, veiliger en accurater te werken."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Belangrijke voordelen voor de business case:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Downtime:"})," AR-geleide troubleshooting en onderhoud verminderen mean time to repair (MTTR) door real-time, handenvrije begeleiding te bieden."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Kwaliteit:"})," Gestandaardiseerde, visuele instructies minimaliseren fouten en herwerk, wat first-time-right percentages verbetert."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Veiligheid:"})," Contextuele prompts en checklists helpen ervoor te zorgen dat compliance met veiligheidsprotocollen op elke stap wordt gewaarborgd."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Trainingstijd:"})," On-the-job AR onboarding stelt nieuwe technici in staat sneller vaardigheid te bereiken, wat tijd tot autonomie vermindert."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Opmerking:"})," Deze voordelen zijn niet theoretisch. Een Capgemini-rapport uit 2023 vond dat organisaties die AR gebruiken voor operaties een reductie van 30–50% in trainingstijd en een daling van 25–40% in foutpercentages zagen (Capgemini research)."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"downtime-reductie-kwantificeren-met-ar-sops",children:["Downtime-reductie kwantificeren met AR SOPs",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#downtime-reductie-kwantificeren-met-ar-sops",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Ongeplande downtime is een belangrijke kostendrijver voor industriële operaties. Oorzaken variëren van apparatuurstoring tot procesafwijkingen of menselijke fouten. De business case voor AR begint door te kwantificeren hoe digitale, AR-geleide werkvoorschriften deze hoofdoorzaken adresseren."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ar-geleide-troubleshooting-en-onderhoud",children:["AR-geleide troubleshooting en onderhoud",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-geleide-troubleshooting-en-onderhoud",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Technici hebben toegang tot stap-voor-stap procedures overlegd op het asset, wat tijd besteed aan zoeken naar handleidingen vermindert."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"AI-gedreven diagnostiek suggereert waarschijnlijke oorzaken en volgende acties op basis van sensordata en eerdere incidenten."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Remote experts kunnen zien wat de technicus ziet en live begeleiding bieden, wat complexe reparaties versnelt."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Voorbeeld:"}),n(a.br,{}),"
","Een wereldwijde verpakkingsfabrikant implementeerde AR SOPs voor routine-apparatuur-omschakelingen. Gemiddelde downtime per omschakeling daalde van 50 minuten naar 30 minuten—een verbetering van 40%. Met 200 omschakelingen per jaar, bespaarde dit meer dan 65 uur verloren productie jaarlijks."]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"de-impact-berekenen",children:["De impact berekenen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#de-impact-berekenen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Downtime-uren bespaard per jaar"})," = (oude omschakeltijd – nieuwe omschakeltijd) × gebeurtenisfrequentie"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Kostenbesparingen"})," = downtime-uren bespaard × gemiddelde kosten per downtime-uur"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Voor een lijn met $8.000 uurlijkse downtime-kosten, vertaalt 65 uur bespaard zich naar $520.000 jaarlijkse besparingen."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"kwaliteit-verbeteren-en-fouten-verminderen",children:["Kwaliteit verbeteren en fouten verminderen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#kwaliteit-verbeteren-en-fouten-verminderen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Kwaliteitslekken, herwerk en afval zijn aanhoudende uitdagingen, vooral naarmate processen complexer worden of verschuiven naar teams met minder ervaring."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ar-sops-voor-gestandaardiseerde-uitvoering",children:["AR SOPs voor gestandaardiseerde uitvoering",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-sops-voor-gestandaardiseerde-uitvoering",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Visuele prompts en animaties verduidelijken elke stap, wat ambiguïteit vermindert."}),"

title: Building the business case for AR: downtime, quality, safety and training time
description: How operations and HSE leaders can justify investment in AR-guided work instructions by quantifying impact on downtime, quality, safety, and training efficiency.

image.alt: Building the business case for AR: downtime, quality, safety and training time

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"building-the-business-case-for-ar-downtime-quality-safety-and-training-time",children:["Building the business case for AR: downtime, quality, safety and training time",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#building-the-business-case-for-ar-downtime-quality-safety-and-training-time",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial leaders face constant pressure to improve uptime, reduce errors, ensure safety, and speed up training. Building the business case for AR-guided work instructions means focusing on measurable benefits: less downtime, higher quality, fewer safety incidents, and faster onboarding. Decision makers need clear evidence and practical steps to justify investment in AI and AR–guided work instructions."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-the-business-case-for-ar-matters-now",children:["Why the business case for AR matters now",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-the-business-case-for-ar-matters-now",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Manufacturing, energy, and process industries are under increasing strain. Equipment is more complex, skilled technicians are in short supply, and compliance requirements are tightening. When unplanned downtime, quality escapes, or safety incidents occur, the costs are immediate and significant."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["According to the International Society of Automation, unplanned downtime can cost manufacturers up to $260,000 per hour (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.isa.org/intech-home/2022/august-2022/features/how-much-does-unplanned-downtime-cost",children:"ISA, 2022"}),"). Even short delays in training or onboarding can mean weeks of lost productivity. Meanwhile, safety incidents are not only a human risk but also a major threat to reputation and compliance."]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Operations, maintenance, HSE, and L&D leaders increasingly look to digital tools to address these risks. Traditional documentation and classroom-based training are not keeping pace with the complexity and speed of modern operations. The result: persistent skills gaps, recurring errors, and slow response to operational changes."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-limitations-of-current-approaches",children:["The limitations of current approaches",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-limitations-of-current-approaches",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Many organisations rely on paper-based SOPs, static PDFs, or outdated training modules. These create several challenges:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Procedures are hard to update and distribute."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Technicians may misinterpret steps, especially in unfamiliar or high-stress situations."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Training is time-consuming and inconsistent."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Critical knowledge is often lost as experienced staff retire."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digital work instructions and AI-powered knowledge bases help, but they still require technicians to look away from the work or search for the right document. This slows down troubleshooting, increases the risk of missing steps, and leaves room for error."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-guided-work-instructions-address-core-business-drivers",children:["How AR-guided work instructions address core business drivers",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-guided-work-instructions-address-core-business-drivers",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions offer a step change in operational performance. By overlaying interactive, context-aware instructions directly onto equipment or workspaces, AR SOPs help technicians work faster, safer, and more accurately."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key benefits for the business case:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Downtime:"})," AR-guided troubleshooting and maintenance reduce mean time to repair (MTTR) by providing real-time, hands-free guidance."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Quality:"})," Standardised, visual instructions minimise errors and rework, improving first-time-right rates."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Safety:"})," Contextual prompts and checklists help ensure compliance with safety protocols at every step."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Training time:"})," On-the-job AR onboarding enables new technicians to reach proficiency faster, reducing time to autonomy."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," These benefits are not theoretical. A 2023 Capgemini report found that organisations using AR for operations saw a 30–50% reduction in training time and a 25–40% decrease in error rates (Capgemini research)."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"quantifying-downtime-reduction-with-ar-sops",children:["Quantifying downtime reduction with AR SOPs",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#quantifying-downtime-reduction-with-ar-sops",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Unplanned downtime is a major cost driver for industrial operations. Causes range from equipment failure to process deviations or human error. The business case for AR starts by quantifying how digital, AR-guided work instructions address these root causes."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ar-guided-troubleshooting-and-maintenance",children:["AR-guided troubleshooting and maintenance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-guided-troubleshooting-and-maintenance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Technicians access step-by-step procedures overlaid on the asset, reducing time spent searching for manuals."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"AI-driven diagnostics suggest likely causes and next actions based on sensor data and previous incidents."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Remote experts can see what the technician sees and provide live guidance, speeding up complex repairs."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Example:"}),n(a.br,{}),"
","A global packaging manufacturer implemented AR SOPs for routine equipment changeovers. Average downtime per changeover dropped from 50 minutes to 30 minutes—a 40% improvement. With 200 changeovers per year, this saved over 65 hours of lost production annually."]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"calculating-the-impact",children:["Calculating the impact",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#calculating-the-impact",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Downtime hours saved per year"})," = (old changeover time – new changeover time) × event frequency"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Cost savings"})," = downtime hours saved × average cost per downtime hour"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For a line with $8,000 hourly downtime cost, 65 hours saved translates to $520,000 annual savings."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"improving-quality-and-reducing-errors",children:["Improving quality and reducing errors",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#improving-quality-and-reducing-errors",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Quality escapes, rework, and scrap are persistent challenges, especially as processes become more complex or shift to lower-experience teams."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ar-sops-for-standardised-execution",children:["AR SOPs for standardised execution",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-sops-for-standardised-execution",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Visual prompts and animations clarify each step, reducing ambiguity."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"AI-adaptive instructions adjust for product variants or real-time process data."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Built-in checks prevent technicians from skipping critical steps or using incorrect parts."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Example:"}),n(a.br,{}),"
","An automotive supplier introduced AR SOPs for a high-precision assembly line. Error rates dropped from 2.5% to 1.2% within three months, cutting scrap costs in half."]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"estimating-quality-related-savings",children:["Estimating quality-related savings",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#estimating-quality-related-savings",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Error rate reduction"})," = (baseline error rate – post-AR error rate) × annual production volume"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Cost avoidance"})," = errors prevented × average cost per error (rework, scrap, warranty)"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"In high-mix, high-value environments, even a 1% error reduction can save hundreds of thousands per year."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"enhancing-safety-compliance-and-incident-prevention",children:["Enhancing safety compliance and incident prevention",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#enhancing-safety-compliance-and-incident-prevention",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Safety is non-negotiable. Even minor lapses can lead to injuries, regulatory penalties, and reputational damage. Traditional safety checklists and training often fail to ensure consistent behaviour in the field."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ar-for-real-time-safety-adherence",children:["AR for real-time safety adherence",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-for-real-time-safety-adherence",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Safety-critical steps are highlighted in context, with visual alerts if skipped."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"AR can enforce digital sign-offs for lock-out/tag-out, PPE checks, and hazardous steps."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Incident reporting and near-miss capture are integrated into the workflow, making compliance easier to document."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Example:"}),n(a.br,{}),"
","A chemicals plant piloted AR-guided lock-out/tag-out procedures. Near-miss incidents dropped by 60% in six months, and audit readiness improved through automatic digital records."]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"calculating-safety-roi",children:["Calculating safety ROI",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#calculating-safety-roi",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Incident reduction"})," = (baseline incidents – post-AR incidents) × average cost per incident (medical, regulatory, downtime)"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Compliance improvement"})," = fewer failed audits, reduced time spent on documentation"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"These improvements directly support HSE and operations KPIs, as well as ISO and legal compliance requirements."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"accelerating-training-and-onboarding-with-ar",children:["Accelerating training and onboarding with AR",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#accelerating-training-and-onboarding-with-ar",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Workforce turnover and skills shortages make rapid, effective onboarding a business imperative. Traditional classroom and job-shadowing approaches are slow and resource-intensive."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ar-onboarding-for-new-technicians",children:["AR onboarding for new technicians",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-onboarding-for-new-technicians",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"New hires follow interactive, step-by-step AR instructions on the job."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Immediate feedback and AI-powered tips help them avoid mistakes in real time."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Training content is updated instantly as procedures change, reducing the risk of outdated knowledge."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Example:"}),n(a.br,{}),"
","A food processing plant used AR to onboard seasonal staff. Average time to autonomous work dropped from 10 days to 4 days—a 60% reduction. Experienced staff spent less time supervising, freeing them for higher-value tasks."]}),"

title: Change management for AR projects: getting operators, supervisors and IT on board
description: How operations, training and IT leaders can drive successful change management for AR projects in industrial environments.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",em:"em",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",table:"table",tbody:"tbody",td:"td",th:"th",thead:"thead",tr:"tr",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"change-management-for-ar-projects-getting-operators-supervisors-and-it-on-board",children:["Change management for AR projects: getting operators, supervisors and IT on board",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#change-management-for-ar-projects-getting-operators-supervisors-and-it-on-board",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) is moving from niche pilot to critical tool in industrial operations. For operations, maintenance, and HSE leaders, AR projects promise measurable gains: faster onboarding, safer procedures, and fewer errors. But these benefits only materialize if your teams—operators, supervisors, and IT—adopt the new way of working. That's why effective change management for AR projects is essential."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-change-management-matters-in-ar-projects",children:["Why change management matters in AR projects",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-change-management-matters-in-ar-projects",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Introducing digital work instructions or AI and AR–guided work instructions isn't just a technology upgrade. It's a shift in how work gets done, how knowledge is shared, and how compliance is proven. Too often, AR pilots stall because the change management piece is missing: teams go through the motions, but don't fully engage."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Common challenges include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Operators reverting to old habits or paper SOPs"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Supervisors unclear on how to coach or measure new workflows"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"IT teams wary about device management and support"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Resistance due to perceived complexity or lack of value"}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A structured approach to change management helps overcome these barriers by aligning stakeholders, clarifying benefits, and supporting adoption from day one."}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"Every AR implementation involves multiple stakeholder groups, each with unique concerns and needs."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"operators",children:["Operators",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#operators",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Operators are the frontline users of AR-guided work instructions. Their buy-in is critical, yet they often have the most to lose if the transition is poorly managed. Common concerns include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Fear of being monitored or evaluated more closely"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Uncertainty about new technology and devices"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:'Loss of autonomy or "the way we've always done it"'}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"supervisors-and-team-leads",children:["Supervisors and team leads",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#supervisors-and-team-leads",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Supervisors play a central role in reinforcing new behaviors and coaching their teams. For AR projects, they need to understand:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"How AR changes the workflow and the supervisor's role"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"What metrics and data are now available"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"How to support operators who struggle with the transition"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"it-and-digital-teams",children:["IT and digital teams",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#it-and-digital-teams",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"IT is responsible for device management, security, integration, and support. Their concerns often center on:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Scalability of device management (especially for smart glasses or tablets)"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Data security and compliance"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Integration with existing systems like MES, ERP, or CMMS"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"training-and-hr",children:["Training and HR",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-and-hr",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Training professionals need to update curricula, while HR may need to address role changes or new competency requirements. Both should be involved early in the process."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"best-practices-for-change-management-in-ar-projects",children:["Best practices for change management in AR projects",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#best-practices-for-change-management-in-ar-projects",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"start-with-a-clear-business-case",children:["Start with a clear business case",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#start-with-a-clear-business-case",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["Before launching any change initiative, make sure everyone understands ",n(r.em,{children:"why"}),". Communicate the specific business problems AR will address—whether it's onboarding time, quality issues, or safety incidents. Use data from pilots or benchmarks to quantify the opportunity."]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"involve-stakeholders-early",children:["Involve stakeholders early",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#involve-stakeholders-early",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Don't wait until the rollout to engage operators or IT. Include them in pilots, solicit feedback, and adjust based on real-world input. Early involvement builds ownership and surfaces potential issues before they become blockers."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"define-success-metrics-upfront",children:["Define success metrics upfront",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#define-success-metrics-upfront",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Set clear KPIs for the AR project and communicate them to all stakeholders. Metrics might include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Time to competence for new operators"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Error rates or quality metrics"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Safety incident rates"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"User engagement with AR instructions"}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Transparent metrics help focus the effort and demonstrate value as the project progresses."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"provide-training-and-support",children:["Provide training and support",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#provide-training-and-support",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Don't assume adoption will happen automatically. Offer hands-on training for operators and supervisors, covering both the technology and the new workflows. Make sure IT has the resources to support users and troubleshoot issues quickly."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"celebrate-quick-wins",children:["Celebrate quick wins",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#celebrate-quick-wins",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Identify early adopters and high-impact use cases where AR can deliver visible results. Publicize these wins to build momentum and demonstrate credibility across the organization."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"communicate-continuously",children:["Communicate continuously",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#communicate-continuously",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Change management is not a one-time event. Keep stakeholders informed of progress, challenges, and adjustments. Use regular updates, town halls, or digital channels to maintain visibility and engagement."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"overcoming-common-resistance",children:["Overcoming common resistance",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#overcoming-common-resistance",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Even with best practices in place, resistance is normal. Here are some strategies for common objections:"}),"
",i(r.table,{children:[n(r.thead,{children:i(r.tr,{children:[n(r.th,{children:"Objection"}),n(r.th,{children:"Response"})]})}),i(r.tbody,{children:[i(r.tr,{children:[n(r.td,{children:'"It's too complicated"'}),n(r.td,{children:"Focus on simple, high-value use cases first. Emphasize support, not surveillance."})]})]})]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"integrating-ar-change-management-with-broader-initiatives",children:["Integrating AR change management with broader initiatives",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#integrating-ar-change-management-with-broader-initiatives",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"AR projects don't exist in isolation. Align your change management approach with broader digital transformation, lean, or continuous improvement initiatives. This helps reinforce the message and ensures AR is seen as part of a larger strategy—not a standalone experiment."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"next-steps",children:["Next steps",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#next-steps",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["Effective change management is the difference between a successful AR rollout and a stalled pilot. ",i(r.p,{children:["Ready to discuss change management for your AR project? ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"Contact the ActARion team"})," or explore our ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/use-cases",children:"use cases"})," to see how other organizations have driven successful AR adoption."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"comparing-solutions-what-to-look-for-when-selecting-an-ar-knowledge-platform",children:["Comparing solutions: what to look for when selecting an AR knowledge platform",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#comparing-solutions-what-to-look-for-when-selecting-an-ar-knowledge-platform",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) knowledge platforms are changing how industrial teams work. For operations managers, HSE leaders, maintenance leads, and L&D professionals, the right AR solution can mean the difference between safe, compliant, and high-performing operations—or costly mistakes and downtime. But with a crowded market, comparing solutions and making the right choice is not straightforward."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This article breaks down what matters most when selecting an AR knowledge platform for industrial use. It covers the practical criteria, must-have features, and concrete steps to ensure your investment delivers measurable improvements in safety, productivity, and workforce readiness."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial environments face increasing complexity and pressure. Assets are more advanced, compliance demands are stricter, and skilled personnel are harder to find. At the same time, unplanned downtime, procedural errors, and safety incidents remain constant threats."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Traditional paper SOPs and static digital documents are not enough. Teams need just-in-time, context-aware guidance—especially for critical inspections, maintenance, and onboarding. AR knowledge platforms, which combine digital work instructions, AI-driven guidance, and real-time data, respond directly to these needs."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"current-challenges-driving-ar-adoption",children:["Current challenges driving AR adoption",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#current-challenges-driving-ar-adoption",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Demands for consistent quality and uptime across distributed teams"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A 2023 McKinsey report found that digital work instructions and AR SOPs can reduce error rates by up to 50% and cut training time by 30–40% in industrial settings (). But real results depend on selecting a platform that fits your operational reality."}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Low adoption among teams"}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Missed productivity and safety targets"}),"
"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"The best AR knowledge platforms do more than overlay instructions—they integrate with your workflows, adapt to your teams, and support measurable operational improvements. Use the following criteria to compare solutions:"}),"

",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Flexible authoring:"})," Can your subject matter experts create and update AR SOPs and digital work instructions without coding?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Content governance:"})," Does the platform support version control, approval workflows, and audit trails?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Media support:"})," Can you combine 3D models, video, step-by-step text, and IoT data in your instructions?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A robust platform should make it easy to digitize inspections, maintenance routines, and onboarding processes—while ensuring content quality and compliance."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"2-usability-for-technicians-and-operators",children:["2. Usability for technicians and operators",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-usability-for-technicians-and-operators",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Device compatibility:"})," Does the solution work on the hardware your teams use (smartphones, tablets, AR headsets)?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"User experience:"})," Are instructions clear, hands-free when needed, and accessible in noisy or hazardous environments?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Offline access:"})," Can teams use the platform reliably in areas with limited connectivity?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"User adoption is critical. Platforms that are hard to use or require expensive, specialized hardware often fail to scale beyond pilot projects."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"3-integration-with-existing-systems",children:["3. Integration with existing systems",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-integration-with-existing-systems",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"ERP, EAM, and MES integration:"})," Can the platform connect with your maintenance, asset management, or learning management systems?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Single sign-on and user management:"})," Does it support your IT security and identity protocols?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data export and analytics:"})," Can you easily extract usage, compliance, and performance data?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Integration ensures that AR work instructions become part of daily operations rather than a siloed tool."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"4-ai-driven-guidance-and-analytics",children:["4. AI-driven guidance and analytics",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-ai-driven-guidance-and-analytics",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Context-aware assistance:"})," Does the platform use AI to recommend next steps, detect errors, or adapt instructions in real time?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Performance tracking:"})," Can you measure completion rates, error types, and time-on-task?"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Continuous improvement:"})," Is there support for feedback loops, so instructions can be refined based on real-world use?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions should deliver smarter, not just digital, support."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"5-security-compliance-and-scalability",children:["5. Security, compliance, and scalability",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-security-compliance-and-scalability",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",i(a.ul,{children:["

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Ongoing support:"})," Is help available when you need it—locally and in your language?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A platform is only as good as the support and expertise behind it."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"key-use-cases-and-operational-impact",children:["Key use cases and operational impact",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-use-cases-and-operational-impact",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial teams use AR knowledge platforms to improve safety, productivity, and training in several high-impact areas:"}),"

",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Field engineers can connect with remote experts, who see what they see and guide them in real time."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Complex troubleshooting is faster, reducing downtime and travel costs."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"quality-assurance-and-compliance",children:["Quality assurance and compliance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#quality-assurance-and-compliance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Every step is documented, with photos, videos, or sensor data as proof of execution."}),"

"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["

"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-to-structure-an-effective-comparison-process",children:["How to structure an effective comparison process",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-structure-an-effective-comparison-process",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A structured evaluation process helps avoid common pitfalls and ensures the chosen AR knowledge platform delivers results:"}),"
",i(a.ol,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Define your objectives:"})," Identify the processes (e.g., inspections, maintenance, onboarding) where AR SOPs would have the most impact."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Engage stakeholders early:"})," Include IT, HSE, operations, and training leads in requirements gathering."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Pilot with real workflows:"})," Test shortlisted platforms in real use cases—not just vendor demos."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Evaluate content creation:"})," Have your subject matter experts create or update digital work instructions to test ease of use."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Check integration and security:"})," Validate how the platform fits with your IT landscape and compliance needs."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Assess support and roadmap:"})," Interview vendors about their industrial experience, support structure, and product roadmap."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Document findings using a clear scorecard or checklist. Focus on operational impact, not just features."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"addressing-common-objections-and-limitations",children:["Addressing common objections and limitations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-common-objections-and-limitations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Implementing AR knowledge platforms in industrial settings does present challenges. Decision makers should be aware of:"}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Data privacy:"})," Ensure the platform meets your industry’s data governance requirements."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Vendors should be transparent about these challenges and provide strategies to address them."}),"

title: Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz beim Bereitstellen von AR und KI in Operationen
description: Erfahren Sie, wie Sie Cybersicherheits- und Datenschutz-Herausforderungen beim Implementieren von AR und KI in industriellen Operationen adressieren. Für Operations-, HSE- und IT-Leiter.

image.alt: Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz beim Bereitstellen von AR und KI in Operationen

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-beim-bereitstellen-von-ar-und-ki-in-operationen",children:["Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz beim Bereitstellen von AR und KI in Operationen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-beim-bereitstellen-von-ar-und-ki-in-operationen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented Reality (AR) und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) transformieren industrielle Operationen. Unternehmen verwenden AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen, um Inspektionen zu digitalisieren, Verfahren zu standardisieren und Schulungen zu beschleunigen. Aber während diese Tools Geräte, Daten und Teams verbinden, entstehen neue Risiken rund um Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz. Für Operations-, HSE- und IT-Leiter ist die Gewährleistung, dass AR- und KI-Bereitstellungen sicher sind, jetzt ein nicht verhandelbarer Teil der digitalen Transformation."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"steigende-adoption-von-ar-und-ki-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:["Steigende Adoption von AR und KI in industriellen Umgebungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#steigende-adoption-von-ar-und-ki-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Organisationen stehen unter Druck, Produktivität zu optimieren, hohe Sicherheitsstandards aufrechtzuerhalten und Wissen effizient zu übertragen. AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen adressieren diese Bedürfnisse:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Feldingenieure verwenden AR-Headsets, um digitale SOPs handenfreie zu befolgen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Wartungsleiter nutzen KI, um Anomalien während Inspektionen zu markieren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Trainingsmanager beschleunigen Onboarding mit interaktiver, Echtzeit-Anleitung."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Laut PwC planen über 70% der Industrieunternehmen, ihre Investitionen in KI bis 2025 zu erhöhen. Die AR-Adoption beschleunigt sich auch, da Hardware praktischer wird und Content-Erstellungstools reifen."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Aber während diese Technologien von Piloten zu Produktion wechseln, erweitert sich die Angriffsfläche. Geräte mit Kameras und Mikrofonen, cloud-verbundene Analytics und Echtzeit-Datenaustausch stellen alle neue Einstiegspunkte für Cyber-Bedrohungen und Datenschutzverletzungen dar."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-dringende-aufmerksamkeit-erfordern",children:["Warum Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz dringende Aufmerksamkeit erfordern",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-cybersicherheit-und-datenschutz-dringende-aufmerksamkeit-erfordern",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Operationen handhaben sensible Informationen: Produktionsparameter, Ausrüstungsstatus, Sicherheitsvorfälle und manchmal personenbezogene Daten über Techniker. Wenn AR- und KI-Plattformen eingeführt werden, werden die folgenden Risiken dringender:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Unbefugter Zugang:"})," AR-Geräte und verbundene Plattformen können für Credential-Diebstahl oder unbefugte Zugriffsversuche ins Visier genommen werden."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datenabfangen:"})," Echtzeit-Video, Sensordaten und Arbeitsprotokolle, die über Netzwerke übertragen werden, können abgefangen werden, wenn nicht ordnungsgemäß verschlüsselt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datenschutzverletzungen:"})," Geräte sammeln oft Audio-, Video- und Standortdaten, die GDPR oder anderen Datenschutzbestimmungen unterliegen können."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Malware und Ransomware:"})," KI-Algorithmen und AR-Geräte sind potenzielle Vektoren für Malware, wenn nicht gesichert und regelmäßig aktualisiert."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Verlust der operativen Integrität:"})," Kompromittierte digitale Arbeitsanweisungen können zu unsicheren Verfahren oder Qualitätslücken führen."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Ein ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.sans.org/white-papers/industrial-cybersecurity-2023-survey/",children:"SANS-Bericht von 2023"})," ergab, dass 40% der Industrieorganisationen im vergangenen Jahr ein Cybersicherheitsvorfall erlebten, der operative Technologie (OT) betraf. Die Kosten einer Verletzung gehen über Ausfallzeiten hinaus—regulatorische Bußgelder, Reputationsschäden und Verlust geistigen Eigentums sind echte Risiken."]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-ar--und-ki-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-neue-sicherheitsherausforderungen-einführen",children:["Wie AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen neue Sicherheitsherausforderungen einführen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ar--und-ki-gestützte-arbeitsanweisungen-neue-sicherheitsherausforderungen-einführen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionelle IT- und OT-Systeme in industriellen Umgebungen sind oft isoliert, mit klaren Grenzen und Kontrollen. AR und KI ändern dies auf mehrere Weise:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Geräteproliferation:"})," AR-Headsets, Tablets und Mobilgeräte vervielfachen die Anzahl der Endpunkte, die Schutz benötigen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Cloud-Konnektivität:"})," Viele AR- und KI-Plattformen verlassen sich auf cloud-basierte Analytics und Speicherung, werfen Fragen zur Datenresidenz und Zugang Dritter auf."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Benutzergenerierte Inhalte:"})," Teams können Fotos, Videos oder Notizen zu digitalen Arbeitsanweisungen hochladen, erhöhen das Volumen und die Sensibilität gespeicherter Daten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Integrationskomplexität:"})," Das Verbinden von AR-SOPs mit Legacy-Systemen, Asset-Datenbanken oder ERP-Tools führt Integrationspunkte ein, die auch gesichert werden müssen."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Jede neue Schnittstelle oder Integration ist eine potenzielle Schwachstelle. Ohne robuste Governance können diese Risiken schnell die Vorteile der Digitalisierung überholen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"schlüsselanforderungen-für-sichere-und-konforme-ar--und-ki-bereitstellungen",children:["Schlüsselanforderungen für sichere und konforme AR- und KI-Bereitstellungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schlüsselanforderungen-für-sichere-und-konforme-ar--und-ki-bereitstellungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Operations- und IT-Leiter müssen zusammenarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass AR- und KI-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen strenge Sicherheits- und Datenschutzstandards erfüllen. Schlüsselanforderungen umfassen:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"geräte--und-netzwerksicherheit",children:["Geräte- und Netzwerksicherheit",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#geräte--und-netzwerksicherheit",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Erfordern Sie starke Authentifizierung (z.B. Multi-Faktor-Authentifizierung) für alle AR- und KI-Geräte."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Erzwingen Sie regelmäßige Software-Updates und Geräte-Patching."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Verwenden Sie sicheres Wi-Fi, VPN oder private 5G-Netzwerke für On-Site-Konnektivität."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Segmentieren Sie AR- und KI-Verkehr von kritischen OT-Netzwerken, wo möglich."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"datenschutz-und-datenschutz",children:["Datenschutz und Datenschutz",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#datenschutz-und-datenschutz",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Verschlüsseln Sie alle Daten im Ruhezustand und während der Übertragung, besonders Video, Audio und Sensor-Streams."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Speichern Sie sensible Daten in sicheren, konformen Cloud-Umgebungen oder vor Ort nach Bedarf."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Implementieren Sie Zugriffskontrollen und Audit-Protokolle, um zu verfolgen, wer auf digitale Arbeitsanweisungen zugegriffen oder sie geändert hat."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Minimieren Sie Datenerfassung auf das, was für Operationen oder Compliance notwendig ist."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Anonymisieren oder pseudonymisieren Sie personenbezogene Daten, wo möglich."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"governance-und-compliance",children:["Governance und Compliance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#governance-und-compliance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Mappen Sie Datenflüsse und Speicherorte für alle AR- und KI-fähigen Prozesse."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Ein europäischer Chemiehersteller stattet Operatoren mit AR-Brillen aus, um tägliche Sicherheitsinspektionen durchzuführen. ",i(t.h3,{id:"remote-unterstützung-mit-strengen-zugriffskontrollen",children:["Remote-Unterstützung mit strengen Zugriffskontrollen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#remote-unterstützung-mit-strengen-zugriffskontrollen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ein Wartungsleiter im Energiesektor verwendet AR, um Feldingenieure mit Remote-Experten zu verbinden. ",n(t.p,{children:"In jedem Fall sind robuste Cybersicherheits- und Datenschutzmaßnahmen sowohl in den Technologie-Stack als auch in die Betriebsverfahren eingebaut."}),"

"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Wie stellen wir GDPR- oder CCPA-Compliance sicher?"'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Dataminimierung, transparente Einwilligungsprozesse und klare Datenfluss-Mapping sind wesentlich. Wählen Sie Anbieter mit starken Erfolgsbilanz in industrieller Compliance."]}),"

",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Was ist mit von Technikern erstellten Inhalten?"'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Implementieren Sie automatische Content-Klassifizierung, Zugriffskontrollen und Aufbewahrungsrichtlinien für benutzergenerierte Fotos, Videos und Notizen."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Sind AR-Geräte selbst ein schwaches Glied?"'}),n(t.br,{}),"

"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:'"Change Management ist eine Herausforderung."'}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Beziehen Sie IT-, Operations- und HSE-Teams früh ein. Bieten Sie gezielte Schulungen und klare Eskalationswege für Sicherheitsvorfälle."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"was-actarion-zu-sicherer-ar--und-ki-bereitstellung-beiträgt",children:["Was ActARion zu sicherer AR- und KI-Bereitstellung beiträgt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-actarion-zu-sicherer-ar--und-ki-bereitstellung-beiträgt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion arbeitet mit Industrieorganisationen zusammen, um KI- und AR-gestützte Arbeitsanweisungen zu liefern, die den höchsten Standards für Cybersicherheit und Datenschutz entsprechen. Unser Ansatz umfasst:"}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung:"})," Alle Daten, vom Gerät bis zur Cloud, werden mit Industriestandards verschlüsselt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Rollenbasierte Zugriffskontrollen:"})," Nur autorisiertes Personal kann digitale Arbeitsanweisungen und zugehörige Daten erstellen, bearbeiten oder überprüfen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Umfassende Audit-Trails:"})," Jeder Zugriff und jede Änderung wird für Compliance und forensische Analyse protokolliert."]}),"

",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Datenschutz durch Design:"})," Personenbezogene Daten werden minimiert, anonymisiert oder ausgeschlossen, wo möglich; Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen sind Standard."]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Die Sicherung von AR- und KI-gestützten Arbeitsanweisungen ist wesentlich für sichere, produktive und konforme industrielle Operationen. title: Cybersecurity en gegevensprivacy bij het deployen van AR en AI in operaties
description: Leer hoe cybersecurity- en gegevensprivacy-uitdagingen aan te pakken bij het implementeren van AR en AI in industriële operaties. Voor operations-, HSE- en IT-leiders.
