const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"hoe-een-interne-ar-contentfabriek-opzetten-met-vakexperts",children:["Hoe een interne AR-contentfabriek opzetten met vakexperts",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-een-interne-ar-contentfabriek-opzetten-met-vakexperts",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Het opzetten van een interne AR-contentfabriek met uw vakexperts is een van de meest effectieve manieren om hoogwaardige, actuele digitale werkvoorschriften op schaal te leveren. Voor operations-, HSE- en L&D-leiders maakt deze aanpak veiliger, sneller en consistenter werk mogelijk terwijl kritieke know-how binnen uw organisatie blijft."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-industriële-bedrijven-nu-een-ar-contentfabriek-nodig-hebben",children:["Waarom industriële bedrijven nu een AR-contentfabriek nodig hebben",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-industriële-bedrijven-nu-een-ar-contentfabriek-nodig-hebben",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële organisaties staan onder druk om productiviteits-, kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen te handhaven terwijl senior medewerkers met pensioen gaan en nieuwe technologieën opkomen. Veel teams vertrouwen nog steeds op papieren SOPs of verspreide digitale documenten. Deze aanpakken slagen er vaak niet in om expertkennis vast te leggen of snel aan te passen aan verandering."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Belangrijke drijfveren die AR-contentcreatie urgent maken:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Vergrijzende beroepsbevolking:"})," Naarmate ervaren technici met pensioen gaan, is het vastleggen van hun expertise bedrijfskritisch."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Complexiteit:"})," Apparatuur, regelgeving en processen zijn complexer dan ooit."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote en gedistribueerde teams:"})," Consistente training en begeleiding zijn moeilijker te leveren."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Veiligheid en compliance:"})," Onvolledige of verouderde instructies verhogen risico en regelgevingsblootstelling."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Continue verbetering:"})," Feedbackloops zijn traag wanneer documentatie statisch is."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionele training- en documentatiemodellen zijn te traag en inflexibel voor het huidige tempo. AR en AI-geleide werkvoorschriften bieden een manier om expertkennis direct naar de plaats van behoefte te brengen, maar alleen als u content efficiënt kunt creëren en bijwerken."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"de-uitdaging-expertkennis-vastleggen-en-schalen",children:["De uitdaging: expertkennis vastleggen en schalen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#de-uitdaging-expertkennis-vastleggen-en-schalen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Het bouwen van een gestage pijplijn van digitale werkvoorschriften met AR-platforms vereist twee dingen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Toegang tot echte vakexperts (SMEs) die uw processen door en door kennen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Een herhaalbare, beheersbare manier om hun kennis vast te leggen, te valideren en bij te werken."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veel bedrijven worstelen met:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Bottlenecks:"})," Slechts een paar mensen kunnen AR-content creëren; IT of externe leveranciers zijn overbelast."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Kwaliteitshiaten:"})," SMEs zijn niet getraind in instructieontwerp of AR-tools."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Governance:"})," Geen duidelijk proces voor het reviewen, bijwerken en buiten gebruik stellen van werkvoorschriften."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Teams zijn onzeker hoe nieuwe methoden naast bestaande SOPs te adopteren."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:'Om deze uitdagingen aan te pakken, zetten toonaangevende organisaties interne "AR-contentfabrieken" op—toegewijde, cross-functionele teams en processen om SME-kennis om te zetten in bruikbare, schaalbare AR SOPs en digitale werkvoorschriften.'}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wat-is-een-interne-ar-contentfabriek",children:["Wat is een interne AR-contentfabriek?",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wat-is-een-interne-ar-contentfabriek",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Een AR-contentfabriek is een interne capaciteit die uw organisatie in staat stelt om:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Snel taakkennis van SMEs vast te leggen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Het om te zetten in gestructureerde, AR-klare digitale werkvoorschriften."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Content te valideren, uit te rollen en bij te werken naarmate processen evolueren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Governance, kwaliteit en compliance bij elke stap te waarborgen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:'Het contentfabriekmodel leent van productie: gestandaardiseerde workflows, duidelijke rollen en een focus op herhaalbare kwaliteit. Het verschil is dat het "product" bruikbare kennis is, geen fysiek onderdeel.'}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Belangrijke elementen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"SME-betrokkenheid:"})," Operators, technici, ingenieurs en proceseigenaren dragen kennis bij."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Contentproducenten:"})," Teamleden getraind in het gebruik van AR-authoringtools en instructieontwerp principes."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Review en governance:"})," QA, HSE en operations-leiders reviewen en keuren content goed."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedbackloops:"})," Continue updates op basis van gebruikersfeedback en procesveranderingen."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Deze aanpak schaalt AR SOPs en AI-geleide instructies ver voorbij wat een centraal documentatie- of trainingsteam alleen zou kunnen produceren."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"hoe-een-ar-contentfabriek-in-de-praktijk-werkt",children:["Hoe een AR-contentfabriek in de praktijk werkt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-een-ar-contentfabriek-in-de-praktijk-werkt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",code:"code",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",pre:"pre",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h1,{id:"how-to-set-up-an-internal-ar-content-factory-with-subject-matter-experts",children:["How to set up an internal AR content factory with subject matter experts",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-set-up-an-internal-ar-content-factory-with-subject-matter-experts",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Setting up an internal AR content factory with your subject matter experts is one of the most effective ways to deliver high-quality, up-to-date digital work instructions at scale. For operations, HSE, and L&D leaders, this approach enables safer, faster, and more consistent work while retaining critical know-how inside your organization."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-industrial-companies-need-an-ar-content-factory-now",children:["Why industrial companies need an AR content factory now",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-industrial-companies-need-an-ar-content-factory-now",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial organizations face pressure to maintain productivity, quality, and safety standards as senior staff retire and new technologies emerge. Many teams still rely on paper-based SOPs or scattered digital documents. These approaches often fail to capture expert knowledge or adapt quickly to change."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Key drivers making AR content creation urgent:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Aging workforce:"})," As experienced technicians retire, capturing their expertise is business-critical."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Complexity:"})," Equipment, regulations, and processes are more complex than ever."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote and distributed teams:"})," Consistent training and guidance are harder to deliver."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Safety and compliance:"})," Incomplete or outdated instructions increase risk and regulatory exposure."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Continuous improvement:"})," Feedback loops are slow when documentation is static."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditional training and documentation models are too slow and inflexible for today’s pace. AR and AI–guided work instructions offer a way to bring expert knowledge directly to the point of need, but only if you can create and update content efficiently."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"the-challenge-capturing-and-scaling-expert-knowledge",children:["The challenge: capturing and scaling expert knowledge",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-challenge-capturing-and-scaling-expert-knowledge",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Building a steady pipeline of digital work instructions using AR platforms requires two things:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Access to real subject matter experts (SMEs) who know your processes inside out."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"A repeatable, manageable way to capture, validate, and update their knowledge."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many companies struggle with:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Bottlenecks:"})," Only a few people can create AR content; IT or external vendors are overloaded."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Quality gaps:"})," SMEs are not trained in instructional design or AR tools."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Governance:"})," No clear process for reviewing, updating, and retiring work instructions."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Teams are unsure how to adopt new methods alongside existing SOPs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"To address these challenges, leading organizations are setting up internal “AR content factories”—dedicated, cross-functional teams and processes to turn SME know-how into usable, scalable AR SOPs and digital work instructions."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"what-is-an-internal-ar-content-factory",children:["What is an internal AR content factory?",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-is-an-internal-ar-content-factory",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"An AR content factory is an internal capability that enables your organization to:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Rapidly capture task knowledge from SMEs."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Convert it into structured, AR–ready digital work instructions."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Validate, deploy, and update content as processes evolve."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ensure governance, quality, and compliance at every step."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The content factory model borrows from manufacturing: standardized workflows, clear roles, and a focus on repeatable quality. The difference is the “product” is actionable knowledge, not a physical part."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Key elements:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"SME engagement:"})," Operators, technicians, engineers, and process owners contribute knowledge."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content producers:"})," Team members trained to use AR authoring tools and instructional design principles."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Review and governance:"})," QA, HSE, and operations leaders review and approve content."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedback loops:"})," Continuous updates based on user feedback and process changes."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This approach scales AR SOPs and AI–guided instructions far beyond what a central documentation or training team could produce alone."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"how-an-ar-content-factory-works-in-practice",children:["How an AR content factory works in practice",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-an-ar-content-factory-works-in-practice",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Setting up an AR content factory is a change process. It involves new roles, workflows, and technology. Here is a practical breakdown of the major steps:"}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"1-define-scope-and-objectives",children:["1. Define scope and objectives",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-define-scope-and-objectives",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Start by identifying where AR and digital work instructions will have the highest impact. Common areas include:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Safety-critical maintenance tasks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Equipment changeovers and setups"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Quality inspections and audits"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Onboarding and upskilling for new team members"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Set clear goals, such as reducing errors, improving compliance, or accelerating onboarding."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"2-build-your-cross-functional-team",children:["2. Build your cross-functional team",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-build-your-cross-functional-team",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A successful AR content factory brings together:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Subject matter experts:"})," Field engineers, operators, maintenance leads, QA and HSE specialists."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content producers:"})," L&D or technical writers trained in AR authoring."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reviewers:"})," Supervisors, safety officers, and process owners for governance."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"IT and platform support:"})," To ensure tool access and integration."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Keep the team lean but representative. For most organizations, a core group of 5–10 is enough to start."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"3-select-the-right-ar-authoring-tools",children:["3. Select the right AR authoring tools",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-select-the-right-ar-authoring-tools",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Choose a platform that:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Allows non-technical users to capture and structure procedures visually (e.g., via guided video, step-by-step overlays, voice annotations)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supports AI-driven suggestions for content structure and translation."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integrates with your learning or asset management systems."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Enables easy content updates and version control."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The right tool should empower SMEs to contribute directly, not just content specialists."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Create templates for different task types to ensure consistency."}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Reviewing and updating content"}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Pair less experienced contributors with mentors to accelerate learning."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Define who owns each type of content and how updates are managed. Key governance measures:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Version control for all AR SOPs and digital work instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Scheduled reviews (e.g., every 6–12 months)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Clear criteria for retiring or archiving outdated content"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Audit trails for compliance"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Assign responsibility for monitoring usage data and feedback."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"7-pilot-measure-and-scale",children:["7. Pilot, measure, and scale",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#7-pilot-measure-and-scale",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Start with a focused pilot in one department or process. Measure:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Time to create and deploy new AR SOPs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Reduction in errors, incidents, or rework"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"User adoption and satisfaction"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Impact on onboarding speed"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Use results to refine your process and build support for wider rollout."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"use-cases-where-ar-content-factories-deliver-results",children:["Use cases: where AR content factories deliver results",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-where-ar-content-factories-deliver-results",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial organizations have seen measurable benefits from internal AR content factories in areas such as:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Maintenance and repair:"})," Technicians follow AR–guided steps, reducing training time by up to 40% and cutting errors (Siemens, 2022)."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Safety procedures:"})," AR SOPs ensure consistent lockout/tagout and permit-to-work compliance, lowering incident rates."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Quality inspections:"})," Operators conduct step-by-step visual checks, with real-time data capture and reporting."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Onboarding:"})," New team members ramp up faster, using digital instructions created by experienced colleagues."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Process change:"})," Rapid updates to AR content help teams adapt to new equipment or regulatory changes."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.blockquote,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Note:"})," For further reading on AR SOPs in maintenance, see ",n(t.a,{href:"/use-cases/maintenance-ar-sops",children:"digital work instructions for maintenance teams"}),"."]}),"

",r(t.h2,{id:"overcoming-common-challenges",children:["Overcoming common challenges",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#overcoming-common-challenges",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Change management is essential. Regular communication, clear roles, and visible leadership support are critical to success."}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Bediener, die sich auf veraltete Papier-SOPs oder statische PDFs verlassen."}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Schwierigkeit, Compliance, Schulungsfortschritt oder Ursachen von Ausfallzeiten zu verfolgen."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Daher kämpfen Teams, selbst mit robusten MES-, ERP- oder CMMS-Systemen, mit inkonsistenter Ausführung, vermeidbaren Fehlern und verpassten Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten."}),"

const{Fragment:n,jsx:e,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(n,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"integrating-ar-work-instructions-with-mes-erp-or-cmms-systems-for-safer-smarter-operations",children:["Integrating AR work instructions with MES, ERP or CMMS systems for safer, smarter operations",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#integrating-ar-work-instructions-with-mes-erp-or-cmms-systems-for-safer-smarter-operations",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Modern industrial operations depend on tightly connected digital processes. Integrating AR work instructions with MES, ERP or CMMS systems is now essential for organisations seeking measurable gains in productivity, quality, and safety. For operations managers, HSE leads, and maintenance heads, this integration enables teams to follow up-to-date, context-aware guidance—while capturing real-time data to drive better decisions."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-integration-matters-now-context-and-challenges",children:["Why integration matters now: context and challenges",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-integration-matters-now-context-and-challenges",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Industrial environments are facing increased pressure to deliver safer, more efficient, and higher quality outcomes, often with leaner teams and more complex assets. Many organisations have invested in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage production, resources, and maintenance. Yet, gaps remain between digital planning and what happens on the shop floor."}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Common pain points include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",e(t.li,{children:"Operators relying on outdated paper SOPs or static PDFs."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Delays in communicating process changes to the field."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Incomplete, error-prone data capture during inspections or maintenance."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Difficulty tracking compliance, training progress, or root causes of downtime."}),"
"]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"As a result, even with robust MES, ERP or CMMS systems in place, teams struggle with inconsistent execution, avoidable errors, and missed improvement opportunities."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-change-is-needed-now",children:["Why change is needed now",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-change-is-needed-now",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Several factors are making this integration urgent:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"More frequent process changes:"})," Agile manufacturing and regulatory updates require faster SOP updates."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Aging workforce:"})," Critical know-how is at risk as experienced technicians retire."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Higher compliance and reporting demands:"})," Audits and certifications require traceable, real-time data."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Digital transformation goals:"})," Leadership is under pressure to prove ROI from digital investments."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Without closing the gap between digital systems and frontline execution, investments in MES, ERP or CMMS deliver limited value. Teams need actionable, up-to-date guidance—delivered directly where work happens and linked back to core systems."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-ar-work-instructions-connect-with-mes-erp-and-cmms",children:["How AR work instructions connect with MES, ERP and CMMS",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-work-instructions-connect-with-mes-erp-and-cmms",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"AR work instructions, sometimes called AR SOPs or AI and AR–guided work instructions, provide step-by-step, visual guidance through smart glasses, tablets, or mobile devices. When integrated with MES, ERP or CMMS, they enable a closed feedback loop between planning, execution, and continuous improvement."}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Key integration points include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Automatic job dispatch:"})," Work orders or tasks from MES/CMMS trigger relevant AR work instructions on the technician’s device."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Context-aware guidance:"})," The AR system pulls asset data, work history, and safety information from ERP/CMMS for precise, tailored instructions."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Real-time validation:"})," Completion data, measurements, photos, or compliance checks are sent back to MES/ERP/CMMS instantly."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Analytics and traceability:"})," All actions are logged, enabling performance tracking, training analysis, and audit readiness."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"This integration transforms digital work instructions from static documents to dynamic, data-driven tools that boost both compliance and productivity."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"use-cases-ar-work-instructions-integrated-with-mes-erp-or-cmms",children:["Use cases: AR work instructions integrated with MES, ERP or CMMS",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-ar-work-instructions-integrated-with-mes-erp-or-cmms",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Integrating AR work instructions with core systems creates value across multiple industrial scenarios:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"maintenance-and-inspections",children:["Maintenance and inspections",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#maintenance-and-inspections",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Automated work order execution:"})," A technician receives a preventive maintenance order from the CMMS. AR-guided instructions walk them through each step, pulling the latest asset data and safety procedures. As tasks are completed, results are logged automatically in the CMMS."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Condition-based inspections:"})," MES triggers an inspection based on sensor data. AR instructions guide the operator, ensuring the correct checks are performed and findings are captured in real time."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"production-and-quality-operations",children:["Production and quality operations",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#production-and-quality-operations",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Changeover procedures:"})," ERP schedules a product changeover. AR work instructions ensure operators follow the latest sequence, reducing setup times and errors. Completion is confirmed in the MES."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"In-process quality checks:"})," Operators receive digital work instructions for quality checks at specific production stages. Results and photos are submitted directly to MES or ERP for traceability."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"safety-and-compliance-processes",children:["Safety and compliance processes",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#safety-and-compliance-processes",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Lockout/tagout (LOTO):"})," When maintenance is scheduled, AR SOPs guide the technician through LOTO steps, referencing equipment data from the CMMS. Compliance is documented with time-stamped evidence."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Incident response:"})," In the event of a safety incident, AR work instructions provide just-in-time guidance, while all actions are recorded for later review and compliance."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"training-and-onboarding",children:["Training and onboarding",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-and-onboarding",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Role-based onboarding:"})," New technicians receive tailored AR SOPs for their first assignments, with progress and competency tracked in the L&D or HR module of the ERP."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"On-the-job upskilling:"})," Operators access AR-guided procedures for new equipment, with completion and assessment data fed back to HR or training systems."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"results-and-measurable-impact",children:["Results and measurable impact",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-and-measurable-impact",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Organisations integrating AR work instructions with MES, ERP or CMMS report tangible improvements:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Reduced errors and rework:"})," Standardised, up-to-date instructions cut avoidable mistakes by 30–60% (see ",e(t.a,{href:"https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/focus/industry-4-0/augmented-reality-industrial-manufacturing.html",children:"Deloitte, 2022"}),")."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Faster onboarding:"})," New hires reach proficiency up to 40% faster with AR-guided, system-connected SOPs."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Higher compliance rates:"})," Automatic logging of completed steps and evidence raises audit pass rates and reduces non-conformance events."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Better resource utilisation:"})," Real-time feedback helps planners adjust schedules and inventory, improving OEE and reducing downtime."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[e(t.strong,{children:"Continuous improvement:"})," Captured execution data supports root cause analysis and ongoing SOP optimisation."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"These results are supported by both industry research and ActARion client case studies, which show measurable gains in safety, productivity, and quality."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"addressing-common-concerns-integration-hardware-and-change-management",children:["Addressing common concerns: integration, hardware and change management",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-common-concerns-integration-hardware-and-change-management",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Decision makers often raise valid concerns about integrating AR work instructions with MES, ERP or CMMS systems:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"technical-integration",children:["Technical integration",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#technical-integration",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Integration can be achieved through open APIs, middleware, or connectors that bridge AR platforms and existing systems. It’s important to:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",e(t.li,{children:"Map data flows and user roles."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Ensure secure, compliant data exchange."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Pilot with a single process or asset, then scale."}),"
"]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"ActARion works with IT and OT teams to ensure robust, secure integration—regardless of system vendor."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"hardware-and-usability",children:["Hardware and usability",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hardware-and-usability",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"AR work instructions run on smart glasses, tablets, or ruggedised mobile devices. Key factors for deployment include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",e(t.li,{children:"Device compatibility with existing IT security policies."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Ergonomics for long shifts or hazardous environments."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Offline capability for sites with limited connectivity."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"content-creation-and-governance",children:["Content creation and governance",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#content-creation-and-governance",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Digitising SOPs for AR and integrating them with MES/ERP/CMMS requires structured content. Best practices include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",e(t.li,{children:"Starting with high-impact, high-frequency procedures."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Using modular templates for faster updates."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Involving process owners and HSE/QA experts in validation."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Setting up version control and approval workflows."}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"change-management-and-workforce-adoption",children:["Change management and workforce adoption",e(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#change-management-and-workforce-adoption",children:e(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(t.p,{children:"Successful integration depends on:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",e(t.li,{children:"Training supervisors and technicians on new workflows."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Communicating the “why” and benefits early."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Providing ongoing support and feedback channels."}),"
",e(t.li,{children:"Tracking adoption metrics and celebrating quick wins."}),"
"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) is no longer just a pilot project in industrial environments. Operations managers, HSE leads, and training specialists are using AI and AR–guided work instructions to improve safety, quality, and productivity across manufacturing, logistics, and energy sectors. ",n(a.p,{children:"The pressure to maintain uptime, assure safety, and transfer skills efficiently is increasing. Many sectors face an ageing workforce, skills shortages, and stricter compliance demands. Traditional paper-based SOPs and manual training are not keeping pace."}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Remote work and distributed expertise"}),": Global operations require knowledge sharing across locations, often with limited on-site support."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Regulatory scrutiny"}),": Documentation and traceability requirements are rising, especially in safety-critical environments."]}),"
"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions overlay digital guidance directly onto the technician’s field of view—using smart glasses, tablets, or head-mounted displays. Combined with AI, these systems can:"}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Enable remote support"}),": Experts can see what the operator sees and provide live guidance."]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Branchen von der Fertigung bis hin zu Energie und Chemie stehen unter Druck, Sicherheit, Compliance und Mitarbeiterproduktivität zu verbessern. "]}),"

description: Industrial leaders: Should you prioritise mobile digital work instructions or AR-guided workflows? Compare approaches, benefits, and next steps for smarter operations.

",i(t.p,{children:"Industrial leaders face a critical decision: Should you digitise your standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions with a mobile-first approach, or invest directly in AI and AR–guided workflows? Understanding which starting point fits your organisation can set the pace for measurable improvements in operations."}),"

",i(t.p,{children:"Industries from manufacturing to energy and chemicals are under pressure to improve safety, compliance, and workforce productivity. Ageing workforces, increasing complexity, and evolving regulatory demands create a need for robust knowledge capture and transfer. Traditional paper-based SOPs and legacy systems often fall short—leading to errors, delays, and inconsistent outcomes."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"Digital work instructions, delivered via mobile devices or augmented reality (AR) headsets, address these challenges by:"}),"

",i(t.li,{children:"Standardising procedures and reducing human error"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Supporting real-time guidance and documentation"}),"

",i(t.li,{children:"Providing traceable compliance records"}),"
"]}),"

",i(t.p,{children:"Digital transformation is no longer optional for industrial operations. However, the speed and scope of change must balance risk, cost, and business continuity. ",i(t.p,{children:"Key trends driving this decision include:"}),"
",n(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:[i(t.strong,{children:"Workforce demographics:"})," Many industrial teams are managing knowledge transfer as experienced technicians retire or shift roles. Mobile and AR tools both support skills capture, but differ in usability and impact."]}),"
",n(t.li,{children:[i(t.strong,{children:"Regulatory requirements:"})," Increasing documentation and compliance demands push organisations to digitise SOPs and evidence execution."]}),"
",n(t.li,{children:[i(t.strong,{children:"Hardware maturity:"})," Mobile devices are ubiquitous and familiar, while AR headsets are rapidly advancing but may require more investment and training."]}),"

title: Role of partners: why implementation support makes or breaks AR adoption
description: Explore why expert implementation partners are critical for successful AR adoption in industrial environments. For operations, HSE, and training leaders.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"role-of-partners-why-implementation-support-makes-or-breaks-ar-adoption",children:["Role of partners: why implementation support makes or breaks AR adoption",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#role-of-partners-why-implementation-support-makes-or-breaks-ar-adoption",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) is steadily moving from pilot projects to daily operations in industrial environments. Yet, many companies still struggle to turn promising AR trials into measurable improvements in productivity, safety, and workforce readiness. The main keyword here is implementation support: the difference between failed pilots and successful AR adoption often comes down to the role of experienced partners."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-ar-adoption-is-challenging-for-industrial-teams",children:["Why AR adoption is challenging for industrial teams",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-ar-adoption-is-challenging-for-industrial-teams",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial companies face unique barriers when introducing new technologies like AR. Operations managers and HSE leads are under pressure to deliver results without disrupting critical processes or compromising safety. Training and L&D managers need to ensure that digital work instructions are accurate, up-to-date, and integrated into existing workflows."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common challenges include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Complex, high-stakes environments where downtime is costly"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Resistance to change from experienced technicians and operators"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integration with legacy systems and varied hardware"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"High expectations for safety, compliance, and quality"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Limited in-house expertise in AR content creation and deployment"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"While AR–guided work instructions and digital SOPs can address these issues, successful adoption requires much more than software installation. The implementation phase is where most projects succeed or fail."}),"

The most common reasons:"]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Insufficient change management"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Poor integration with existing processes"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Content that is outdated, incomplete, or hard to maintain"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lack of user buy-in and ongoing support"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Unclear ROI or business impact"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These failures waste time and budget, and can create skepticism about future digital transformation efforts. ",i(t.h2,{id:"why-implementation-support-is-critical-for-ar-adoption",children:["Why implementation support is critical for AR adoption",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-implementation-support-is-critical-for-ar-adoption",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Implementation support is not just about technical setup. It covers the full lifecycle from initial assessment to ongoing optimization. The right partner brings:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Process mapping and SOP digitization:"})," Translating complex procedures into clear, actionable AR-guided steps"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management expertise:"})," Helping teams adapt to new tools and workflows"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Integration know-how:"})," Connecting AR solutions with ERP, maintenance, and training systems"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content development:"})," Rapidly creating and updating digital work instructions that reflect real-world tasks"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"User training and support:"})," Building confidence and competence among technicians, operators, and supervisors"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Governance and compliance:"})," Ensuring every digital SOP meets regulatory and quality standards"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This end-to-end support is what turns a promising AR pilot into a sustainable operational improvement."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-partners-accelerate-ar-and-aiguided-work-instruction-success",children:["How partners accelerate AR and AI–guided work instruction success",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-partners-accelerate-ar-and-aiguided-work-instruction-success",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Experienced AR implementation partners understand the realities of industrial environments. They work closely with your teams to:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"assess-readiness-and-define-use-cases",children:["Assess readiness and define use cases",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#assess-readiness-and-define-use-cases",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A credible partner starts by mapping existing SOPs, identifying high-impact use cases, and aligning AR adoption with business priorities. For example:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Reducing downtime during complex machine changeovers"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Standardizing inspections and audits for safety-critical assets"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Accelerating onboarding for new technicians through AR SOPs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supporting remote maintenance with step-by-step digital instructions"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This upfront work ensures AR is deployed where it can deliver measurable ROI."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Many companies underestimate the effort required to create effective digital work instructions. Partners help by:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Interviewing subject matter experts"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Capturing tacit knowledge from experienced technicians"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Structuring content for AR delivery (text, images, video, 3D models)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Testing and iterating instructions in real work environments"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This results in AR SOPs that are accurate, usable, and easy to update as processes change."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"integrate-ar-solutions-with-existing-systems",children:["Integrate AR solutions with existing systems",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#integrate-ar-solutions-with-existing-systems",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Seamless integration is essential for adoption. Partners provide:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Technical integration with maintenance, quality, and training platforms"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Hardware selection and configuration (smart glasses, tablets, etc.)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"User authentication and access control"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Data capture and analytics for continuous improvement"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This reduces friction and ensures AR fits into your daily operations."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"train-users-and-drive-change",children:["Train users and drive change",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#train-users-and-drive-change",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Change management is a major barrier in industrial settings. Partners support successful rollout by:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Running train-the-trainer sessions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Providing on-site and remote support"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Creating feedback loops for continuous improvement"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Addressing objections and demonstrating quick wins"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Effective training builds trust and accelerates acceptance among technicians and operators."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"monitor-measure-and-optimize",children:["Monitor, measure, and optimize",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#monitor-measure-and-optimize",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Finally, partners help you track results and optimize over time:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Setting up KPIs for productivity, safety, and quality"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Analyzing usage data to identify bottlenecks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Updating digital work instructions based on feedback"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Scaling successful use cases to new sites or teams"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This ensures ongoing value and helps justify further investment in AR and AI–guided work instructions."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"real-world-results-what-successful-ar-implementation-looks-like",children:["Real-world results: what successful AR implementation looks like",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-results-what-successful-ar-implementation-looks-like",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"When AR is deployed with strong implementation support, the results are measurable and impactful. Examples from industrial sectors include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"30% reduction in error rates"})," during complex assembly processes after deploying AR SOPs"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Up to 40% faster onboarding"})," for new technicians using digital work instructions"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"25% fewer safety incidents"})," in maintenance operations where AR guides reinforce compliance"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Consistent audit readiness"})," as all procedures are documented, tracked, and updated centrally"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These outcomes are only possible when AR adoption is approached as an operational transformation—not just a technology project."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"addressing-common-concerns-from-hardware-to-change-management",children:["Addressing common concerns: from hardware to change management",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-common-concerns-from-hardware-to-change-management",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Decision makers often raise legitimate concerns about AR adoption:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hardware compatibility:"})," Partners help select, test, and configure devices suited to your environment (ATEX-certified, ruggedized, etc.)."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content creation workload:"})," Implementation support includes rapid SOP digitization and ongoing updates, reducing the burden on internal teams."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change resistance:"})," Structured training and clear communication address skepticism and demonstrate value early."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Integration complexity:"})," Experienced partners manage technical integration, so AR works seamlessly with existing systems."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Data security and compliance:"})," Governance frameworks ensure that digital work instructions meet all regulatory and data privacy requirements."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These are not trivial challenges, but they are manageable with the right support."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-as-your-ar-implementation-partner",children:["What ActARion brings as your AR implementation partner",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-as-your-ar-implementation-partner",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion specializes in helping industrial companies deploy AI and AR–guided work instructions at scale. We combine deep industry knowledge with proven implementation methods to deliver:"}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Our approach is collaborative and transparent. We work alongside your operations, HSE, and training leaders to deliver measurable improvements in productivity, safety, and workforce readiness."}),"

title: Sicherheit zuerst: AR nutzen zur Durchsetzung kritischer Prüfungen und Lockout-Tagout-Verfahren
description: Wie KI- und AR-geführte Arbeitsanweisungen Operations- und HSE-Leitern helfen, kritische Sicherheitsprüfungen und Lockout-Tagout-Verfahren durchzusetzen, Risiken zu reduzieren und Compliance zu verbessern.

image.alt: Sicherheit zuerst: AR nutzen zur Durchsetzung kritischer Prüfungen und Lockout-Tagout-Verfahren

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"sicherheit-zuerst-ar-nutzen-zur-durchsetzung-kritischer-prüfungen-und-lockout-tagout-verfahren",children:["Sicherheit zuerst: AR nutzen zur Durchsetzung kritischer Prüfungen und Lockout-Tagout-Verfahren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#sicherheit-zuerst-ar-nutzen-zur-durchsetzung-kritischer-prüfungen-und-lockout-tagout-verfahren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Sicherheit, Compliance und Betriebszeit bilden den Kern jeder industriellen Operation. Für Operations Manager, HSE-Verantwortliche und Wartungsleiter ist es nicht verhandelbar, sicherzustellen, dass kritische Prüfungen—insbesondere Lockout-Tagout-(LOTO-)Verfahren—buchstabengetreu befolgt werden. Dennoch können selbst bei etablierten SOPs menschliche Fehler, Wissenslücken und inkonsistente Dokumentation Teams und Anlagen gefährden. KI- und AR-geführte Arbeitsanweisungen bieten jetzt einen praktischen Weg, diese wesentlichen Sicherheitsschritte zu digitalisieren und durchzusetzen, direkt in der Werkshalle."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-kritische-sicherheitsprüfungen-und-lockout-tagout-noch-immer-scheitern",children:["Warum kritische Sicherheitsprüfungen und Lockout-Tagout noch immer scheitern",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-kritische-sicherheitsprüfungen-und-lockout-tagout-noch-immer-scheitern",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Trotz Jahrzehnten von Sicherheitsprogrammen und Investitionen in Schulung sind kritische Sicherheitsprüfungen und LOTO-Verfahren noch immer eine führende Ursache für Vorfälle in Fertigung, Versorgungsunternehmen und Prozessindustrien. Laut dem U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics gehört das Versagen bei der Kontrolle gefährlicher Energie (einschließlich LOTO-Verstöße) konsequent zu den am häufigsten zitierten OSHA-Verstößen, was zu Hunderten vermeidbarer Verletzungen pro Jahr führt ([Quelle])."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Häufige Gründe, warum kritische Prüfungen und LOTO noch immer versagen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Papierbasierte SOPs sind schwer zu aktualisieren und leicht zu ignorieren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams überspringen Schritte unter Produktionsdruck oder aufgrund unklarer Anweisungen."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Neue oder Leiharbeitnehmer haben möglicherweise keine praktische Erfahrung mit standortspezifischen Gefahren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vorgesetzte haben begrenzten Echtzeit-Einblick, wer welche Prüfung durchgeführt hat und wie gründlich."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Diese Lücken sind nicht nur Compliance-Probleme—sie sind Geschäftsrisiken. Vorfälle, die aus verpassten LOTO-Schritten resultieren, können zu schweren Verletzungen, Geräteschäden, Produktionsausfällen und regulatorischen Strafen führen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-veränderung-jetzt-notwendig-ist",children:["Warum Veränderung jetzt notwendig ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-veränderung-jetzt-notwendig-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Betriebe stehen unter zunehmendem Druck, die Sicherheit zu verbessern und Ausfallzeiten zu reduzieren, während sie gleichzeitig mit Personalfluktuation und strengeren Vorschriften umgehen müssen. Das traditionelle Modell—periodische Klassenschulung, Papierchecklisten und Stichprobenaudits—kann nicht Schritt halten."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Wichtige Treiber für Veränderung:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Steigende Komplexität:"})," Moderne Anlagen und verteilte Assets erfordern nuanciertere, schrittweise Sicherheitsprüfungen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Workforce-Dynamik:"})," Hohe Fluktuation und der Einsatz von Auftragnehmern bedeuten, dass viele Personen vor Ort mit spezifischen SOPs nicht vertraut sind."]}),"

title: Veiligheid voorop: AR gebruiken voor kritieke controles en lockout tagout procedures
description: Hoe AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies operations en HSE-leiders helpen kritieke veiligheidscontroles en lockout tagout procedures af te dwingen, risico's te verminderen en naleving te verbeteren.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"veiligheid-voorop-ar-gebruiken-voor-kritieke-controles-en-lockout-tagout-procedures",children:["Veiligheid voorop: AR gebruiken voor kritieke controles en lockout tagout procedures",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#veiligheid-voorop-ar-gebruiken-voor-kritieke-controles-en-lockout-tagout-procedures",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veiligheid, naleving en uptime vormen de kern van elke industriële operatie. Voor operations managers, HSE-verantwoordelijken en onderhoudsupervisors is het garanderen dat kritieke controles—met name lockout tagout (LOTO) procedures—naar de letter worden gevolgd, niet onderhandelbaar. Toch kunnen zelfs met gevestigde SOP's menselijke fouten, kennishiaten en inconsistente documentatie teams en assets in gevaar brengen. AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies bieden nu een praktische manier om deze essentiële veiligheidsstappen te digitaliseren en af te dwingen, direct op de werkvloer."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-kritieke-veiligheidscontroles-en-lockout-tagout-nog-steeds-falen",children:["Waarom kritieke veiligheidscontroles en lockout tagout nog steeds falen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-kritieke-veiligheidscontroles-en-lockout-tagout-nog-steeds-falen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ondanks decennia van veiligheidsprogramma's en investeringen in training, zijn kritieke veiligheidscontroles en LOTO-procedures nog steeds een belangrijke oorzaak van incidenten in productie, nutsbedrijven en procesindustrieën. Volgens het U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics behoort het niet beheersen van gevaarlijke energie (inclusief LOTO-overtredingen) consequent tot de meest geciteerde OSHA-overtredingen, wat leidt tot honderden vermijdbare verwondingen per jaar ([bron])."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veelvoorkomende redenen waarom kritieke controles en LOTO nog steeds mislukken:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Papieren SOP's zijn moeilijk bij te werken en gemakkelijk te negeren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams slaan stappen over onder productiedruk of door onduidelijke instructies."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Nieuwe of ingehuurde technici missen mogelijk hands-on ervaring met locatiespecifieke gevaren."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supervisors hebben beperkt real-time zicht op wie welke controle heeft uitgevoerd, en hoe grondig."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Deze hiaten zijn niet alleen nalevingsproblemen—het zijn bedrijfsrisico's. Incidenten die voortvloeien uit gemiste LOTO-stappen kunnen leiden tot ernstig letsel, apparaatschade, productieverlies en regelgevende boetes."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-verandering-nu-nodig-is",children:["Waarom verandering nu nodig is",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-verandering-nu-nodig-is",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële operaties worden geconfronteerd met toenemende druk om veiligheid te verbeteren en stilstand te verminderen, terwijl ze ook te maken hebben met personeelsverloop en strengere regelgeving. Het traditionele model—periodieke klastraining, papieren checklists en steekproefaudits—kan het tempo niet bijhouden."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Belangrijke drijfveren voor verandering:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Stijgende complexiteit:"})," Moderne apparatuur en gedistribueerde assets vereisen genuanceerdere, stap-voor-stap veiligheidscontroles."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Workforce-dynamiek:"})," Hoog verloop en het gebruik van contractors betekent dat veel mensen op de locatie niet bekend zijn met specifieke SOP's."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Regelgevend toezicht:"})," Digitale records en traceerbaarheid worden nu verwacht, niet optioneel, in veel rechtsgebieden."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Productie-eisen:"})," Teams wordt vaak gevraagd meer te doen met minder, wat de verleiding vergroot om bochten af te snijden."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Veel organisaties zoeken naar een manier om veiligheidsprocedures echt uitvoerbaar en auditeerbaar te maken—zonder operaties te vertragen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"hoe-ai-en-ar-geleide-werkinstructies-helpen-veiligheid-en-loto-af-te-dwingen",children:["Hoe AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies helpen veiligheid en LOTO af te dwingen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ai-en-ar-geleide-werkinstructies-helpen-veiligheid-en-loto-af-te-dwingen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies overbruggen de kloof tussen beleid en praktijk. In plaats van statische documenten of geheugengebaseerde routines, leveren deze systemen stap-voor-stap, interactieve begeleiding direct aan technici op de werkplek. Voor LOTO en andere kritieke veiligheidscontroles betekent dit:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Visuele aanwijzingen:"})," AR-overlays tonen de exacte locatie van kleppen, schakelaars of isolatiepunten op echte apparatuur."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Verplichte bevestigingen:"})," Stappen kunnen foto's, scans of digitale handtekeningen vereisen voordat de workflow mag doorgaan."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Contextuele intelligentie:"})," AI past instructies aan op het specifieke asset, de taak en de omgeving—wat ambiguïteit vermindert."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Real-time traceerbaarheid:"})," Elke actie wordt getimestamped en gelogd, wat een digitale audit trail voor naleving creëert."]}),"
"]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Een technicus die belast is met het isoleren van een pomp voor onderhoud gebruikt een tablet of AR-headset. De AR SOP begeleidt hen door:"}),"
",i(t.ol,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"De correcte isolatiepunten identificeren (gemarkeerd in hun gezichtsveld)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"QR-codes of NFC-tags scannen om te bevestigen dat vergrendelingsapparaten zijn aangebracht."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"De vergrendelde status fotograferen voor supervisorbeoordeling."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Een digitale checklist invullen die niet kan worden ingediend tenzij alle stappen zijn geverifieerd."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Supervisors kunnen de voortgang in real-time monitoren en een volledig digitaal record bekijken—wat giswerk en achteraf onderzoeken elimineert."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"use-cases-waar-ar-lockout-tagout-en-kritieke-controles-waarde-toevoegen",children:["Use cases: waar AR lockout tagout en kritieke controles waarde toevoegen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-waar-ar-lockout-tagout-en-kritieke-controles-waarde-toevoegen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies voor veiligheid en LOTO worden geïmplementeerd in de volgende scenario's:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"geplande-onderhoudsstops",children:["Geplande onderhoudsstops",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#geplande-onderhoudsstops",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Tijdens grote turnarounds moeten tientallen technici—vaak van meerdere contractors—apparatuur isoleren en spanningsloos maken. AR SOP's zorgen ervoor dat elke stap consistent wordt gevolgd, en dat supervisors een live dashboard hebben van de vergrendelingsstatus over de hele locatie."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"noodinterventies",children:["Noodinterventies",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#noodinterventies",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In urgente situaties is het gemakkelijk om een stap te missen of documentatie te omzeilen. AR-geleide workflows leiden teams door de juiste volgorde, zelfs onder druk, en leggen bewijs vast voor latere beoordeling."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"training-en-onboarding",children:["Training en onboarding",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-en-onboarding",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"ar-opschalen-van-één-fabriek-naar-meerdere-governance-templates-en-standaarden",children:["AR opschalen van één fabriek naar meerdere: governance, templates en standaarden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-opschalen-van-één-fabriek-naar-meerdere-governance-templates-en-standaarden",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) werkinstructies leveren meetbare veiligheids- en productiviteitswinsten op in industriële fabrieken wereldwijd. Voor operations managers, HSE-leiders en L&D-teams is de volgende uitdaging duidelijk: hoe schaal je succesvolle AR SOP's op van een enkele pilotlocatie naar meerdere fabrieken—zonder controle, consistentie of kwaliteit te verliezen?"}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Dit artikel verkent de governance, templates en standaarden die nodig zijn om AR op te schalen in uw organisatie. Het behandelt veelvoorkomende valkuilen, biedt concrete voorbeelden en schetst actiegerichte stappen voor besluitvormers die investeringen moeten rechtvaardigen en ROI op schaal moeten bewijzen."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Veel industriële bedrijven hebben AR-pilots of kleinschalige implementaties gelanceerd. Resultaten zijn veelbelovend: kortere inwerktijd, minder fouten en betere nalevingsdocumentatie. De echte test komt bij het uitbreiden van AR digitale werkinstructies voorbij de pilotfabriek."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Veelvoorkomende uitdagingen zijn:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Inconsistente SOP's en contentkwaliteit tussen locaties"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Lokale workarounds die veiligheid of controleerbaarheid ondermijnen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Dubbel werk, verspilde middelen en versieproliferatie"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Moeilijk content onderhouden wanneer apparatuur of regelgeving verandert"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Gebrek aan duidelijke eigenaarschap voor updaten, reviewen en goedkeuren van instructies"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Zonder governance-framework kunnen AR-initiatieven vastlopen of zelfs averechts werken. Operators kunnen terugvallen op legacy-methoden, en management verliest vertrouwen in de waarde van digitale werkinstructies."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"waarom-nu-trends-die-de-noodzaak-voor-robuuste-ar-governance-aandrijven",children:["Waarom nu: trends die de noodzaak voor robuuste AR-governance aandrijven",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-nu-trends-die-de-noodzaak-voor-robuuste-ar-governance-aandrijven",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Verschillende trends maken het urgent voor industriële leiders om sterke AR SOP-governance te vestigen:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Personeelsverloop en vaardigheidskloof:"})," Naarmate ervaren technici met pensioen gaan, zijn consistente, hoogwaardige digitale werkinstructies cruciaal voor inwerken en kennisbehoud (McKinsey, 2023)."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Toenemende regelgevingsdruk:"})," Controleerbare, actuele SOP's zijn niet langer optioneel in veel industrieën. Digitale AR SOP's bieden een duidelijke nalevingsregistratie."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Globalisering en gedistribueerde operaties:"})," Multi-site fabrikanten hebben standaardisatie nodig om kwaliteit en veiligheid te waarborgen, ongeacht locatie."]}),"

"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Opmerking:"}),' Volgens een Capgemini-onderzoek uit 2022 noemt 74% van de industriële bedrijven die AR implementeren "schaalbaarheid en standaardisatie" als hun grootste zorg (',n(a.a,{href:"https://www.capgemini.com/research/the-business-value-of-ar/",children:"Capgemini Research Institute, 2022"}),")."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"governance-de-basis-voor-opschalen-van-ar-werkinstructies",children:["Governance: de basis voor opschalen van AR-werkinstructies",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#governance-de-basis-voor-opschalen-van-ar-werkinstructies",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Effectieve AR SOP-opschaling begint met governance. Dit betekent meer dan IT-beleid of contentgoedkeuring—het gaat om het definiëren van rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en processen over fabrieken heen."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Belangrijke elementen van robuuste AR-governance:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Centrale AR-stuurgroep:"})," Een cross-functioneel team (operations, HSE, IT, training) om standaarden te stellen, metrics te reviewen en verandering te managen."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Locatie-kampioenen:"})," Lokale experts verantwoordelijk voor het aanpassen en implementeren van AR SOP's, feedback geven en adoptie verzekeren."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Contenteigenaarschap en lifecycle management:"})," Duidelijke toewijzing van wie elke SOP maakt, reviewt, goedkeurt en updatet."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Audit- en nalevingsproces:"})," Regelmatige controles om te verzekeren dat AR-instructies voldoen aan regelgevings-, veiligheids- en kwaliteitsstandaarden."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Feedback en continue verbetering:"})," Gestructureerde kanalen voor technici en supervisors om updates voor te stellen en problemen te melden."]}),"

title: Scaling AR from one plant to many: governance, templates and standards
description: How operations, HSE and L&D leaders can scale AR SOPs across multiple sites with robust governance, templates and standards.
