author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:n,jsx:e,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(n,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"scaling-ar-from-one-plant-to-many-governance-templates-and-standards",children:["Scaling AR from one plant to many: governance, templates and standards",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#scaling-ar-from-one-plant-to-many-governance-templates-and-standards",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) work instructions are delivering measurable safety and productivity gains in industrial plants worldwide. For operations managers, HSE leads, and L&D teams, the next challenge is clear: how do you scale successful AR SOPs from a single pilot site to multiple plants—without losing control, consistency or quality?"}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"This article explores the governance, templates, and standards required to scale AR across your organisation. It addresses common pitfalls, provides concrete examples, and outlines actionable steps for decision makers who need to justify investment and prove ROI at scale."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"the-challenge-why-scaling-ar-beyond-one-site-is-hard",children:["The challenge: why scaling AR beyond one site is hard",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-challenge-why-scaling-ar-beyond-one-site-is-hard",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Many industrial companies have launched AR pilots or small-scale deployments. Results are promising: reduced onboarding time, fewer errors, and better compliance documentation. The real test comes when expanding AR digital work instructions beyond the pilot plant."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Common challenges include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Inconsistent SOPs and content quality between sites"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Local workarounds that undermine safety or auditability"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Duplicate efforts, wasted resources, and version sprawl"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Difficulty maintaining content as equipment or regulations change"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Lack of clear ownership for updating, reviewing and approving instructions"}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Without a governance framework, AR initiatives can stall or even backfire. Operators may revert to legacy methods, and management loses confidence in the value of digital work instructions."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-now-trends-driving-the-need-for-robust-ar-governance",children:["Why now: trends driving the need for robust AR governance",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-trends-driving-the-need-for-robust-ar-governance",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Several trends make it urgent for industrial leaders to establish strong AR SOP governance:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Workforce turnover and skills gap:"})," As experienced technicians retire, consistent, high-quality digital work instructions are critical for onboarding and knowledge retention (McKinsey, 2023)."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Increasing regulatory pressure:"})," Auditable, up-to-date SOPs are no longer optional in many industries. Digital AR SOPs provide a clear record of compliance."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Globalisation and distributed operations:"})," Multi-site manufacturers need standardisation to ensure quality and safety, regardless of location."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Rapid technology adoption:"})," AR hardware and platforms are maturing, but content chaos can undermine the business case without structure."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.blockquote,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Note:"})," According to a 2022 Capgemini survey, 74% of industrial companies deploying AR cite “scalability and standardisation” as their top concern (",e(r.a,{href:"https://www.capgemini.com/research/the-business-value-of-ar/",children:"Capgemini Research Institute, 2022"}),")."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"governance-the-foundation-for-scaling-ar-work-instructions",children:["Governance: the foundation for scaling AR work instructions",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#governance-the-foundation-for-scaling-ar-work-instructions",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Effective AR SOP scaling starts with governance. This means more than IT policy or content approval—it’s about defining roles, responsibilities, and processes across plants."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Key elements of robust AR governance:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Central AR steering committee:"})," A cross-functional team (operations, HSE, IT, training) to set standards, review metrics, and manage change."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Site champions:"})," Local experts responsible for adapting and implementing AR SOPs, providing feedback, and ensuring adoption."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Content ownership and lifecycle management:"})," Clear assignment of who creates, reviews, approves, and updates each SOP."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Audit and compliance process:"})," Regular checks to ensure AR instructions meet regulatory, safety, and quality standards."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Feedback and continuous improvement:"})," Structured channels for technicians and supervisors to suggest updates and report issues."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"A centralised governance model ensures consistency, while local involvement drives relevance and adoption."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"templates-driving-consistency-and-efficiency-in-ar-sops",children:["Templates: driving consistency and efficiency in AR SOPs",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#templates-driving-consistency-and-efficiency-in-ar-sops",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Templates are the backbone of scalable, high-quality AR work instructions. They provide structure, enforce best practices, and reduce duplication across sites."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Effective AR SOP templates should:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Standardise step types (e.g. safety checks, visual inspections, data entry)"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Include mandatory fields for equipment, PPE, regulatory references, and sign-off"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Support multimedia (photos, video, 3D models) for clarity and engagement"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Allow for local customisation where justified (e.g. site-specific hazards)"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Integrate with existing document control and EHS systems"}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Templates make it faster to create new digital instructions, simplify training for content authors, and ensure all teams follow the same process."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:e(r.strong,{children:"Example template elements:"})}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Task objective and scope"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Required tools and PPE"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Step-by-step actions with AR overlays"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Safety and quality checks"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Data capture points (e.g. measurements, photos)"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Escalation or exception handling"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Revision history and approval status"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"standards-ensuring-quality-safety-and-compliance-at-scale",children:["Standards: ensuring quality, safety and compliance at scale",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#standards-ensuring-quality-safety-and-compliance-at-scale",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Standards bring discipline to AR SOP deployment. They define what “good” looks like for content, usability, and compliance—across all plants."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Key standards for scaling AR SOPs:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Content quality:"})," Readability, accuracy, and visual clarity criteria"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Safety integration:"})," Mandatory inclusion of risk controls and lockout/tagout steps"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Version control:"})," Unique IDs, revision tracking, and sunset dates for outdated instructions"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Training and certification:"})," Requirements for SOP authors and reviewers"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Hardware compatibility:"})," Minimum device specs and approved AR hardware lists"]}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"By codifying standards, organisations reduce the risk of “shadow SOPs” and ensure every technician, in every location, receives the same level of guidance."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-ar-sops-work-at-scale-scenarios-and-use-cases",children:["How AR SOPs work at scale: scenarios and use cases",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-sops-work-at-scale-scenarios-and-use-cases",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Scaling AR SOPs goes beyond digitising a few maintenance routines. It enables a step change in operational consistency and performance."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:e(r.strong,{children:"Common use cases for multi-site AR SOPs:"})}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Planned maintenance:"})," Standardising critical asset checks across plants, ensuring every team follows the same best practice."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Safety-critical tasks:"})," Embedding lockout/tagout, confined space entry, or chemical handling steps with visual AR cues and mandatory sign-off."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Changeovers and line setup:"})," Reducing downtime and errors by guiding teams through complex, site-specific sequences with interactive AR."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Quality inspections:"})," Enabling real-time defect capture, photo documentation, and escalation within a standardised AR workflow."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Onboarding and cross-training:"})," Accelerating learning curves for new hires or transfers with step-by-step AR instructions aligned to global standards."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:e(r.strong,{children:"Scenario: Multi-site chemical manufacturer"})}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"A global chemical company rolled out AR-guided work instructions for pump maintenance at its pilot plant, cutting onboarding time by 40%. When expanding to five additional sites, the absence of clear templates led to inconsistent procedures and audit findings. By establishing a central AR governance team, standardising templates, and requiring site champion sign-off, the company reduced SOP creation time by 60% and improved audit scores across all plants."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"results-measurable-benefits-of-robust-ar-sop-governance",children:["Results: measurable benefits of robust AR SOP governance",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-measurable-benefits-of-robust-ar-sop-governance",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Companies that invest in governance, templates, and standards for AR digital work instructions report:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Faster scale-up:"})," 2–3x reduction in time needed to deploy new SOPs at additional sites"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Consistency and compliance:"})," Significant reduction in SOP deviations and audit findings"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Lower content maintenance burden:"})," Central updates cascade automatically to all sites"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Improved safety and quality metrics:"})," Fewer incidents, near-misses, and quality escapes"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Higher workforce confidence:"})," Technicians trust instructions and are more likely to follow them"]}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"For operations and HSE leaders, these outcomes translate directly to higher uptime, reduced risk, and better ROI on digital investments."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-scaling-ar-sops-with-confidence",children:["What ActARion brings: scaling AR SOPs with confidence",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-scaling-ar-sops-with-confidence",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"ActARion partners with industrial companies to scale AI and AR–guided work instructions across multiple sites, with a focus on governance, templates, and standards."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Key elements of ActARion’s approach:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Governance workshops:"})," Facilitate alignment across operations, safety, and IT to define roles, processes, and review cycles."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Template libraries:"})," Provide ready-to-use, customisable AR SOP templates for common tasks, incorporating best practices and regulatory requirements."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Standards development:"})," Support organisations in codifying content, safety, and hardware standards tailored to their environment."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Practical guidance for onboarding site champions, training authors, and driving adoption at the plant level."]}),"

",e(r.p,{children:"With a proven track record in high-compliance industries, ActARion helps clients accelerate AR deployment, reduce risk, and achieve measurable business impact."}),"

title: Typische Fallstricke beim Start mit AR in der Produktion und wie man sie vermeidet
description: Verstehen Sie die häufigen Fallstricke bei der Implementierung von AR in der Produktion und lernen Sie praktische Strategien für eine erfolgreiche Einführung in industriellen Betrieben.

image.alt: Typische Fallstricke beim Start mit AR in der Produktion und wie man sie vermeidet

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"typische-fallstricke-beim-start-mit-ar-in-der-produktion-und-wie-man-sie-vermeidet",children:["Typische Fallstricke beim Start mit AR in der Produktion und wie man sie vermeidet",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#typische-fallstricke-beim-start-mit-ar-in-der-produktion-und-wie-man-sie-vermeidet",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented Reality (AR) verändert, wie Industrieteams arbeiten. Aber viele Unternehmen stoßen auf vermeidbare Fallstricke beim Start mit AR in der Produktion. Diese Herausforderungen zu verstehen—und zu wissen, wie man sie vermeidet—kann den Unterschied zwischen einem stagnierenden Piloten und einer messbaren Verbesserung in Sicherheit, Produktivität und Wissenstransfer ausmachen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"ar-in-der-produktion-kontext-und-dringlichkeit",children:["AR in der Produktion: Kontext und Dringlichkeit",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-in-der-produktion-kontext-und-dringlichkeit",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Betriebe stehen unter wachsendem Druck, die Sicherheit zu verbessern, Compliance aufrechtzuerhalten und die Verfügbarkeit hoch zu halten. Gleichzeitig altern technische Teams und neuen Mitarbeitern fehlt oft praktische Erfahrung. Laut McKinsey wird AR in Fertigung und Wartung eingesetzt, um diese Lücken zu schließen, indem Echtzeit-digitale Arbeitsanweisungen direkt vor Ort geliefert werden."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Jedoch ist der Übergang von einem vielversprechenden AR-Piloten zur breiten Produktionsbereitstellung selten unkompliziert. Frühe Fehltritte können den Fortschritt verzögern, Teams frustrieren und das Vertrauen in digitale Lösungen untergraben. Für Operations Manager, HSE-Leiter und Schulungsprofis ist es entscheidend, diese Fallstricke zu antizipieren und sie direkt anzugehen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-ar-initiativen-oft-in-der-produktion-scheitern",children:["Warum AR-Initiativen oft in der Produktion scheitern",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-ar-initiativen-oft-in-der-produktion-scheitern",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Viele AR-Projekte liefern nicht den erwarteten Wert. Die Grundursachen sind praktisch, nicht technisch. Die häufigsten Fallstricke sind:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"AR-Hardware ohne Bediener-Input auswählen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Den Aufwand für die Digitalisierung von SOPs unterschätzen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Änderungsmanagement und Schulungsbedarf ignorieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Keine klaren Metriken für Erfolg und ROI"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR nicht mit bestehenden Systemen und Workflows integrieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR als einmaliges Pilotprojekt statt als skalierbares Programm behandeln"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Diese Probleme sind nicht einzigartig für eine Branche. Ob in der Prozessindustrie, diskreten Fertigung oder im Außendienst – dieselben Muster treten auf. Sie früh anzugehen ist wesentlich für eine erfolgreiche Einführung."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"fallstrick-1-ar-hardware-ohne-bediener-input-auswählen",children:["Fallstrick 1: AR-Hardware ohne Bediener-Input auswählen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#fallstrick-1-ar-hardware-ohne-bediener-input-auswählen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die Auswahl des richtigen AR-Geräts ist nicht nur eine IT-Entscheidung. Es geht darum, wie Techniker und Bediener tatsächlich arbeiten. Häufige Fehler sind:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Geräte auswählen, die zu schwer oder unbequem für den ganztägigen Einsatz sind"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Kompatibilität mit Sicherheitsausrüstung (z.B. Helme, Handschuhe, Augenschutz) übersehen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Umgebungsbedingungen ignorieren (Staub, Feuchtigkeit, Beleuchtung, Lärm)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Geräte mit kurzer Akkulaufzeit oder unzuverlässiger Konnektivität wählen"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hinweis:"})," In einer PWC-Studie (2023) scheiterten 46% der industriellen AR-Piloten aufgrund schlechter Hardware-Eignung für die vorgesehene Arbeitsumgebung."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet",children:["Wie man diesen Fallstrick vermeidet",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Techniker und Sicherheitsleiter in Hardware-Evaluierung und Feldtests einbeziehen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Geräte in echten Produktionsszenarien testen, nicht nur im Labor"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Freisprechende, sprachgesteuerte Optionen wo möglich priorisieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Feedback dokumentieren und vor der Skalierung iterieren"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"fallstrick-2-den-aufwand-für-die-sop-digitalisierung-unterschätzen",children:["Fallstrick 2: Den Aufwand für die SOP-Digitalisierung unterschätzen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#fallstrick-2-den-aufwand-für-die-sop-digitalisierung-unterschätzen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ein häufiges Missverständnis ist, dass bestehende SOPs direkt in AR-Plattformen übernommen werden können. In Wirklichkeit sind die meisten SOPs für Papier oder PDF geschrieben und müssen für digitale, schrittweise Anleitung neu gedacht werden."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Typische Probleme sind:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"SOPs, die zu generisch sind oder umsetzbare Details fehlen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schritte, die Vorwissen voraussetzen oder wichtige Sicherheitsüberprüfungen auslassen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Anweisungen, die sich nicht gut in visuelle Formate übersetzen (Bilder, 3D-Modelle, Videos)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Mangelnde Standardisierung über ähnliche Aufgaben"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-1",children:["Wie man diesen Fallstrick vermeidet",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-1",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Eine Inhaltsaudit durchführen, um zu identifizieren, welche SOPs bereit für Digitalisierung sind"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Mit erfahrenen Trainern und Bedienern zusammenarbeiten, um Verfahren in granulare, prüfbare Schritte aufzuteilen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR-Plattformen verwenden, die Inhaltserstellung und Updates für Nicht-IT-Personal einfach machen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Digitale Arbeitsanweisungen bei einer wirkungsstarken, häufig wiederholten Aufgabe pilotieren, bevor man skaliert"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"fallstrick-3-änderungsmanagement-und-wissenstransfer-ignorieren",children:["Fallstrick 3: Änderungsmanagement und Wissenstransfer ignorieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#fallstrick-3-änderungsmanagement-und-wissenstransfer-ignorieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR ist nicht einfach ein weiteres Tool—es verändert, wie Arbeit erledigt wird. Teams, die sich vom Prozess ausgeschlossen fühlen, könnten die Adoption verweigern oder zu alten Gewohnheiten zurückkehren."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Häufige Anzeichen für unzureichendes Änderungsmanagement:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Bediener kehren zu Papieranweisungen zurück, nachdem die anfängliche Begeisterung nachlässt"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vorgesetzte sind nicht geschult, um digitale Arbeit zu coachen oder zu überwachen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Schulung ist eine einmalige Veranstaltung, kein kontinuierlicher Prozess"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:'Teams sehen AR als "zusätzliche Aufgabe" statt als Produktivitätshilfe'}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-2",children:["Wie man diesen Fallstrick vermeidet",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-2",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Bediener, Vorgesetzte und HSE früh in Design und Einführung einbeziehen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Praxisorientierte, szenariobasierte AR-Schulung anbieten (nicht nur Klassenzimmersitzungen)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR-Champions in jedem Team ernennen, um Kollegen zu unterstützen und Feedback zu sammeln"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR-Nutzung in tägliche Routinen, Audits und Schichtübergaben einbauen"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"fallstrick-4-keine-klaren-metriken-für-erfolg-und-roi",children:["Fallstrick 4: Keine klaren Metriken für Erfolg und ROI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#fallstrick-4-keine-klaren-metriken-für-erfolg-und-roi",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:'Ohne klare Maßstäbe ist es unmöglich zu wissen, ob AR Wert liefert. Viele Piloten scheitern, weil die Ziele vage sind ("Effizienz verbessern") oder überhaupt nicht verfolgt werden.'}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Typische Übersehungen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Keine Baseline-Daten zu Aufgabenzeit, Fehlerquoten oder Sicherheitsvorfällen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Erfolg nur an Benutzerzufriedenheit gemessen, nicht an operativen KPIs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"ROI-Annahmen basierend auf Lieferantenversprechen, nicht auf echten Daten"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-3",children:["Wie man diesen Fallstrick vermeidet",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-3",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Konkrete Metriken in der Pilotphase definieren (z.B. Zeit für Aufgabenabschluss, Anzahl der Fehler, Vorfallberichte)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR-Plattformen mit integrierten Analytics verwenden, um Nutzung und Ergebnisse zu verfolgen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vorher-Nachher-Ergebnisse bei Pilotaufgaben vergleichen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ergebnisse an Stakeholder berichten und zur Verfeinerung der Einführung verwenden"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"fallstrick-5-ar-nicht-mit-bestehenden-systemen-und-workflows-integrieren",children:["Fallstrick 5: AR nicht mit bestehenden Systemen und Workflows integrieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#fallstrick-5-ar-nicht-mit-bestehenden-systemen-und-workflows-integrieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR ist am effektivsten, wenn es nahtlos in bestehende Workflows passt. Eine eigenständige AR-App, die doppelte Dateneingabe oder manuelle Synchronisierung erfordert, schafft Reibung und Risiko."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Häufige Integrationsprobleme:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"AR-Anweisungen sind nicht mit Asset Management oder Wartungssystemen verknüpft"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"In AR durchgeführte Arbeit wird nicht im Haupt-ERP oder CMMS protokolliert"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Bediener müssen zwischen Geräten oder Apps wechseln, um eine Aufgabe abzuschließen"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-4",children:["Wie man diesen Fallstrick vermeidet",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-4",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Den End-to-End-Workflow vor der AR-Bereitstellung kartieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR-Plattformen mit offenen APIs und bewährten Integrationen wählen (z.B. SAP, Maximo, Infor EAM)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Anwendungsfälle priorisieren, bei denen digitale Arbeitsanweisungen eine echte Lücke schließen (z.B. Einarbeitung, Compliance-Prüfungen, Wartungsrunden)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"IT und Prozessverantwortliche früh einbeziehen, um Integration und Daten-Governance anzugehen"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"fallstrick-6-ar-als-einmaliges-pilotprojekt-behandeln",children:["Fallstrick 6: AR als einmaliges Pilotprojekt behandeln",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#fallstrick-6-ar-als-einmaliges-pilotprojekt-behandeln",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:'Viele Organisationen führen einen einzigen AR-Piloten durch und stagnieren dann. Dieses "Pilot-Fegefeuer" passiert, wenn:'}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Es keinen Plan gibt, erfolgreiche Piloten auf andere Teams oder Standorte zu skalieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Wissen bei einem einzelnen Projektleiter oder Lieferanten verbleibt"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Gelernte Lektionen nicht dokumentiert oder geteilt werden"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-5",children:["Wie man diesen Fallstrick vermeidet",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-man-diesen-fallstrick-vermeidet-5",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Eine Roadmap für die Skalierung von AR über Standorte und Prozesse entwickeln"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Interne Kapazität für AR-Inhaltserstellung und Support aufbauen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ergebnisse, Templates und gelernte Lektionen zwischen Teams teilen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR als Teil Ihrer digitalen Transformation behandeln, nicht als eigenständiges Projekt"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-ki-und-ar-geführte-arbeitsanweisungen-diese-fallstricke-adressieren",children:["Wie KI und AR-geführte Arbeitsanweisungen diese Fallstricke adressieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ki-und-ar-geführte-arbeitsanweisungen-diese-fallstricke-adressieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"KI und AR-geführte Arbeitsanweisungen bringen Struktur und Rückverfolgbarkeit in Produktionsprozesse. Durch Digitalisierung von SOPs und Bereitstellung über AR-Geräte erhalten Teams:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Schrittweise digitale Anweisungen, die auf jede Aufgabe zugeschnitten sind"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Visuelle Hinweise (Bilder, 3D-Modelle, Videos) zum richtigen Zeitpunkt"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Echtzeit-Datenerfassung (z.B. Fotos, Sprachnotizen, Checklisten)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Automatisierte Compliance-Prüfungen und Sicherheitsaufforderungen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Analytics über Aufgabenabschluss, Fehler und aufgewendete Zeit"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"KI kann Anweisungen basierend auf Bedienererfahrung weiter personalisieren, Anomalien markieren und Verbesserungen vorschlagen."}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Beispiel:"})," Ein globaler Hersteller reduzierte die Einarbeitungszeit für neue Wartungstechniker um 30% mit AR-SOPs, während Fehlerquoten bei kritischen Aufgaben um 40% sanken. (Interne Fallstudiedaten, ActARion)"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"praktische-anwendungsfälle-für-ar-sops-in-der-produktion",children:["Praktische Anwendungsfälle für AR-SOPs in der Produktion",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#praktische-anwendungsfälle-für-ar-sops-in-der-produktion",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Unternehmen sehen messbare Ergebnisse von KI und AR-geführten Arbeitsanweisungen in:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Anlageneinrichtung und Umrüstungen (Stillstandszeit reduzieren)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Wartungs- und Inspektionsrunden (Rückverfolgbarkeit verbessern)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Qualitätsprüfungen und Dokumentation (Compliance unterstützen)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sicherheitskritische Verfahren (sicherstellen, dass alle Schritte befolgt werden)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Einarbeitung und Weiterqualifizierung neuer Techniker (Time-to-Competence beschleunigen)"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Für jeden Anwendungsfall ist der Schlüssel, mit einem wirkungsstarken, wiederholbaren Prozess zu beginnen und basierend auf Feedback und Ergebnissen zu erweitern."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"was-actarion-zu-industriellen-ar-bereitstellungen-beiträgt",children:["Was ActARion zu industriellen AR-Bereitstellungen beiträgt",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-actarion-zu-industriellen-ar-bereitstellungen-beiträgt",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion arbeitet mit Operations-, HSE- und Schulungsleitern zusammen, um diese Fallstricke von Tag eins an zu vermeiden. Unser Ansatz umfasst:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Gemeinsame Workshops zur Auswahl der richtigen Hardware für Ihre Umgebung"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Strukturierte SOP-Digitalisierungssprints mit Ihren Trainern und Bedienern"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Bewährte Änderungsmanagement-Frameworks, die auf industrielle Teams zugeschnitten sind"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integration mit Ihren bestehenden Asset Management- und ERP-Systemen"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Transparente Metriken und Berichterstattung zum Nachweis des ROI"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Eine klare Roadmap für die Skalierung von AR-SOPs über Standorte und Prozesse"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Wir konzentrieren uns auf messbare Verbesserungen in Sicherheit, Produktivität und Mitarbeiterbereitschaft—nicht nur auf Technologieadoption."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"entdecken-sie-wie-das-in-ihrer-organisation-aussieht",children:["Entdecken Sie, wie das in Ihrer Organisation aussieht",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#entdecken-sie-wie-das-in-ihrer-organisation-aussieht",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Um zu sehen, wie KI und AR-geführte Arbeitsanweisungen Ihren Teams helfen können, die häufigen Fallstricke zu vermeiden und echte Ergebnisse zu liefern, vereinbaren Sie ein exploratives Discovery-Gespräch mit ActARion. Es gibt keine Verpflichtung—nur einen praktischen Blick darauf, was in Ihrem Kontext funktioniert."}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:n(t.a,{href:"/de/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR-Einarbeitung für neue Techniker"})}),"
",n(t.li,{children:n(t.a,{href:"/de/use-cases/digital-work-instructions",children:"Digitale Arbeitsanweisungen in der Asset-Wartung"})}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Erfahren Sie mehr über AR in der Industrie von McKinseys Analyse"}),"
"]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Typische valkuilen bij starten met AR op de werkvloer en hoe ze te vermijden
description: Begrijp de veelvoorkomende valkuilen bij implementatie van AR op de werkvloer en leer praktische strategieën voor een succesvolle uitrol in industriële operaties.

image.alt: Typische valkuilen bij starten met AR op de werkvloer en hoe ze te vermijden

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"typische-valkuilen-bij-starten-met-ar-op-de-werkvloer-en-hoe-ze-te-vermijden",children:["Typische valkuilen bij starten met AR op de werkvloer en hoe ze te vermijden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#typische-valkuilen-bij-starten-met-ar-op-de-werkvloer-en-hoe-ze-te-vermijden",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) verandert hoe industriële teams werken. Maar veel bedrijven stuiten op vermijdbare valkuilen bij het starten met AR op de werkvloer. Deze uitdagingen begrijpen—en weten hoe je ze vermijdt—kan het verschil betekenen tussen een vastgelopen pilot en een meetbare verbetering in veiligheid, productiviteit en kennisoverdracht."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"ar-op-de-werkvloer-context-en-urgentie",children:["AR op de werkvloer: context en urgentie",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-op-de-werkvloer-context-en-urgentie",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industriële operaties staan onder toenemende druk om veiligheid te verbeteren, naleving te handhaven en uptime hoog te houden. Tegelijkertijd vergrijzen technische teams en missen nieuwe medewerkers vaak praktijkervaring. Volgens McKinsey wordt AR toegepast in productie en onderhoud om deze kloven te dichten door real-time, digitale werkinstructies direct in het veld te leveren."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Echter, de overstap van een veelbelovende AR-pilot naar brede werkvloer-implementatie is zelden rechtlijnig. Vroege misstappen kunnen vooruitgang vertragen, teams frustreren en vertrouwen in digitale oplossingen ondermijnen. Voor operations managers, HSE-leiders en trainingsprofessionals is het cruciaal om deze valkuilen te anticiperen en ze direct aan te pakken."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"waarom-ar-initiatieven-vaak-worstelen-op-de-werkvloer",children:["Waarom AR-initiatieven vaak worstelen op de werkvloer",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-ar-initiatieven-vaak-worstelen-op-de-werkvloer",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Veel AR-projecten leveren niet de verwachte waarde. De grondoorzaken zijn praktisch, niet technisch. De meest voorkomende valkuilen zijn:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"AR-hardware kiezen zonder input van operators"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"De inspanning onderschatten om SOP's te digitaliseren"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Verandermanagement en trainingsbehoeften negeren"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Geen duidelijke metrics voor succes en ROI"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"AR niet integreren met bestaande systemen en workflows"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"AR behandelen als eenmalige pilot in plaats van schaalbaar programma"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Deze problemen zijn niet uniek voor één sector. Of het nu gaat om procesindustrieën, discrete productie of field service, dezelfde patronen komen naar voren. Ze vroeg aanpakken is essentieel voor een succesvolle uitrol."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"valkuil-1-ar-hardware-kiezen-zonder-input-van-operators",children:["Valkuil 1: AR-hardware kiezen zonder input van operators",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#valkuil-1-ar-hardware-kiezen-zonder-input-van-operators",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Het juiste AR-apparaat selecteren is niet alleen een IT-beslissing. Het gaat om hoe technici en operators daadwerkelijk werken. Veelgemaakte fouten zijn:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Apparaten selecteren die te zwaar of oncomfortabel zijn voor dagelijks gebruik"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Compatibiliteit met veiligheidsuitrusting (bijv. helmen, handschoenen, oogbescherming) over het hoofd zien"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"De omgevingsomstandigheden negeren (stof, vocht, verlichting, geluid)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Apparaten kiezen met korte batterijduur of onbetrouwbare connectiviteit"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Opmerking:"})," In een PWC-studie (2023) faalden 46% van de industriële AR-pilots door slechte hardware-fit voor de beoogde werkomgeving."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden",children:["Hoe deze valkuil te vermijden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Betrek technici en veiligheidsleiders bij hardware-evaluatie en veldtests"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Test apparaten in echte productiescenario's, niet alleen in het lab"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Geef prioriteit aan handsfree, spraakgestuurde opties waar mogelijk"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Documenteer feedback en itereer voordat je opschaalt"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"valkuil-2-de-inspanning-onderschatten-om-sops-te-digitaliseren",children:["Valkuil 2: De inspanning onderschatten om SOP's te digitaliseren",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#valkuil-2-de-inspanning-onderschatten-om-sops-te-digitaliseren",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Een veelvoorkomende misvatting is dat bestaande SOP's direct in AR-platforms kunnen worden gedumpt. In werkelijkheid zijn de meeste SOP's geschreven voor papier of PDF en moeten ze worden heroverwogen voor digitale, stap-voor-stap begeleiding."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Typische problemen zijn:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"SOP's die te generiek zijn of actiegerichte details missen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Stappen die voorkennis veronderstellen of belangrijke veiligheidscontroles weglaten"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Instructies die niet goed vertalen naar visuele formats (afbeeldingen, 3D-modellen, video's)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Gebrek aan standaardisatie over vergelijkbare taken"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-1",children:["Hoe deze valkuil te vermijden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-1",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Voer een content-audit uit om te identificeren welke SOP's klaar zijn voor digitalisering"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Werk samen met ervaren trainers en operators om procedures op te splitsen in granulaire, controleerbare stappen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Gebruik AR-platforms die contentcreatie en updates gemakkelijk maken voor niet-IT-personeel"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Pilot digitale werkinstructies op een high-impact, vaak herhaalde taak voordat je opschaalt"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"valkuil-3-verandermanagement-en-kennisoverdracht-negeren",children:["Valkuil 3: Verandermanagement en kennisoverdracht negeren",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#valkuil-3-verandermanagement-en-kennisoverdracht-negeren",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR is niet zomaar een ander tool—het verandert hoe werk wordt gedaan. Teams die zich buitengesloten voelen van het proces kunnen adoptie weerstaan of terugvallen op oude gewoontes."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Veelvoorkomende tekenen van inadequaat verandermanagement:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Operators vallen terug op papieren instructies nadat het eerste enthousiasme wegebt"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Supervisors zijn niet getraind om digitaal werk te coachen of monitoren"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Training is een eenmalige gebeurtenis, geen continu proces"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:'Teams zien AR als een "extra taak" in plaats van een productiviteitshulp'}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-2",children:["Hoe deze valkuil te vermijden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-2",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Betrek operators, supervisors en HSE vroeg bij ontwerp en uitrol"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Bied hands-on, scenario-gebaseerde AR-training (niet alleen klassessies)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Wijs AR-kampioenen aan in elk team om collega's te ondersteunen en feedback te verzamelen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Bouw AR-gebruik in dagelijkse routines, audits en ploegoverdrachten"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"valkuil-4-geen-duidelijke-metrics-voor-succes-en-roi",children:["Valkuil 4: Geen duidelijke metrics voor succes en ROI",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#valkuil-4-geen-duidelijke-metrics-voor-succes-en-roi",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'Zonder duidelijke maatstaven is het onmogelijk te weten of AR waarde levert. Veel pilots falen omdat de doelen vaag zijn ("efficiëntie verbeteren") of helemaal niet worden bijgehouden.'}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Typische oversights:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Geen baseline-data over taaktijd, foutpercentages of veiligheidsincidenten"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Succes alleen gemeten aan gebruikerstevredenheid, niet aan operationele KPI's"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"ROI-aannames gebaseerd op leveranciersbeloftes, niet op echte data"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-3",children:["Hoe deze valkuil te vermijden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-3",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Definieer concrete metrics in de pilotfase (bijv. tijd om taak te voltooien, aantal fouten, incidentrapporten)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Gebruik AR-platforms met ingebouwde analytics om gebruik en uitkomsten te volgen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Vergelijk voor-en-na-resultaten op pilottaken"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Rapporteer resultaten aan stakeholders en gebruik ze om de uitrol te verfijnen"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"valkuil-5-ar-niet-integreren-met-bestaande-systemen-en-workflows",children:["Valkuil 5: AR niet integreren met bestaande systemen en workflows",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#valkuil-5-ar-niet-integreren-met-bestaande-systemen-en-workflows",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR is het effectiefst wanneer het naadloos past in bestaande workflows. Een standalone AR-app die dubbele data-invoer of handmatige synchronisatie vereist, creëert wrijving en risico."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Veelvoorkomende integratieproblemen:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"AR-instructies zijn niet gekoppeld aan asset management of onderhoudssystemen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Werk uitgevoerd in AR wordt niet gelogd in het hoofd-ERP of CMMS"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Operators moeten schakelen tussen apparaten of apps om een taak te voltooien"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-4",children:["Hoe deze valkuil te vermijden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-4",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Breng de end-to-end workflow in kaart voordat je AR implementeert"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Kies AR-platforms met open API's en bewezen integraties (bijv. SAP, Maximo, Infor EAM)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Geef prioriteit aan use cases waar digitale werkinstructies een echte kloof dichten (bijv. inwerken, nalevingscontroles, onderhoudsrondes)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Betrek IT en proceseigenaren vroeg om integratie en datagovernance aan te pakken"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"valkuil-6-ar-behandelen-als-eenmalige-pilot",children:["Valkuil 6: AR behandelen als eenmalige pilot",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#valkuil-6-ar-behandelen-als-eenmalige-pilot",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'Veel organisaties voeren één AR-pilot uit en lopen dan vast. Dit "pilot-vagevuur" gebeurt wanneer:'}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Er geen plan is om succesvolle pilots op te schalen naar andere teams of locaties"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Kennis blijft bij één projectleider of leverancier"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Geleerde lessen niet worden gedocumenteerd of gedeeld"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-5",children:["Hoe deze valkuil te vermijden",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-deze-valkuil-te-vermijden-5",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Ontwikkel een roadmap voor opschalen van AR over locaties en processen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Bouw interne capaciteit voor AR-contentcreatie en ondersteuning"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Deel resultaten, templates en geleerde lessen tussen teams"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Behandel AR als onderdeel van uw digitale transformatie, niet als losstaand project"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"hoe-ai-en-ar-geleide-werkinstructies-deze-valkuilen-aanpakken",children:["Hoe AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies deze valkuilen aanpakken",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-ai-en-ar-geleide-werkinstructies-deze-valkuilen-aanpakken",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies brengen structuur en traceerbaarheid naar werkvloerprocessen. Door SOP's te digitaliseren en via AR-apparaten te leveren, ontvangen teams:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Stap-voor-stap digitale instructies afgestemd op elke taak"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Visuele cues (afbeeldingen, 3D-modellen, video's) op het juiste moment"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Realtime datavastlegging (bijv. foto's, spraaknotities, checklists)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Geautomatiseerde nalevingscontroles en veiligheidsprompts"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Analytics over taakvoltooiing, fouten en bestede tijd"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AI kan instructies verder personaliseren op basis van operatorervaring, afwijkingen markeren en verbeteringen suggereren."}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Voorbeeld:"})," Een mondiale fabrikant verminderde de inwerktijd voor nieuwe onderhoudstechnici met 30% door AR SOP's te gebruiken, terwijl foutpercentages in kritieke taken met 40% daalden. (Interne case-data, ActARion)"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"praktische-use-cases-voor-ar-sops-op-de-werkvloer",children:["Praktische use cases voor AR SOP's op de werkvloer",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#praktische-use-cases-voor-ar-sops-op-de-werkvloer",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Bedrijven zien meetbare resultaten van AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies in:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Apparatuur-setup en wissels (stilstand verminderen)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Onderhouds- en inspectierondes (traceerbaarheid verbeteren)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Kwaliteitscontroles en documentatie (naleving ondersteunen)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Veiligheidskritieke procedures (verzekeren dat alle stappen worden gevolgd)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Inwerken en bijscholen van nieuwe technici (time-to-competence versnellen)"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Voor elke use case is de sleutel om te starten met een high-impact, herhaalbaar proces en uit te breiden op basis van feedback en resultaten."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"wat-actarion-brengt-naar-industriële-ar-implementaties",children:["Wat ActARion brengt naar industriële AR-implementaties",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wat-actarion-brengt-naar-industriële-ar-implementaties",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion werkt samen met operations-, HSE- en trainingsleiders om deze valkuilen vanaf dag één te vermijden. Onze aanpak omvat:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Gezamenlijke workshops om de juiste hardware voor uw omgeving te selecteren"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Gestructureerde SOP-digitalisatiesprints met uw trainers en operators"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Bewezen verandermanagement-frameworks afgestemd op industriële teams"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Integratie met uw bestaande asset management- en ERP-systemen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Transparante metrics en rapportage om ROI te bewijzen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Een duidelijke roadmap voor opschalen van AR SOP's over locaties en processen"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"We richten ons op meetbare verbeteringen in veiligheid, productiviteit en personeelsgereedheid—niet alleen technologie-adoptie."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"verken-hoe-dit-eruitziet-in-uw-organisatie",children:["Verken hoe dit eruitziet in uw organisatie",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#verken-hoe-dit-eruitziet-in-uw-organisatie",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Om te zien hoe AI en AR-geleide werkinstructies uw teams kunnen helpen de veelvoorkomende valkuilen te vermijden en echte resultaten te leveren, plan een verkennend discovery-gesprek met ActARion. Er is geen verplichting—alleen een praktische blik op wat werkt in uw context."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:n(a.a,{href:"/nl/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR-inwerken voor nieuwe technici"})}),"
",n(a.li,{children:n(a.a,{href:"/nl/use-cases/digital-work-instructions",children:"Digitale werkinstructies in asset-onderhoud"})}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Leer meer over AR in de industrie van McKinsey's analyse"}),"
"]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Typical pitfalls when starting with AR on the shop floor and how to avoid them
description: Understand the common pitfalls when implementing AR on the shop floor and learn practical strategies to ensure a successful rollout in industrial operations.

image.alt: Typical pitfalls when starting with AR on the shop floor and how to avoid them

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"typical-pitfalls-when-starting-with-ar-on-the-shop-floor-and-how-to-avoid-them",children:["Typical pitfalls when starting with AR on the shop floor and how to avoid them",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#typical-pitfalls-when-starting-with-ar-on-the-shop-floor-and-how-to-avoid-them",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) is changing how industrial teams work. But many companies face avoidable pitfalls when starting with AR on the shop floor. Understanding these challenges—and knowing how to avoid them—can mean the difference between a stalled pilot and a measurable improvement in safety, productivity and skills transfer."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"ar-on-the-shop-floor-context-and-urgency",children:["AR on the shop floor: context and urgency",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-on-the-shop-floor-context-and-urgency",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial operations face mounting pressure to improve safety, maintain compliance, and keep uptime high. At the same time, technical teams are aging and new hires often lack hands-on experience. According to McKinsey, AR is being adopted across manufacturing and maintenance to address these gaps by delivering real-time, digital work instructions directly in the field."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"However, moving from a promising AR pilot to broad shop floor deployment is rarely straightforward. Early missteps can stall progress, frustrate teams, and undermine confidence in digital solutions. For operations managers, HSE leads, and training professionals, it’s critical to anticipate these pitfalls and address them head-on."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-ar-initiatives-often-struggle-on-the-shop-floor",children:["Why AR initiatives often struggle on the shop floor",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-ar-initiatives-often-struggle-on-the-shop-floor",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many AR projects do not deliver the expected value. The root causes are practical, not technical. The most common pitfalls include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Choosing AR hardware without operator input"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Underestimating the effort to digitise SOPs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ignoring change management and training needs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lacking clear metrics for success and ROI"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Failing to integrate AR with existing systems and workflows"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Treating AR as a one-off pilot rather than a scalable program"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These issues are not unique to any one sector. Whether in process industries, discrete manufacturing, or field service, the same patterns emerge. Addressing them early is essential for a successful rollout."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-1-choosing-ar-hardware-without-operator-input",children:["Pitfall 1: choosing AR hardware without operator input",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-1-choosing-ar-hardware-without-operator-input",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Selecting the right AR device is not just an IT decision. It’s about how technicians and operators actually work. Common mistakes include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Selecting devices that are too heavy or uncomfortable for all-day use"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Overlooking compatibility with safety gear (e.g., helmets, gloves, eye protection)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ignoring the environmental conditions (dust, moisture, lighting, noise)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Choosing devices with short battery life or unreliable connectivity"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Note:"})," In a 2023 PWC study (2023), 46% of industrial AR pilots failed due to poor hardware fit for the intended work environment."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Involve technicians and safety leads in hardware evaluation and field trials"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Test devices in real production scenarios, not just in the lab"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Prioritise hands-free, voice-controlled options where possible"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Document feedback and iterate before scaling up"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-2-underestimating-the-effort-to-digitise-sops",children:["Pitfall 2: underestimating the effort to digitise SOPs",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-2-underestimating-the-effort-to-digitise-sops",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A common misconception is that existing SOPs can be dropped straight into AR platforms. In reality, most SOPs are written for paper or PDF and need to be rethought for digital, step-by-step guidance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Typical issues include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"SOPs that are too generic or lack actionable detail"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Steps that assume prior knowledge or omit key safety checks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Instructions that do not translate well to visual formats (images, 3D models, videos)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lack of standardisation across similar tasks"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-1",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-1",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Conduct a content audit to identify which SOPs are ready for digitisation"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Work with experienced trainers and operators to break down procedures into granular, auditable steps"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Use AR platforms that make content creation and updates easy for non-IT staff"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Pilot digital work instructions on a high-impact, frequently repeated task before scaling"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-3-ignoring-change-management-and-skills-transfer",children:["Pitfall 3: ignoring change management and skills transfer",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-3-ignoring-change-management-and-skills-transfer",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR is not just another tool—it changes how work gets done. Teams who feel left out of the process may resist adoption or revert to old habits."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common signs of inadequate change management:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Operators revert to paper instructions after initial enthusiasm fades"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supervisors are not trained to coach or monitor digital work"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Training is a one-off event, not a continuous process"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams see AR as an “extra task” rather than a productivity aid"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-2",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-2",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Involve operators, supervisors, and HSE early in the design and rollout"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Provide hands-on, scenario-based AR training (not just classroom sessions)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Appoint AR champions in each team to support peers and gather feedback"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Build AR use into daily routines, audits, and shift handovers"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-4-lacking-clear-metrics-for-success-and-roi",children:["Pitfall 4: lacking clear metrics for success and ROI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-4-lacking-clear-metrics-for-success-and-roi",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Without clear measures, it’s impossible to know if AR is delivering value. Many pilots fail because the goals are vague (“improve efficiency”) or not tracked at all."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Typical oversights:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"No baseline data on task time, error rates, or safety incidents"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Success measured only by user satisfaction, not operational KPIs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"ROI assumptions based on vendor promises, not real data"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-3",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-3",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Define concrete metrics at the pilot stage (e.g., time to complete task, number of errors, incident reports)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Use AR platforms with built-in analytics to track usage and outcomes"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compare before-and-after results on pilot tasks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Report results to stakeholders and use them to refine the rollout"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-5-failing-to-integrate-ar-with-existing-systems-and-workflows",children:["Pitfall 5: failing to integrate AR with existing systems and workflows",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-5-failing-to-integrate-ar-with-existing-systems-and-workflows",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR is most effective when it fits seamlessly into existing workflows. A standalone AR app that requires duplicate data entry or manual syncing creates friction and risk."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common integration issues:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"AR instructions are not linked to asset management or maintenance systems"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Work performed in AR is not logged in the main ERP or CMMS"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Operators must switch between devices or apps to complete a task"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-4",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-4",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Map out the end-to-end workflow before deploying AR"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Choose AR platforms with open APIs and proven integrations (e.g., SAP, Maximo, Infor EAM)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Prioritise use cases where digital work instructions close a real gap (e.g., onboarding, compliance checks, maintenance rounds)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Involve IT and process owners early to address integration and data governance"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-6-treating-ar-as-a-one-off-pilot",children:["Pitfall 6: treating AR as a one-off pilot",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-6-treating-ar-as-a-one-off-pilot",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many organisations run a single AR pilot, then stall. This “pilot purgatory” happens when:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"There’s no plan for scaling successful pilots to other teams or sites"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Knowledge remains with a single project lead or vendor"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lessons learned are not documented or shared"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-5",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-5",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Develop a roadmap for scaling AR across sites and processes"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Build internal capability for AR content creation and support"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Share results, templates, and lessons learned across teams"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Treat AR as part of your digital transformation, not a standalone project"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-address-these-pitfalls",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions address these pitfalls",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-address-these-pitfalls",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions bring structure and traceability to shop floor processes. By digitising SOPs and delivering them through AR devices, teams receive:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Step-by-step digital instructions tailored to each task"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Visual cues (images, 3D models, videos) at the right moment"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Real-time data capture (e.g., photos, voice notes, checklists)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Automated compliance checks and safety prompts"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Analytics on task completion, errors, and time spent"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI can further personalise instructions based on operator experience, flag anomalies, and suggest improvements."}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Example:"})," A global manufacturer reduced onboarding time for new maintenance technicians by 30% using AR SOPs, while also cutting error rates in critical tasks by 40%. (Internal case data, ActARion)"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"practical-use-cases-for-ar-sops-on-the-shop-floor",children:["Practical use cases for AR SOPs on the shop floor",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-use-cases-for-ar-sops-on-the-shop-floor",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Companies are seeing measurable results from AI and AR–guided work instructions in:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Equipment setup and changeovers (reducing downtime)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Maintenance and inspection rounds (improving traceability)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Quality checks and documentation (supporting compliance)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Safety-critical procedures (ensuring all steps are followed)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Onboarding and upskilling new technicians (speeding time-to-competence)"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For each use case, the key is to start with a high-impact, repeatable process and expand based on feedback and results."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-ar-deployments",children:["What ActARion brings to industrial AR deployments",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-ar-deployments",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion works with operations, HSE, and training leaders to avoid these pitfalls from day one. Our approach includes:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["

",n(t.p,{children:"We focus on measurable improvements in safety, productivity, and workforce readiness—not just technology adoption."}),"

description: Wie Industrieteams AR für Wissensaustausch über Schichten, Standorte und Länder nutzen, um Sicherheit, Produktivität und Mitarbeiterbereitschaft zu verbessern.

body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"ar-für-wissensaustausch-über-schichten-standorte-und-länder-nutzen",children:["AR für Wissensaustausch über Schichten, Standorte und Länder nutzen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-für-wissensaustausch-über-schichten-standorte-und-länder-nutzen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrieunternehmen stehen unter konstantem Druck, Produktivität, Sicherheit und Qualität aufrechtzuerhalten, während sie komplexe Operationen über mehrere Standorte managen. AR für Wissensaustausch über Schichten, Standorte und Länder zu nutzen hilft Teams, Expertise direkt am Arbeitsplatz zu erfassen und zu übertragen, wodurch Fehler und Ausfallzeiten reduziert werden."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"die-herausforderung-des-wissensaustauschs-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:["Die Herausforderung des Wissensaustauschs in industriellen Umgebungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#die-herausforderung-des-wissensaustauschs-in-industriellen-umgebungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrielle Betriebe stehen selten still. Teams arbeiten rund um die Uhr, oft über verschiedene Schichten und Standorte. Ausrüstung, Verfahren und Vorschriften variieren zwischen Standorten und Ländern, während erfahrene Techniker in Rente gehen oder Rollen wechseln. Das lässt viele Unternehmen kämpfen, um:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Verfahren und Best Practices über Standorte zu standardisieren"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Neue Mitarbeiter und Zeitpersonal effizient einzuarbeiten"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Wiederkehrende Fehler durch inkonsistenten Wissenstransfer zu verhindern"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compliance mit sich ständig ändernden Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards sicherzustellen"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionelle Methoden—Papierhandbücher, statische digitale Dokumente, Präsenztraining—können mit dem Tempo und der Komplexität moderner Industriearbeit nicht mithalten. Laut einem Bericht des World Economic Forum aus 2023 gehören Qualifikationslücken und schlechter Wissenstransfer zu den fünf größten Risiken für Fertigungs- und Prozessindustrien weltweit."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-wissensaustausch-jetzt-geändert-werden-muss",children:["Warum Wissensaustausch jetzt geändert werden muss",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-wissensaustausch-jetzt-geändert-werden-muss",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Mehrere Branchentrends machen effektiven Wissensaustausch zu einer kritischen Priorität:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Alternde Belegschaft:"})," Viele erfahrene Techniker nähern sich dem Ruhestand und nehmen Jahrzehnte implizites Wissen mit."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Globalisierung:"})," Operationen erstrecken sich über mehrere Länder, Sprachen und regulatorische Umgebungen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Erhöhte Komplexität:"})," Ausrüstung, Prozesse und Compliance-Anforderungen entwickeln sich weiter."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hohe Fluktuation:"})," Zeit- und Vertragsarbeiter füllen Lücken, haben aber oft keine standortspezifische Expertise."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote- und Hybridarbeit:"})," Reisebeschränkungen und verteilte Teams erfordern neue Wege zur Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitigen Unterstützung."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Die Kosten, diese Herausforderungen nicht anzugehen, sind signifikant. Studien der Aberdeen Group zeigen, dass schlechter Wissenstransfer zu bis zu 20% höheren Betriebskosten, vermehrten Sicherheitsvorfällen und längeren Ausfallzeiten bei Schichtwechseln oder nach Personalfluktuation führen kann."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-ar-und-ki-geführte-arbeitsanweisungen-wissensaustausch-unterstützen",children:["Wie AR und KI-geführte Arbeitsanweisungen Wissensaustausch unterstützen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ar-und-ki-geführte-arbeitsanweisungen-wissensaustausch-unterstützen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR (Augmented Reality) kombiniert mit KI-geführten Arbeitsanweisungen bietet eine praktische Lösung zur Erfassung, Standardisierung und Weitergabe von Expertise über Schichten, Standorte und Landesgrenzen hinweg. So funktioniert es:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Visuelle SOPs:"})," AR überlagert digitale Arbeitsanweisungen, Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen und Checklisten direkt auf Ausrüstung oder Arbeitsbereiche, wodurch Mehrdeutigkeit reduziert wird."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Kontextbewusste Unterstützung:"})," KI passt Anweisungen basierend auf Geräteversion, Bedienererfahrung oder lokalen Vorschriften an."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote-Zusammenarbeit:"})," Experten können Teams in Echtzeit unterstützen, unabhängig vom Standort, mit AR-fähigen Geräten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Automatische Dokumentation:"})," Während Teams Aufgaben erledigen, können Systeme Aktionen für Compliance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung protokollieren."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Mehrsprachige Unterstützung:"})," Anweisungen können in mehreren Sprachen geliefert werden, angepasst an die Belegschaft an jedem Standort."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Dieser Ansatz geht über statische Dokumente und einmalige Schulungssitzungen hinaus und bettet Wissen direkt in tägliche Workflows ein."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wichtige-anwendungsfälle-für-ar-wissensaustausch-über-schichten-und-standorte",children:["Wichtige Anwendungsfälle für AR-Wissensaustausch über Schichten und Standorte",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wichtige-anwendungsfälle-für-ar-wissensaustausch-über-schichten-und-standorte",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"wartungsverfahren-standardisieren",children:["Wartungsverfahren standardisieren",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wartungsverfahren-standardisieren",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Ein globales Chemieunternehmen betreibt Anlagen in Europa und Asien. Durch AR-SOPs stellen sie sicher, dass jeder Wartungstechniker, unabhängig von Standort oder Schicht, dieselben validierten Verfahren für kritische Pumpeninspektionen befolgt. Visuelle Overlays heben exakte Komponenten, Drehmomente und Sicherheitsüberprüfungen hervor, reduzieren Fehler und verbessern die Auditbereitschaft. Wenn ein Pumpenmodell aktualisiert wird, werden Anweisungen zentral aktualisiert und sofort an alle Standorte ausgerollt."}),"

title: AR gebruiken voor kennisdeling over ploegen, locaties en landen
description: Hoe industriële teams AR gebruiken voor kennisdeling over ploegen, locaties en landen om veiligheid, productiviteit en personeelsgereedheid te verbeteren.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"ar-gebruiken-voor-kennisdeling-over-ploegen-locaties-en-landen",children:["AR gebruiken voor kennisdeling over ploegen, locaties en landen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-gebruiken-voor-kennisdeling-over-ploegen-locaties-en-landen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële bedrijven staan onder constante druk om productiviteit, veiligheid en kwaliteit te handhaven terwijl ze complexe operaties beheren over meerdere locaties. AR gebruiken voor kennisdeling over ploegen, locaties en landen helpt teams expertise direct op de werkvloer vast te leggen en over te dragen, waardoor fouten en stilstand worden verminderd."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"de-uitdaging-van-kennisdeling-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:["De uitdaging van kennisdeling in industriële omgevingen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#de-uitdaging-van-kennisdeling-in-industriële-omgevingen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industriële operaties stoppen zelden. Teams werken 24 uur per dag, vaak over verschillende ploegen en locaties. Apparatuur, procedures en regelgeving variëren tussen locaties en landen, terwijl ervaren technici met pensioen gaan of van rol veranderen. Dit laat veel bedrijven worstelen om:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Procedures en best practices te standaardiseren over locaties"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Nieuwe medewerkers en tijdelijk personeel efficiënt in te werken"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Terugkerende fouten te voorkomen veroorzaakt door inconsistente kennisoverdracht"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Naleving te verzekeren van steeds veranderende veiligheids- en kwaliteitsstandaarden"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionele methoden—papieren handleidingen, statische digitale documenten, klassikale training—kunnen het tempo en de complexiteit van modern industrieel werk niet bijhouden. Volgens een rapport uit 2023 van het World Economic Forum behoren vaardigheidskloven en slechte kennisoverdracht tot de top vijf risico's voor productie- en procesindustrieën wereldwijd."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-kennisdeling-nu-moet-veranderen",children:["Waarom kennisdeling nu moet veranderen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-kennisdeling-nu-moet-veranderen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Verschillende industrietrends maken effectieve kennisdeling een kritieke prioriteit:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Vergrijzend personeelsbestand:"})," Veel ervaren technici naderen pensioen en nemen decennia aan impliciete kennis met zich mee."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Globalisering:"})," Operaties beslaan meerdere landen, talen en regelgevingsomgevingen."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Toegenomen complexiteit:"})," Apparatuur, processen en nalevingsvereisten blijven evolueren."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hoog verloop:"})," Tijdelijk en contractpersoneel vullen gaten maar missen vaak locatiespecifieke expertise."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote en hybride werk:"})," Reisbeperkingen en gedistribueerde teams vereisen nieuwe manieren om samen te werken en elkaar te ondersteunen."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"De kosten van het niet aanpakken van deze uitdagingen zijn significant. ",n(t.p,{children:"AR (augmented reality) gecombineerd met AI-geleide werkinstructies biedt een praktische oplossing voor het vastleggen, standaardiseren en delen van expertise over ploegen, locaties en landsgrenzen. Zo werkt het:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Visuele SOP's:"})," AR legt digitale werkinstructies, stap-voor-stap gidsen en checklists direct over apparatuur of werkruimtes, wat ambiguïteit vermindert."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Contextbewuste ondersteuning:"})," AI past instructies aan op basis van apparatuurversie, operatorervaring of lokale regelgeving."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote samenwerking:"})," Experts kunnen teams realtime ondersteunen, ongeacht locatie, met AR-enabled apparaten."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Automatische documentatie:"})," Terwijl teams taken voltooien, kunnen systemen acties loggen voor naleving en continue verbetering."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Meertalige ondersteuning:"})," Instructies kunnen in meerdere talen worden geleverd, afgestemd op het personeel op elke locatie."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Deze aanpak gaat verder dan statische documenten en eenmalige trainingssessies, en integreert kennis direct in dagelijkse workflows."}),"
