",n(s.p,{children:"Die Erfassung von Unternehmenswissen mit AR-Arbeitsanweisungen erfordert kein massives Projekt. Hier ist eine praktische Roadmap:"}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"1-kritische-verfahren-identifizieren",children:["1. Kritische Verfahren identifizieren",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-kritische-verfahren-identifizieren",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Arbeiten Sie mit Operations-, Wartungs- und Qualitätsteams zusammen, um die Verfahren zu identifizieren, bei denen Expertenwissen am kritischsten ist—und wo Wissensverlust die größten Auswirkungen hätte."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"2-nach-risiko-und-verfügbarkeit-priorisieren",children:["2. Nach Risiko und Verfügbarkeit priorisieren",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-nach-risiko-und-verfügbarkeit-priorisieren",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Konzentrieren Sie sich zuerst auf Verfahren, die von Experten durchgeführt werden, die kurz vor der Rente stehen, oder wo Wissen bei einer einzigen Person konzentriert ist. Das sind Ihre Höchstrisikobereiche."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"3-mit-minimaler-störung-erfassen",children:["3. Mit minimaler Störung erfassen",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-mit-minimaler-störung-erfassen",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Statten Sie Experten mit AR-Geräten (Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Smartphones) aus und lassen Sie sie die Aufgabe wie gewohnt ausführen. Das System erfasst die Ausführung in Echtzeit, ohne ihren Workflow zu stören."}),"

",n(s.p,{children:"Machen Sie die AR-Arbeitsanweisung in Ihrer digitalen Bibliothek verfügbar. Schulen Sie Teams, wie sie darauf zugreifen und sie nutzen können. Aktualisieren Sie, wenn sich Prozesse weiterentwickeln."}),"

",n(s.p,{children:"Das Ergebnis: Ein umfassender, visueller Leitfaden, der jedem Techniker zur Verfügung steht. Die Einarbeitungszeit für das Verfahren sank um 40%, und Fehler bei Dichtungsaustauschen wurden eliminiert."}),"

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"bedrijfsgeheugen-vastleggen-met-ar-werkinstructies-voordat-experts-met-pensioen-gaan",children:["Bedrijfsgeheugen vastleggen met AR-werkinstructies voordat experts met pensioen gaan",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#bedrijfsgeheugen-vastleggen-met-ar-werkinstructies-voordat-experts-met-pensioen-gaan",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Elke industriële organisatie is afhankelijk van een klein aantal experts die echt begrijpen hoe dingen werken. Dit zijn de technici die een probleem kunnen diagnosticeren op geluid, de operators die precies weten hoe ze een temperamentvolle machine aan de praat krijgen, de engineers die zich herinneren waarom een bepaalde instelling decennia geleden is gekozen. Wanneer deze experts met pensioen gaan of vertrekken, nemen ze onvervangbare kennis mee."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR-werkinstructies bieden een praktische, schaalbare manier om deze expertise vast te leggen voordat het de deur uit loopt—en het toegankelijk te maken voor elk teamlid, on demand."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"het-verborgen-risico-van-kennisverlies",children:["Het verborgen risico van kennisverlies",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#het-verborgen-risico-van-kennisverlies",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Kennisverlies is een van de meest onderschatte risico's in industriële operaties. Wanneer deze medewerkers vertrekken, zijn de gevolgen reëel:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Langere troubleshootingtijden"})," doordat minder ervaren personeel worstelt met diagnoses"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Meer fouten en herwerk"})," door lacunes in procedurele kennis"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hoger veiligheidsrisico"})," wanneer kritieke stappen worden vergeten of verkeerd begrepen"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Trager inwerken"})," voor nieuwe medewerkers die geen toegang hebben tot expertbegeleiding"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionele documentatiemethoden—papieren SOP's, video-opnames, meelopen—leggen slechts een fractie vast van wat experts weten. Veel van hun kennis is contextueel, situationeel en moeilijk in woorden uit te drukken."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"waarom-ar-werkinstructies-kennis-anders-vastleggen",children:["Waarom AR-werkinstructies kennis anders vastleggen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-ar-werkinstructies-kennis-anders-vastleggen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR-werkinstructies veranderen fundamenteel hoe expertkennis wordt vastgelegd en gedeeld:"}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"In plaats van experts te vragen te beschrijven wat ze doen, laten AR-werkinstructies hen het demonstreren—stap voor stap, in de echte werkomgeving. Het systeem legt hun acties, beelden, spraaknotities en annotaties vast terwijl ze de taak uitvoeren."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:'Experts kunnen tips, waarschuwingen, best practices en redenering toevoegen—het "waarom" achter elke stap—dat zelden in traditionele SOP's terechtkomt.'}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"kennis-toegankelijk-maken",children:["Kennis toegankelijk maken",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#kennis-toegankelijk-maken",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Eenmaal vastgelegd zijn AR-werkinstructies beschikbaar voor elke operator, op elk apparaat, in meerdere talen. Kennis is niet langer opgesloten in het hoofd van één persoon."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"een-praktische-aanpak-voor-het-vastleggen-van-expertkennis",children:["Een praktische aanpak voor het vastleggen van expertkennis",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#een-praktische-aanpak-voor-het-vastleggen-van-expertkennis",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Het vastleggen van bedrijfsgeheugen met AR-werkinstructies vereist geen massaal project. Hier is een praktische roadmap:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"1-identificeer-kritieke-procedures",children:["1. Identificeer kritieke procedures",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-identificeer-kritieke-procedures",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Werk samen met operations-, onderhouds- en kwaliteitsteams om de procedures te identificeren waar expertkennis het meest kritiek is—en waar kennisverlies de grootste impact zou hebben."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"2-prioriteer-op-risico-en-beschikbaarheid",children:["2. Prioriteer op risico en beschikbaarheid",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-prioriteer-op-risico-en-beschikbaarheid",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Focus eerst op procedures uitgevoerd door experts die dicht bij pensioen zijn, of waar kennis geconcentreerd is bij één persoon. Dit zijn uw hoogste-risico gebieden."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"3-leg-vast-met-minimale-verstoring",children:["3. Leg vast met minimale verstoring",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-leg-vast-met-minimale-verstoring",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Voorzie experts van AR-apparaten (smart glasses, tablets of smartphones) en laat hen de taak uitvoeren zoals ze normaal zouden doen. Het systeem legt de uitvoering realtime vast, zonder hun workflow te verstoren."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"4-valideer-en-verrijk",children:["4. Valideer en verrijk",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-valideer-en-verrijk",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Review de vastgelegde content met de expert. Voeg verduidelijkingen, waarschuwingen en tips toe. Valideer met andere operators of trainers om volledigheid te verzekeren."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"5-publiceer-en-train",children:["5. Publiceer en train",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-publiceer-en-train",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Maak de AR-werkinstructie beschikbaar in uw digitale bibliotheek. Train teams over hoe ze deze kunnen raadplegen en gebruiken. Update naarmate processen evolueren."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"real-world-voorbeeld-onderhoudsexpertise-behouden",children:["Real-world voorbeeld: onderhoudsexpertise behouden",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-voorbeeld-onderhoudsexpertise-behouden",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Een chemische fabriek stond voor het pensioen van haar lead compressortechnicus—de enige persoon die de complexe sealafdichtingsvervangingsprocedure volledig begreep. Eerdere pogingen om het proces in papieren SOP's te documenteren waren mislukt; de geschreven instructies waren incompleet en verwarrend voor andere technici."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Met AR-werkinstructies voerde de expert de sealvervanging uit terwijl hij smart glasses droeg. Het systeem legde video, beelden en spraaknotities vast bij elke stap. AI-tools hielpen de content te structureren in een duidelijke, stap-voor-stap AR SOP."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Het resultaat: een uitgebreide, visuele gids beschikbaar voor elke technicus. Inwerktijd voor de procedure daalde met 40%, en fouten tijdens sealvervangingen werden geëlimineerd."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"wie-moet-kennisvasleggingsinitiatieven-leiden",children:["Wie moet kennisvasleggingsinitiatieven leiden?",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-moet-kennisvasleggingsinitiatieven-leiden",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Het vastleggen van bedrijfsgeheugen met AR-werkinstructies wordt typisch geleid door:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Onderhoudsmanagers"})," verantwoordelijk voor het behoud van technische expertise"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"HR en L&D-leiders"})," gericht op het verminderen van kennissverliesrisico"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Operations managers"})," die procedurele consistentie verzekeren"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Kwaliteitsmanagers"})," die best practices documenteren voor naleving"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"aan-de-slag",children:["Aan de slag",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#aan-de-slag",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Als u het bedrijfsgeheugen van uw organisatie wilt beschermen met AR-werkinstructies, begin dan met het identificeren van uw hoogste-risico procedures en uw meest waardevolle experts. Een gerichte pilot kan snel waarde demonstreren en momentum opbouwen voor bredere adoptie."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Leer meer over ",n(t.a,{href:"/nl/ar-work-instructions-corporate-memory",children:"AR-werkinstructies en SOP's om bedrijfsgeheugen te behouden"})," of ",n(t.a,{href:"/nl/contact",children:"neem contact op met ActARion"})," om uw kennisvasleggingsuitdagingen te bespreken."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Capturing corporate memory with AR work instructions before experts retire
description: Learn how to capture and preserve expert knowledge using AR work instructions before experienced staff retire, protecting your operations from knowledge loss.

image.alt: Capturing corporate memory with AR work instructions before experts retire

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h1,{id:"capturing-corporate-memory-with-ar-work-instructions-before-experts-retire",children:["Capturing corporate memory with AR work instructions before experts retire",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#capturing-corporate-memory-with-ar-work-instructions-before-experts-retire",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Every industrial organisation depends on a small number of experts who truly understand how things work. These are the technicians who can diagnose a problem by sound, the operators who know exactly how to coax a temperamental machine into compliance, the engineers who remember why a certain setting was chosen decades ago. When these experts retire or leave, they take irreplaceable knowledge with them."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR work instructions offer a practical, scalable way to capture this expertise before it walks out the door—and make it accessible to every team member, on demand."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"the-hidden-risk-of-knowledge-loss",children:["The hidden risk of knowledge loss",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-hidden-risk-of-knowledge-loss",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Knowledge loss is one of the most underestimated risks in industrial operations. Studies suggest that up to 70% of organisational knowledge is tacit—held in the heads of experienced employees rather than written down. When these employees leave, the consequences are real:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Longer troubleshooting times"})," as less experienced staff struggle to diagnose issues"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"More errors and rework"})," due to gaps in procedural knowledge"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Higher safety risk"})," when critical steps are forgotten or misunderstood"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Slower onboarding"})," for new hires who lack access to expert guidance"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditional documentation methods—paper SOPs, video recordings, shadowing—capture only a fraction of what experts know. Much of their knowledge is contextual, situational and hard to express in words."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-ar-work-instructions-capture-knowledge-differently",children:["Why AR work instructions capture knowledge differently",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-ar-work-instructions-capture-knowledge-differently",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR work instructions fundamentally change how expert knowledge is captured and shared:"}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"capture-in-context",children:["Capture in context",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#capture-in-context",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Instead of asking experts to describe what they do, AR work instructions let them demonstrate it—step by step, in the real work environment. The system records their actions, images, voice notes and annotations as they perform the task."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"structure-automatically",children:["Structure automatically",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#structure-automatically",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI-powered tools help structure captured content into clear, sequential steps. Gaps and inconsistencies are flagged, prompting experts to fill in missing details."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"enrich-with-tacit-knowledge",children:["Enrich with tacit knowledge",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#enrich-with-tacit-knowledge",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:'Experts can add tips, warnings, best practices and reasoning—the "why" behind each step—that rarely makes it into traditional SOPs.'}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"make-knowledge-accessible",children:["Make knowledge accessible",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#make-knowledge-accessible",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Once captured, AR work instructions are available to any operator, on any device, in multiple languages. Knowledge is no longer locked in one person's head."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"a-practical-approach-to-capturing-expert-knowledge",children:["A practical approach to capturing expert knowledge",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#a-practical-approach-to-capturing-expert-knowledge",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Capturing corporate memory with AR work instructions does not require a massive project. Here is a practical roadmap:"}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"1-identify-critical-procedures",children:["1. Identify critical procedures",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-identify-critical-procedures",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Work with operations, maintenance and quality teams to list the procedures where expert knowledge is most critical—and where knowledge loss would have the greatest impact."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"2-prioritise-by-risk-and-availability",children:["2. Prioritise by risk and availability",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-prioritise-by-risk-and-availability",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Focus first on procedures performed by experts who are close to retirement, or where knowledge is concentrated in a single person. These are your highest-risk areas."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"3-capture-with-minimal-disruption",children:["3. Capture with minimal disruption",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-capture-with-minimal-disruption",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Equip experts with AR devices (smart glasses, tablets or smartphones) and let them perform the task as they normally would. The system captures the execution in real time, without disrupting their workflow."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"4-validate-and-enrich",children:["4. Validate and enrich",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-validate-and-enrich",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Review the captured content with the expert. Add clarifications, warnings and tips. Validate with other operators or trainers to ensure completeness."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"5-publish-and-train",children:["5. Publish and train",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-publish-and-train",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Make the AR work instruction available in your digital library. Train teams on how to access and use it. Update as processes evolve."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"real-world-example-preserving-maintenance-expertise",children:["Real-world example: preserving maintenance expertise",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-example-preserving-maintenance-expertise",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A chemical plant faced the retirement of its lead compressor technician—the only person who fully understood the complex seal replacement procedure. Previous attempts to document the process in paper SOPs had failed; the written instructions were incomplete and confusing to other technicians."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Using AR work instructions, the expert performed the seal replacement while wearing smart glasses. The system captured video, images and voice notes at each step. AI tools helped structure the content into a clear, step-by-step AR SOP."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The result: a comprehensive, visual guide available to every technician. Onboarding time for the procedure dropped by 40%, and errors during seal replacements were eliminated."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"who-should-lead-knowledge-capture-initiatives",children:["Who should lead knowledge capture initiatives?",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#who-should-lead-knowledge-capture-initiatives",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Capturing corporate memory with AR work instructions is typically led by:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Maintenance managers"})," responsible for preserving technical expertise"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"HR and L&D leaders"})," focused on reducing knowledge loss risk"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Operations managers"})," ensuring procedural consistency"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Quality managers"})," documenting best practices for compliance"]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"getting-started",children:["Getting started",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#getting-started",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If you want to protect your organisation's corporate memory with AR work instructions, start by identifying your highest-risk procedures and your most valuable experts. A focused pilot can demonstrate value quickly and build momentum for broader adoption."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/ar-work-instructions-corporate-memory",children:"AR work instructions and SOPs to preserve corporate memory"})," or ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"contact ActARion"})," to discuss your knowledge capture challenges."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:r}=e.components||{};return r?n(r,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",table:"table",tbody:"tbody",td:"td",th:"th",thead:"thead",tr:"tr",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h1,{id:"checklist-is-your-assembly-process-ready-for-ar-work-instructions",children:["Checklist: is your assembly process ready for AR work instructions?",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#checklist-is-your-assembly-process-ready-for-ar-work-instructions",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR work instructions can dramatically reduce assembly errors, improve consistency and accelerate onboarding. But not every assembly process is equally ready for AR—and a poorly planned implementation can waste time and resources."}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Are assembly tasks documented as step-by-step procedures?"}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"Would visual overlays, arrows or 3D models help operators understand what to do?"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Are there frequent errors related to orientation, placement or identification?"}),"
"]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:n(t.strong,{children:"Ask yourself:"})}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"How many product variants do operators handle?"}),"

",n(t.p,{children:n(t.strong,{children:"Ask yourself:"})}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Are you required to document assembly steps for audits or compliance?"}),"

",r(t.h3,{id:"anomalie-warnungen",children:["Anomalie-Warnungen",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#anomalie-warnungen",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Wenn Muster klar werden, kann Wartung von zeitbasierten Plänen zu zustandsbasierten Auslösern wechseln. Arbeitsaufträge werden generiert, wenn Daten anzeigen, dass Wartung erforderlich ist—nicht nach einem festen Kalender."}),"

description: Hoe integratie van sensor- en IoT-data met AR-geleide onderhoudswerkinstructies slimmer, effectiever preventief en voorspellend onderhoud creëert.

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"sensordata-verbinden-met-ar-geleide-onderhoudsstappen",children:["Sensordata verbinden met AR-geleide onderhoudsstappen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#sensordata-verbinden-met-ar-geleide-onderhoudsstappen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

Deze sensordata bevat waardevolle inzichten over de gezondheid van apparatuur. Maar te vaak blijft het losgekoppeld van de technici die onderhoud uitvoeren."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Sensordata verbinden met AR-geleide onderhoudsstappen overbrugt deze kloof. Technici zien realtime apparatuurdata in context, wat slimmere beslissingen, gerichte interventies en een pad naar voorspellend onderhoud mogelijk maakt."}),"

"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"AR-werkinstructies kunnen live sensorreading in het gezichtsveld van de technicus weergeven—temperatuur, druk, trilling—over de daadwerkelijke apparatuur. Technici zien de data in context, zonder te schakelen tussen schermen."}),"

"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Sensorreadings kunnen automatisch worden vastgelegd als onderdeel van het onderhoudsrecord—geen handmatige invoer vereist. Dit creëert een rijke dataset die onderhoudsactiviteiten koppelt aan apparatuurconditie."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"anomaliewaarschuwingen",children:["Anomaliewaarschuwingen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#anomaliewaarschuwingen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

title: Connecting sensor data to AR-guided maintenance steps
description: How integrating sensor and IoT data with AR-guided maintenance work instructions creates smarter, more effective preventive and predictive maintenance.

image.alt: Connecting sensor data to AR-guided maintenance steps

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:a}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return a(e,{children:[a(t.h1,{id:"connecting-sensor-data-to-ar-guided-maintenance-steps",children:["Connecting sensor data to AR-guided maintenance steps",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#connecting-sensor-data-to-ar-guided-maintenance-steps",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Modern industrial equipment generates vast amounts of data—vibration levels, temperatures, pressures, cycle counts, error codes. This sensor data holds valuable insights about equipment health. But too often, it remains disconnected from the technicians who perform maintenance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Connecting sensor data to AR-guided maintenance steps bridges this gap. Technicians see real-time equipment data in context, enabling smarter decisions, targeted interventions and a path toward predictive maintenance."}),"
",a(t.h2,{id:"the-disconnect-between-data-and-execution",children:["The disconnect between data and execution",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-disconnect-between-data-and-execution",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many organisations collect sensor data but struggle to make it actionable:"}),"
",a(t.ul,{children:["
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Data in silos:"})," Sensor data lives in SCADA, historian or IoT platforms, separate from maintenance systems"]}),"
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Limited technician access:"})," Technicians may not have easy access to relevant data during maintenance tasks"]}),"
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Interpretation challenges:"})," Raw data requires analysis to be meaningful—technicians need insights, not numbers"]}),"
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reactive use:"})," Data is often reviewed after failures, not used proactively during maintenance"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This disconnect means valuable data is underutilised, and maintenance remains largely reactive."}),"
",a(t.h2,{id:"how-ar-integrates-sensor-data-into-maintenance",children:["How AR integrates sensor data into maintenance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-integrates-sensor-data-into-maintenance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR-guided maintenance can bridge the gap between sensor data and execution:"}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"real-time-data-display",children:["Real-time data display",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-time-data-display",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR work instructions can display live sensor readings in the technician's field of view—temperature, pressure, vibration—overlaid on the actual equipment. Technicians see the data in context, without switching between screens."}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"condition-based-prompts",children:["Condition-based prompts",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#condition-based-prompts",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR systems can use sensor data to guide maintenance dynamically. For example:"}),"
",a(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"If vibration exceeds a threshold, prompt additional inspection steps"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"If temperature is within range, skip a check that is not needed"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"If cycle count reaches a milestone, trigger a specific maintenance task"}),"
"]}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"automatic-data-logging",children:["Automatic data logging",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#automatic-data-logging",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Sensor readings can be captured automatically as part of the maintenance record—no manual entry required. This creates a rich data set linking maintenance activities to equipment condition."}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"anomaly-alerts",children:["Anomaly alerts",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#anomaly-alerts",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If sensors detect unusual conditions during maintenance, the AR system can alert the technician immediately. This enables real-time response to emerging issues."}),"
",a(t.h2,{id:"the-path-to-predictive-maintenance",children:["The path to predictive maintenance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-path-to-predictive-maintenance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Connecting sensor data to AR-guided maintenance is a stepping stone toward predictive maintenance:"}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"build-a-linked-data-set",children:["Build a linked data set",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#build-a-linked-data-set",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Each maintenance task creates a record that combines execution data (what the technician did) with condition data (what the sensors reported). Over time, this builds a rich data set for analysis."}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"identify-patterns",children:["Identify patterns",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#identify-patterns",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Analytics can reveal patterns—correlations between sensor readings and maintenance outcomes, early warning signs of failure, optimal maintenance intervals."}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"trigger-maintenance-proactively",children:["Trigger maintenance proactively",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trigger-maintenance-proactively",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"As patterns become clear, maintenance can shift from time-based schedules to condition-based triggers. Work orders are generated when data indicates maintenance is needed—not on a fixed calendar."}),"
",a(t.h3,{id:"continuous-improvement",children:["Continuous improvement",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#continuous-improvement",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The feedback loop continues. Maintenance outcomes inform sensor thresholds. Sensor data refines maintenance procedures. The system gets smarter over time."}),"
",a(t.h2,{id:"real-world-example-pump-monitoring-in-manufacturing",children:["Real-world example: pump monitoring in manufacturing",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-example-pump-monitoring-in-manufacturing",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A manufacturing plant installed vibration sensors on critical pumps. Data was collected but rarely reviewed until after failures."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"By integrating sensor data with AR-guided maintenance:"}),"
",a(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Technicians saw live vibration data during inspections"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"AR prompts guided additional checks when vibration exceeded thresholds"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Sensor readings were logged automatically with each maintenance task"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Results after one year:"}),"
",a(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Early detection of bearing wear increased by 60%"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Unplanned pump failures dropped by 40%"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Maintenance intervals were optimised based on actual condition data"}),"
"]}),"
",a(t.h2,{id:"keys-to-success",children:["Keys to success",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#keys-to-success",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"To connect sensor data effectively to AR-guided maintenance:"}),"
",a(t.ul,{children:["
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Start with high-value assets:"})," Focus on equipment where sensor data and condition-based maintenance will have the greatest impact"]}),"
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Define meaningful thresholds:"})," Work with reliability engineers to set thresholds that trigger appropriate actions"]}),"
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Make data accessible:"})," Ensure the AR platform can access relevant sensor data in real time"]}),"
",a(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Train technicians:"})," Help technicians understand what the data means and how to respond"]}),"
"]}),"
",a(t.h2,{id:"getting-started",children:["Getting started",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#getting-started",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If your organisation collects sensor data but struggles to make it actionable, connecting it to AR-guided maintenance can help. Start with a pilot on high-value assets, integrate relevant data streams and build from there."}),"
",a(t.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/ar-preventive-maintenance",children:"AR preventive maintenance with data-driven insights"})," or ",n(t.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"contact ActARion"})," to discuss your sensor integration goals."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:a}=e.components||{};return a?n(a,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

",n(t.p,{children:"Every manufacturing operation has them: the hero operators. The ones everyone calls when a difficult changeover is coming up. The ones who somehow get the line running when no one else can. The ones whose shifts have noticeably better performance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Hero operators are valuable—but relying on them is risky. When they are unavailable, sick or on vacation, changeover times balloon and errors spike. Their expertise is concentrated in a few individuals, not embedded in the organisation."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Traditional attempts to address the hero operator problem often fall short:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Documentation:"})," Heroes are asked to write down what they do, but tacit knowledge is hard to express in words"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Training:"})," Heroes train others, but the transfer is incomplete and inconsistent"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Shadowing:"})," Operators shadow heroes, but this is time-consuming and depends on hero availability"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These approaches capture some knowledge, but they do not create true standardisation."}),"

",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Build digital work instructions:"})," Structure the captured content into clear, visual, step-by-step procedures."]}),"

",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Consistent changeover times:"})," Variability between operators drops dramatically"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reduced dependence on individuals:"})," Any trained operator can perform changeovers reliably"]}),"

"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The heroes are no longer bottlenecks—they are the foundation of a standardised, scalable capability."}),"

title: From paper SOPs to AR SOPs: reducing assembly errors on the line
description: How industrial teams are migrating from paper SOPs to AR SOPs on assembly lines, and the error reduction results they are achieving.

image.alt: From paper SOPs to AR SOPs: reducing assembly errors on the line

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"from-paper-sops-to-ar-sops-reducing-assembly-errors-on-the-line",children:["From paper SOPs to AR SOPs: reducing assembly errors on the line",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#from-paper-sops-to-ar-sops-reducing-assembly-errors-on-the-line",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

But in today's complex manufacturing environments, paper SOPs struggle to keep up. Assembly errors, rework and quality escapes persist—despite best efforts to improve documentation."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR SOPs offer a fundamentally different approach. By delivering visual, step-by-step guidance directly at the workstation, they reduce ambiguity, prevent errors and create a digital record of every build. ",r(a.h2,{id:"why-paper-sops-fall-short-on-assembly-lines",children:["Why paper SOPs fall short on assembly lines",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-paper-sops-fall-short-on-assembly-lines",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Paper SOPs have inherent limitations that contribute to assembly errors:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"interpretation-required",children:["Interpretation required",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#interpretation-required",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'Paper instructions describe what to do, but leave operators to interpret how. Phrases like "attach component A to bracket B" leave room for error—which orientation? Which fastener? Which torque?'}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"out-of-context",children:["Out of context",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#out-of-context",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Paper SOPs are separate from the work. Operators must read the instruction, remember it, then look at the assembly. This mental context-switching introduces errors, especially for complex tasks."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"version-control-challenges",children:["Version control challenges",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#version-control-challenges",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Keeping paper SOPs current is a constant struggle. Outdated versions circulate, and operators may unknowingly follow obsolete procedures."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"no-verification",children:["No verification",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#no-verification",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Paper checklists confirm that a step was marked complete—not that it was done correctly. Errors can slip through undetected until final inspection or customer complaints."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-sops-address-these-limitations",children:["How AR SOPs address these limitations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-sops-address-these-limitations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR SOPs bring instructions directly into the operator's field of view, overlaid on the actual assembly:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"visual-unambiguous-guidance",children:["Visual, unambiguous guidance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#visual-unambiguous-guidance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR overlays show exactly where to place a component, which fastener to use and how to orient it. There is no interpretation required—guidance is visual and precise."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"in-context-instruction",children:["In-context instruction",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#in-context-instruction",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Operators see what to do while looking at the assembly. There is no context-switching between reading and doing."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"instant-updates",children:["Instant updates",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#instant-updates",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"When procedures change, AR SOPs are updated centrally and deployed instantly. Every operator sees the current version, every time."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"built-in-verification",children:["Built-in verification",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#built-in-verification",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR systems can require photo capture, sensor confirmation or operator acknowledgment at each step. Errors are caught in real time, not after the fact."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"the-migration-path-paper-to-ar-sops",children:["The migration path: paper to AR SOPs",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-migration-path-paper-to-ar-sops",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Migrating from paper to AR SOPs does not need to be a massive project. Here is a practical approach:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"1-prioritise-high-impact-assembly-tasks",children:["1. Prioritise high-impact assembly tasks",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-prioritise-high-impact-assembly-tasks",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Focus first on tasks where errors are most costly, frequent or safety-critical. These are the tasks where AR will deliver the clearest return."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"2-convert-existing-paper-sops",children:["2. Convert existing paper SOPs",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-convert-existing-paper-sops",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Use your paper SOPs as the starting point. Translate steps into AR format, adding visual cues, checkpoints and verification prompts."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"3-validate-with-experts",children:["3. Validate with experts",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-validate-with-experts",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Have experienced operators review and test the AR SOPs. They will identify gaps, add tips and ensure the content reflects actual best practice."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"4-pilot-before-scaling",children:["4. Pilot before scaling",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-pilot-before-scaling",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Roll out AR SOPs on a pilot line or workstation. Measure error rates, cycle times and operator feedback. Refine based on results."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"5-expand-and-standardise",children:["5. Expand and standardise",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-expand-and-standardise",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"With pilot success demonstrated, expand AR SOPs to additional tasks and lines. Establish governance for content ownership and updates."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"results-what-organisations-are-achieving",children:["Results: what organisations are achieving",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-what-organisations-are-achieving",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Organisations that have migrated from paper to AR SOPs on assembly lines report significant improvements:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Error reduction:"})," 40–70% fewer assembly errors compared to paper SOPs"]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Rework decrease:"})," 30–50% less rework and scrap from assembly mistakes"]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Cycle time improvement:"})," 5–15% faster cycle times as operators spend less time searching for information"]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Audit readiness:"})," Instant access to traceable, version-controlled documentation for audits"]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Onboarding acceleration:"})," New operators reach competency 30–50% faster with AR guidance"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"These results are consistent across industries—from aerospace and automotive to electronics and industrial equipment."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"real-world-example-electronics-assembly",children:["Real-world example: electronics assembly",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-example-electronics-assembly",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"An electronics manufacturer faced persistent rework due to incorrect component orientation and missed solder points. Paper SOPs were detailed, but operators still made errors under production pressure."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"By converting to AR SOPs with visual overlays and step-by-step verification, the company achieved:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"65% reduction in orientation errors"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"45% reduction in rework costs"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"20% faster onboarding for new assemblers"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"The investment paid back within six months, and AR SOPs are now standard across all assembly lines."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"getting-started",children:["Getting started",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#getting-started",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"If paper SOPs are not delivering the error reduction you need, AR SOPs offer a proven alternative. Start with a focused pilot on your highest-impact assembly tasks, measure results and build from there."}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/ar-guided-assembly-production",children:"AR-guided assembly for error-free production"})," or ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"contact ActARion"})," to discuss your assembly challenges."]}),"
",n(a.hr,{}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"go-deeper",children:["Go deeper",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#go-deeper",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This article is part of our knowledge base on digital work instructions and compliance. For a comprehensive overview, read our whitepaper:"}),"
",r(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:n(a.a,{href:"/en/whitepapers/digital-work-instructions-ar-sops",children:"Digital work instructions and AR SOPs for standard work and compliance"})})," — A practical guide for quality, HSE, and operations leaders on transforming SOPs into executable, auditable AR instructions."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:r}=e.components||{};return r?n(r,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Von Stammwissen zu AR-SOPs: Eine praktische Roadmap
description: Eine Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung für Industrieteams, die undokumentiertes Stammwissen in standardisierte, skalierbare AR-SOPs und digitale Arbeitsanweisungen umwandeln möchten.

image.alt: Von Stammwissen zu AR-SOPs: Eine praktische Roadmap

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const s={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(s.h1,{id:"von-stammwissen-zu-ar-sops-eine-praktische-roadmap",children:["Von Stammwissen zu AR-SOPs: Eine praktische Roadmap",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#von-stammwissen-zu-ar-sops-eine-praktische-roadmap",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Jeder Industriebetrieb hat Stammwissen—die ungeschriebenen Regeln, Abkürzungen und Techniken, die erfahrene Mitarbeiter nutzen, aber selten dokumentieren. Dieses Wissen ist wertvoll, aber auch fragil. Wenn Schlüsselpersonen gehen, verschwindet Stammwissen. Wenn Teams wachsen, skaliert es nicht. Wenn Auditoren nach Dokumentation fragen, existiert sie nicht."}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Stammwissen in AR-SOPs und digitale Arbeitsanweisungen zu transformieren ist eine der wirkungsvollsten Investitionen, die eine Organisation machen kann. Dieser Artikel bietet eine praktische Roadmap für den Einstieg."}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"was-ist-stammwissen-und-warum-ist-es-wichtig",children:["Was ist Stammwissen und warum ist es wichtig?",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#was-ist-stammwissen-und-warum-ist-es-wichtig",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Stammwissen bezieht sich auf Informationen, die nur in den Köpfen bestimmter Mitarbeiter existieren. Es umfasst:"}),"
",i(s.ul,{children:["
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Best Practices"}),", die durch Jahre der Erfahrung entwickelt wurden"]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Workarounds"}),", die Ausrüstungsquirks oder Prozessbeschränkungen kompensieren"]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Diagnostische Intuition"})," zur schnellen Identifizierung und Lösung von Problemen"]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Sicherheitstipps"}),", die nicht in offiziellen Verfahren stehen"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Stammwissen ist oft das, was leistungsstarke Teams von durchschnittlichen unterscheidet. Aber es ist auch unsichtbar—bis es weg ist."}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"die-kosten-undokumentierten-stammwissens",children:["Die Kosten undokumentierten Stammwissens",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#die-kosten-undokumentierten-stammwissens",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Sich auf Stammwissen zu verlassen schafft echtes Geschäftsrisiko:"}),"
",i(s.ul,{children:["
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Einzelne Fehlerstellen:"})," Wenn der Experte nicht verfügbar ist, weiß niemand anders, was zu tun ist."]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Inkonsistente Ausführung:"})," Verschiedene Personen führen dieselbe Aufgabe unterschiedlich aus, was zu variablen Ergebnissen führt."]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Langsame Einarbeitung:"})," Neueinstellungen müssen durch Osmose lernen, was Zeit kostet und von informellem Mentoring abhängt."]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Compliance-Lücken:"})," Auditoren erwarten dokumentierte Verfahren, keine Mund-zu-Mund-Anweisungen."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"eine-praktische-roadmap-zur-konvertierung-von-stammwissen-in-ar-sops",children:["Eine praktische Roadmap zur Konvertierung von Stammwissen in AR-SOPs",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#eine-praktische-roadmap-zur-konvertierung-von-stammwissen-in-ar-sops",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Stammwissen in AR-SOPs zu transformieren ist kein einmaliges Projekt—es ist eine laufende Fähigkeit. Hier ist eine praktische Roadmap:"}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"schritt-1-identifizieren-und-priorisieren",children:["Schritt 1: Identifizieren und priorisieren",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-1-identifizieren-und-priorisieren",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Beginnen Sie damit, die Verfahren, Aufgaben und Fähigkeiten aufzulisten, bei denen Stammwissen am kritischsten ist. Priorisieren Sie basierend auf:"}),"
",i(s.ul,{children:["
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Auswirkung:"})," Was passiert, wenn dieses Wissen verloren geht oder falsch ausgeführt wird?"]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Risiko:"})," Wie wahrscheinlich ist es, dass der Wissensträger geht oder nicht verfügbar ist?"]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Häufigkeit:"})," Wie oft wird diese Aufgabe durchgeführt?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Konzentrieren Sie sich zuerst auf Verfahren mit hoher Auswirkung, hohem Risiko und hoher Häufigkeit."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"schritt-2-wissensträger-einbinden",children:["Schritt 2: Wissensträger einbinden",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-2-wissensträger-einbinden",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Identifizieren Sie die Experten, die das Stammwissen besitzen. Erklären Sie Zweck und Wert der Initiative—es geht nicht darum, sie zu ersetzen, sondern ihre Expertise zu bewahren und zu teilen."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"schritt-3-in-der-realen-umgebung-erfassen",children:["Schritt 3: In der realen Umgebung erfassen",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-3-in-der-realen-umgebung-erfassen",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Statten Sie Experten mit AR-Geräten aus und lassen Sie sie die Aufgabe in der realen Arbeitsumgebung ausführen. Das AR-System erfasst ihre Aktionen, Bilder und Sprachnotizen während sie arbeiten. Dieser Ansatz ist schneller und genauer als Experten zu interviewen oder aus dem Gedächtnis zu schreiben."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"schritt-4-strukturieren-und-validieren",children:["Schritt 4: Strukturieren und validieren",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-4-strukturieren-und-validieren",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Verwenden Sie KI-unterstützte Tools, um erfasste Inhalte in klare, aufeinanderfolgende Schritte zu organisieren. Überprüfen Sie mit dem Experten, um Lücken zu füllen, Tipps hinzuzufügen und Genauigkeit sicherzustellen. Validieren Sie mit anderen Teammitgliedern, um zu bestätigen, dass das Verfahren vollständig und nutzbar ist."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"schritt-5-veröffentlichen-und-verteilen",children:["Schritt 5: Veröffentlichen und verteilen",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-5-veröffentlichen-und-verteilen",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Veröffentlichen Sie die AR-SOP in Ihrer digitalen Bibliothek. Machen Sie sie auf Smart Glasses, Tablets oder Smartphones zugänglich. Kommunizieren Sie die Verfügbarkeit an Teams, die sie benötigen."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"schritt-6-schulen-und-verstärken",children:["Schritt 6: Schulen und verstärken",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-6-schulen-und-verstärken",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Führen Sie die AR-SOP bei Bedienern und Technikern ein. Bieten Sie kurze Schulungen an, wie man sie öffnet und befolgt. Überwachen Sie die Nutzung und sammeln Sie Feedback."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"schritt-7-iterieren-und-erweitern",children:["Schritt 7: Iterieren und erweitern",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#schritt-7-iterieren-und-erweitern",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Verwenden Sie Daten und Feedback, um die AR-SOP über Zeit zu verbessern. Erweitern Sie auf zusätzliche Verfahren und bauen Sie eine wachsende Bibliothek standardisierten, skalierbaren Wissens auf."}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"häufige-herausforderungen-überwinden",children:["Häufige Herausforderungen überwinden",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#häufige-herausforderungen-überwinden",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Das Konvertieren von Stammwissen in AR-SOPs kann auf Widerstand stoßen. Hier sind häufige Herausforderungen und wie man sie angeht:"}),"
",i(s.ul,{children:["
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Experten zögerlich zu teilen:"})," Betonen Sie, dass das Ziel ist, ihre Expertise anzuerkennen und zu bewahren, nicht sie zu ersetzen. Beziehen Sie sie als Inhaltseigentümer und Prüfer ein."]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Zeitmangel:"})," Integrieren Sie Wissenserfassung in normale Arbeitsaktivitäten, anstatt separate Dokumentationsprojekte hinzuzufügen."]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Perfektionismus:"}),' Beginnen Sie mit "gut genug" AR-SOPs und verbessern Sie über Zeit. Perfekt ist der Feind von fertig.']}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Technologiebedenken:"})," Bieten Sie praktische Schulung und Unterstützung. Die meisten Bediener passen sich schnell an, sobald sie den Wert sehen."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"real-world-beispiel-eine-kritische-troubleshooting-routine-standardisieren",children:["Real-World-Beispiel: Eine kritische Troubleshooting-Routine standardisieren",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-beispiel-eine-kritische-troubleshooting-routine-standardisieren",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Eine Fertigungsanlage verließ sich auf einen Senior-Techniker zur Fehlerbehebung eines komplexen Fördersystems. Wenn der Techniker im Urlaub war, dauerten Troubleshooting-Anrufe dreimal so lange und eskalierten oft unnötig."}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Mit AR-Arbeitsanweisungen erfasste der Techniker die Diagnoseroutine Schritt für Schritt, einschließlich Tipps zur Identifizierung häufiger Fehler. Die resultierende AR-SOP wurde dem Wartungsteam bereitgestellt."}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Innerhalb von drei Monaten sank die durchschnittliche Troubleshooting-Zeit um 40%, und Eskalationen fielen um 60%—selbst wenn der Senior-Techniker nicht verfügbar war."}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"erste-schritte",children:["Erste Schritte",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#erste-schritte",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Wenn Ihre Organisation von Stammwissen abhängig ist, ist jetzt die Zeit zu handeln—bevor die Experten gehen und das Wissen verloren ist. Beginnen Sie mit einem fokussierten Piloten: ein oder zwei wirkungsstarke Verfahren, erfasst und als AR-SOPs veröffentlicht. Demonstrieren Sie Wert, bauen Sie Momentum auf und erweitern Sie von dort."}),"
",i(s.p,{children:["Erfahren Sie mehr über ",n(s.a,{href:"/de/ar-work-instructions-corporate-memory",children:"AR-Arbeitsanweisungen und SOPs zur Bewahrung von Unternehmenswissen"})," oder ",n(s.a,{href:"/de/contact",children:"kontaktieren Sie ActARion"}),", um Ihre Wissensmanagement-Herausforderungen zu besprechen."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Van tribale kennis naar AR SOP's: een praktische roadmap
description: Een stap-voor-stap gids voor industriële teams die ongedocumenteerde tribale kennis willen transformeren naar gestandaardiseerde, schaalbare AR SOP's en digitale werkinstructies.

image.alt: Van tribale kennis naar AR SOP's: een praktische roadmap

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"van-tribale-kennis-naar-ar-sops-een-praktische-roadmap",children:["Van tribale kennis naar AR SOP's: een praktische roadmap",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#van-tribale-kennis-naar-ar-sops-een-praktische-roadmap",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Elke industriële operatie heeft tribale kennis—de ongeschreven regels, shortcuts en technieken die ervaren medewerkers gebruiken maar zelden documenteren. title: From tribal knowledge to AR SOPs: a practical roadmap
description: A step-by-step guide for industrial teams looking to transform undocumented tribal knowledge into standardised, scalable AR SOPs and digital work instructions.

image.alt: From tribal knowledge to AR SOPs: a practical roadmap

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(t){const r={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...t.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"from-tribal-knowledge-to-ar-sops-a-practical-roadmap",children:["From tribal knowledge to AR SOPs: a practical roadmap",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#from-tribal-knowledge-to-ar-sops-a-practical-roadmap",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Every industrial operation has tribal knowledge—the unwritten rules, shortcuts and techniques that experienced employees use but rarely document. This knowledge is valuable, but it is also fragile. When key people leave, tribal knowledge disappears. When teams grow, it does not scale. When auditors ask for documentation, it does not exist."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Transforming tribal knowledge into AR SOPs and digital work instructions is one of the highest-impact investments an organisation can make. This article provides a practical roadmap for getting started."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"what-is-tribal-knowledge-and-why-does-it-matter",children:["What is tribal knowledge and why does it matter?",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-is-tribal-knowledge-and-why-does-it-matter",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Tribal knowledge refers to information that exists only in the minds of certain employees. It includes:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Best practices"})," developed through years of experience"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Workarounds"})," that compensate for equipment quirks or process limitations"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Diagnostic intuition"})," for identifying and solving problems quickly"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Safety tips"})," that are not written in official procedures"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Tribal knowledge is often what separates high-performing teams from average ones. But it is also invisible—until it is gone."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"the-cost-of-undocumented-tribal-knowledge",children:["The cost of undocumented tribal knowledge",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-cost-of-undocumented-tribal-knowledge",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Relying on tribal knowledge creates real business risk:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Single points of failure:"})," If the expert is unavailable, no one else knows what to do."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Inconsistent execution:"})," Different people do the same task differently, leading to variable results."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Slow onboarding:"})," New hires must learn by osmosis, which takes time and depends on informal mentoring."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Compliance gaps:"})," Auditors expect documented procedures, not word-of-mouth instructions."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"a-practical-roadmap-for-converting-tribal-knowledge-to-ar-sops",children:["A practical roadmap for converting tribal knowledge to AR SOPs",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#a-practical-roadmap-for-converting-tribal-knowledge-to-ar-sops",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Transforming tribal knowledge into AR SOPs is not a one-time project—it is an ongoing capability. Here is a practical roadmap:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"step-1-identify-and-prioritise",children:["Step 1: Identify and prioritise",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-1-identify-and-prioritise",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Start by listing the procedures, tasks and skills where tribal knowledge is most critical. Prioritise based on:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Impact:"})," What happens if this knowledge is lost or executed incorrectly?"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Risk:"})," How likely is it that the knowledge holder will leave or be unavailable?"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Frequency:"})," How often is this task performed?"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Focus first on high-impact, high-risk, high-frequency procedures."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"step-2-engage-knowledge-holders",children:["Step 2: Engage knowledge holders",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-2-engage-knowledge-holders",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Identify the experts who hold the tribal knowledge. Explain the purpose and value of the initiative—this is not about replacing them, but about preserving and sharing their expertise."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"step-3-capture-in-the-real-environment",children:["Step 3: Capture in the real environment",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-3-capture-in-the-real-environment",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Equip experts with AR devices and let them perform the task in the real work environment. The AR system captures their actions, images and voice notes as they work. This approach is faster and more accurate than interviewing experts or writing from memory."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"step-4-structure-and-validate",children:["Step 4: Structure and validate",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-4-structure-and-validate",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Use AI-assisted tools to organise captured content into clear, sequential steps. Review with the expert to fill gaps, add tips and ensure accuracy. Validate with other team members to confirm the procedure is complete and usable."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"step-5-publish-and-distribute",children:["Step 5: Publish and distribute",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-5-publish-and-distribute",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Publish the AR SOP to your digital library. Make it accessible on smart glasses, tablets or smartphones. Communicate the availability to teams who need it."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"step-6-train-and-reinforce",children:["Step 6: Train and reinforce",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-6-train-and-reinforce",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Introduce the AR SOP to operators and technicians. Provide brief training on how to access and follow it. Monitor usage and gather feedback."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"step-7-iterate-and-expand",children:["Step 7: Iterate and expand",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#step-7-iterate-and-expand",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Use data and feedback to improve the AR SOP over time. Expand to additional procedures, building a growing library of standardised, scalable knowledge."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"overcoming-common-challenges",children:["Overcoming common challenges",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#overcoming-common-challenges",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Converting tribal knowledge to AR SOPs can encounter resistance. Here are common challenges and how to address them:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Experts reluctant to share:"})," Emphasise that the goal is to recognise and preserve their expertise, not replace them. Involve them as content owners and reviewers."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Lack of time:"})," Integrate knowledge capture into normal work activities rather than adding separate documentation projects."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Perfectionism:"}),' Start with "good enough" AR SOPs and improve over time. Perfect is the enemy of done.']}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Technology concerns:"})," Provide hands-on training and support. Most operators adapt quickly once they see the value."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"real-world-example-standardising-a-critical-troubleshooting-routine",children:["Real-world example: standardising a critical troubleshooting routine",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-example-standardising-a-critical-troubleshooting-routine",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A manufacturing plant relied on a senior technician to troubleshoot a complex conveyor system. When the technician was on vacation, troubleshooting calls took three times longer and often escalated unnecessarily."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Using AR work instructions, the technician captured the diagnostic routine step by step, including tips for identifying common faults. The resulting AR SOP was published to the maintenance team."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Within three months, average troubleshooting time dropped by 40%, and escalations fell by 60%—even when the senior technician was unavailable."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"getting-started",children:["Getting started",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#getting-started",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"If your organisation depends on tribal knowledge, the time to act is now—before the experts leave and the knowledge is lost. Start with a focused pilot: one or two high-impact procedures, captured and published as AR SOPs. Demonstrate value, build momentum and expand from there."}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/ar-work-instructions-corporate-memory",children:"AR work instructions and SOPs to preserve corporate memory"})," or ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"contact ActARion"})," to discuss your knowledge management challenges."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Wie AR-Onboarding Neueinstellungen schneller produktiv macht
description: Entdecken Sie, wie AR-geführtes Onboarding die Produktivität von Neueinstellungen in industriellen Umgebungen beschleunigt, Time-to-Competency reduziert und Retention verbessert.

image.alt: Wie AR-Onboarding Neueinstellungen schneller produktiv macht

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"wie-ar-onboarding-neueinstellungen-schneller-produktiv-macht",children:["Wie AR-Onboarding Neueinstellungen schneller produktiv macht",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-ar-onboarding-neueinstellungen-schneller-produktiv-macht",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In industriellen Umgebungen ist es sowohl eine Herausforderung als auch ein Wettbewerbsvorteil, Neueinstellungen schnell auf den neuesten Stand zu bringen. Jede Woche, die ein neuer Bediener mit Lernen verbringt, ist eine Woche mit reduziertem Output, höherem Fehlerrisiko und erhöhter Belastung für Trainer. Traditionelle Onboarding-Methoden—Begleitung, Präsenztraining, PDF-Handbücher—sind langsam, inkonsistent und schwer zu skalieren."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR-geführtes Onboarding bietet einen schnelleren, effektiveren Weg. Indem Schritt-für-Schritt visuelle Anleitung direkt vor Neueinstellungen platziert wird, während sie arbeiten, beschleunigen AR-Arbeitsanweisungen das Lernen, reduzieren Fehler und helfen neuen Mitarbeitern, früher beizutragen."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"warum-traditionelles-onboarding-langsam-ist",children:["Warum traditionelles Onboarding langsam ist",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#warum-traditionelles-onboarding-langsam-ist",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditionelles Onboarding hat inhärente Einschränkungen:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Passives Lernen:"})," Präsenzsitzungen und Handbuchlesen sind passiv. Informationen werden präsentiert, aber die Retention ist gering."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Trainer-Abhängigkeit:"})," Begleitung erfordert, dass ein erfahrener Mitarbeiter verfügbar, bereit und kompetent im Unterrichten ist—eine dreifache Einschränkung, die selten zusammenfällt."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Kontextlücke:"})," Lernen im Klassenzimmer oder aus einem Dokument überträgt sich nicht leicht auf die reale Arbeitsumgebung."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Variable Qualität:"})," Trainingsqualität hängt davon ab, wer trainiert, wann und wo. Konsistenz ist schwer zu erreichen."]}),"

title: How AR onboarding helps new hires reach productivity faster
description: Discover how AR-guided onboarding accelerates new hire productivity in industrial environments, reducing time to competency and improving retention.

image.alt: How AR onboarding helps new hires reach productivity faster

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"how-ar-onboarding-helps-new-hires-reach-productivity-faster",children:["How AR onboarding helps new hires reach productivity faster",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-onboarding-helps-new-hires-reach-productivity-faster",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"In industrial environments, getting new hires up to speed quickly is both a challenge and a competitive advantage. Every week a new operator spends learning is a week of reduced output, higher error risk and increased burden on trainers. Traditional onboarding methods—shadowing, classroom training, PDF manuals—are slow, inconsistent and hard to scale."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR-guided onboarding offers a faster, more effective path. By putting step-by-step visual guidance directly in front of new hires as they work, AR work instructions accelerate learning, reduce errors and help new employees contribute sooner."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-traditional-onboarding-is-slow",children:["Why traditional onboarding is slow",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-traditional-onboarding-is-slow",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Traditional onboarding has inherent limitations:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Passive learning:"})," Classroom sessions and reading manuals are passive. Information is presented, but retention is low."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Trainer dependency:"})," Shadowing requires an experienced employee to be available, willing and skilled at teaching—a triple constraint that rarely aligns."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Context gap:"})," Learning in a classroom or from a document does not transfer easily to the real work environment."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Variable quality:"})," Training quality depends on who is training, when and where. Consistency is hard to achieve."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"These limitations mean new hires often take weeks or months to reach full productivity, with significant error rates along the way."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-onboarding-accelerates-learning",children:["How AR onboarding accelerates learning",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-onboarding-accelerates-learning",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR-guided onboarding addresses these challenges directly:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"learning-by-doing",children:["Learning by doing",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#learning-by-doing",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions guide new hires through real tasks, step by step. They learn by doing, not by watching or reading. This hands-on approach improves retention and builds confidence faster."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"always-available-guidance",children:["Always-available guidance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#always-available-guidance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR guidance is available on demand—no need to wait for a trainer. New hires can practice independently, accelerating their learning curve."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"contextual-visual-instruction",children:["Contextual, visual instruction",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#contextual-visual-instruction",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR overlays are displayed on the actual equipment or workspace. Instructions are immediately relevant and easy to follow, eliminating the context gap."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"consistent-experience",children:["Consistent experience",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#consistent-experience",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Every new hire receives the same high-quality instruction, regardless of trainer availability or shift. This ensures consistent skill development across the organisation."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"immediate-feedback",children:["Immediate feedback",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#immediate-feedback",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR systems can detect errors and provide real-time feedback, helping new hires correct mistakes before they become habits."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-business-impact-of-faster-onboarding",children:["The business impact of faster onboarding",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-business-impact-of-faster-onboarding",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Accelerating time to productivity delivers real business value:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"More output, sooner:"})," New hires contribute productive work earlier, increasing capacity and throughput."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Fewer errors during learning:"})," AR guidance reduces errors during the onboarding phase, cutting rework and waste."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Lower trainer burden:"})," Trainers can focus on complex scenarios and exceptions, rather than routine procedural instruction."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Better retention:"})," New hires who feel supported and confident are more likely to stay, reducing turnover costs."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"real-world-example-logistics-onboarding",children:["Real-world example: logistics onboarding",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-example-logistics-onboarding",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A logistics company piloted AR-guided onboarding for new warehouse operators. Previously, new hires spent two weeks shadowing before working independently, with ongoing coaching for several more weeks."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"With AR work instructions:"}),"

description: Entdecken Sie, wie AR-SOPs und digitale Arbeitsanweisungen die Auditvorbereitung vereinfachen, Compliance-Risiken reduzieren und nachverfolgbare Nachweise korrekter Verfahrensausführung schaffen.
