title: SOP's actueel houden in snel veranderende omgevingen met digitale werkinstructies
description: Hoe digitale werkinstructies en AR SOP's industriële teams helpen actuele, nauwkeurige procedures te handhaven, zelfs wanneer processen, apparatuur en regelgeving frequent veranderen.

image.alt: SOP's actueel houden in snel veranderende omgevingen met digitale werkinstructies

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"sops-actueel-houden-in-snel-veranderende-omgevingen-met-digitale-werkinstructies",children:["SOP's actueel houden in snel veranderende omgevingen met digitale werkinstructies",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#sops-actueel-houden-in-snel-veranderende-omgevingen-met-digitale-werkinstructies",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"In veel industriële omgevingen is verandering constant. Apparatuur wordt geüpgraded, processen worden geoptimaliseerd, regelgeving evolueert en productvarianten vermenigvuldigen. Toch lopen SOP's—de documenten die mensen vertellen hoe ze hun werk moeten doen—vaak ver achter. Verouderde procedures creëren risico: fouten, inconsistentie, nalevingslacunes en frustratie."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digitale werkinstructies en AR SOP's maken het mogelijk om procedures actueel te houden, zelfs in snel veranderende omgevingen. Door content te centraliseren, updates te vereenvoudigen en wijzigingen direct te distribueren, transformeren ze SOP-beheer van een last naar een concurrentievoordeel."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"waarom-traditioneel-sop-beheer-achterblijft",children:["Waarom traditioneel SOP-beheer achterblijft",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#waarom-traditioneel-sop-beheer-achterblijft",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Papieren SOP's en statische digitale documenten zijn inherent traag bij te werken:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Handmatige revisieprocessen:"})," Wijzigingen vereisen opstellen, reviewen, goedkeuren, printen en distribueren van nieuwe versies—vaak weken of maanden durend."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Versiebeheer-chaos:"})," Meerdere versies circuleren, en operators kunnen onbewust verouderde procedures gebruiken."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Distributie-bottlenecks:"})," Bijgewerkte SOP's naar elk werkstation, ploeg en locatie krijgen is een logistieke uitdaging."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Trainingslacunes:"})," Zelfs wanneer nieuwe SOP's worden gedistribueerd, is verzekeren dat iedereen is getraind op de wijzigingen moeilijk."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"In snel veranderende omgevingen betekenen deze vertragingen dat operators vaak werken met procedures die niet meer de realiteit weerspiegelen. De kloof tussen gedocumenteerde en daadwerkelijke praktijk wordt over tijd groter."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"hoe-digitale-werkinstructies-het-updateprobleem-oplossen",children:["Hoe digitale werkinstructies het updateprobleem oplossen",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#hoe-digitale-werkinstructies-het-updateprobleem-oplossen",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digitale werkinstructies en AR SOP's pakken deze uitdagingen bij de wortel aan:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"gecentraliseerd-contentbeheer",children:["Gecentraliseerd contentbeheer",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#gecentraliseerd-contentbeheer",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Alle procedures worden opgeslagen in een enkele, cloud-gebaseerde bibliotheek. Updates worden eenmaal gemaakt en gelden overal—geen papieren kopieën meer najagen of meerdere bestandsversies beheren."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"directe-publicatie-en-distributie",children:["Directe publicatie en distributie",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#directe-publicatie-en-distributie",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Wanneer een procedure verandert, wordt de bijgewerkte digitale werkinstructie direct gepubliceerd. Elke operator ziet de nieuwe versie de volgende keer dat ze het openen—geen printen, geen distributievertraging."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"ingebouwd-versiebeheer",children:["Ingebouwd versiebeheer",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ingebouwd-versiebeheer",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Het systeem volgt elke versie, met volledige historie en audittrail. Auditors kunnen precies zien welke versie actief was op een bepaalde datum, en welke versie elke operator gebruikte."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"automatische-notificaties-en-training",children:["Automatische notificaties en training",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#automatische-notificaties-en-training",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Operators kunnen worden genotificeerd wanneer procedures veranderen, en moeten bijgewerkte content reviewen of opnieuw certificeren voordat ze het gebruiken. Dit sluit de trainingslacune automatisch."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"gemakkelijk-bewerken-en-samenwerking",children:["Gemakkelijk bewerken en samenwerking",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#gemakkelijk-bewerken-en-samenwerking",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Vakexperts kunnen AR-werkinstructies direct bijwerken—stappen, foto's, waarschuwingen of verduidelijkingen toevoegen—zonder complexe authoring-tools. Wijzigingen worden gereviewd, goedgekeurd en gepubliceerd via een gestroomlijnde workflow."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"praktische-tips-voor-het-actueel-houden-van-ar-sops",children:["Praktische tips voor het actueel houden van AR SOP's",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#praktische-tips-voor-het-actueel-houden-van-ar-sops",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Digitale werkinstructies actueel houden vereist discipline en proces. Hier zijn praktische aanbevelingen:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"1-wijs-eigenaarschap-toe",children:["1. Wijs eigenaarschap toe",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-wijs-eigenaarschap-toe",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Elke AR SOP moet een duidelijke eigenaar hebben die verantwoordelijk is voor het actueel houden. Dit is typisch een procesengineer, supervisor of vakexpert."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"2-bouw-updates-in-verandermanagement-in",children:["2. Bouw updates in verandermanagement in",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-bouw-updates-in-verandermanagement-in",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Wanneer apparatuur, processen of regelgeving veranderen, neem AR SOP-updates op als vereiste stap in het verandermanagementproces."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"3-gebruik-feedback-van-de-werkvloer",children:["3. Gebruik feedback van de werkvloer",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-gebruik-feedback-van-de-werkvloer",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Operators spotten vaak als eersten problemen of verbeteringen. Bied een eenvoudige manier voor hen om content te markeren die updating nodig heeft, en review deze feedback regelmatig."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"4-plan-periodieke-reviews",children:["4. Plan periodieke reviews",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-plan-periodieke-reviews",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Zelfs als er geen grote wijzigingen optreden, review AR SOP's op een regelmatig schema (bijv. jaarlijks) om drift op te vangen en nauwkeurigheid te verzekeren."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"5-volg-adoptie-en-gebruik",children:["5. Volg adoptie en gebruik",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-volg-adoptie-en-gebruik",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Monitor hoe vaak AR-werkinstructies worden gebruikt en of operators alle stappen voltooien. Laag gebruik of frequente fouten kunnen content indiceren die verbetering nodig heeft."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"real-world-voorbeeld-regelgevingswijzigingen-beheren-in-farma",children:["Real-world voorbeeld: regelgevingswijzigingen beheren in farma",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-voorbeeld-regelgevingswijzigingen-beheren-in-farma",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Een farmaceutische fabrikant had te maken met frequente regelgevingsupdates die wijzigingen in productie-SOP's vereisten. Met papieren documentatie duurde elke wijziging weken om te implementeren en creëerde nalevingsrisico tijdens de overgang."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Door over te stappen naar digitale werkinstructies, behaalde het bedrijf:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Same-day publicatie van bijgewerkte procedures na regelgevingswijzigingen"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Automatische notificaties aan getroffen operators, met bevestigingstracking"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Volledige audittrail die toont welke versie op elk moment actief was"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Nalevingsauditbevindingen gerelateerd aan SOP-actualiteit daalden naar nul, en tijd besteed aan SOP-administratie daalde met meer dan 50%."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"wie-profiteert-van-digitaal-sop-beheer",children:["Wie profiteert van digitaal SOP-beheer?",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#wie-profiteert-van-digitaal-sop-beheer",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"SOP's actueel houden met digitale werkinstructies is relevant voor:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Kwaliteitsmanagers"})," die verzekeren dat procedures huidige best practices en regelgeving weerspiegelen"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Procesengineurs"})," verantwoordelijk voor het updaten van procedures naarmate processen evolueren"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Operations managers"})," die verzekeren dat teams werken met nauwkeurige, actuele instructies"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Compliance officers"})," die audit-klaar versiebeheer en distributie demonstreren"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"aan-de-slag",children:["Aan de slag",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#aan-de-slag",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Als uw SOP's worstelen om verandering bij te houden, kunnen digitale werkinstructies helpen. Begin met het identificeren van de procedures die het meest frequent veranderen of het grootste nalevingsrisico vormen. Een gerichte pilot kan de waarde demonstreren van gecentraliseerde, direct bijwerkbare AR SOP's."}),"

title: Keeping SOPs up to date in fast-changing environments with digital work instructions
description: How digital work instructions and AR SOPs help industrial teams maintain current, accurate procedures even when processes, equipment and regulations change frequently.

image.alt: Keeping SOPs up to date in fast-changing environments with digital work instructions

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"keeping-sops-up-to-date-in-fast-changing-environments-with-digital-work-instructions",children:["Keeping SOPs up to date in fast-changing environments with digital work instructions",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#keeping-sops-up-to-date-in-fast-changing-environments-with-digital-work-instructions",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"In many industrial environments, change is constant. Equipment is upgraded, processes are optimised, regulations evolve and product variants multiply. Yet SOPs—the documents that tell people how to do their work—often lag far behind. Outdated procedures create risk: errors, inconsistency, compliance gaps and frustration."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Digital work instructions and AR SOPs make it possible to keep procedures current, even in fast-changing environments. By centralising content, simplifying updates and distributing changes instantly, they transform SOP management from a burden into a competitive advantage."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-traditional-sop-management-falls-behind",children:["Why traditional SOP management falls behind",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-traditional-sop-management-falls-behind",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Paper SOPs and static digital documents are inherently slow to update:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Manual revision processes:"})," Changes require drafting, reviewing, approving, printing and distributing new versions—often taking weeks or months."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Version control chaos:"})," Multiple versions circulate, and operators may unknowingly use outdated procedures."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Distribution bottlenecks:"})," Getting updated SOPs to every workstation, shift and site is a logistical challenge."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Training gaps:"})," Even when new SOPs are distributed, ensuring everyone is trained on the changes is difficult."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"In fast-changing environments, these delays mean operators are often working from procedures that no longer reflect reality. The gap between documented and actual practice widens over time."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-digital-work-instructions-solve-the-update-problem",children:["How digital work instructions solve the update problem",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-digital-work-instructions-solve-the-update-problem",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Digital work instructions and AR SOPs address these challenges at the root:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"centralised-content-management",children:["Centralised content management",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#centralised-content-management",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"All procedures are stored in a single, cloud-based library. Updates are made once and apply everywhere—no more chasing paper copies or managing multiple file versions."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"instant-publishing-and-distribution",children:["Instant publishing and distribution",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#instant-publishing-and-distribution",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"When a procedure changes, the updated digital work instruction is published instantly. Every operator sees the new version the next time they access it—no printing, no distribution delays."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"built-in-version-control",children:["Built-in version control",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#built-in-version-control",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"The system tracks every version, with full history and audit trail. Auditors can see exactly which version was active on any given date, and which version each operator used."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"automatic-notifications-and-training",children:["Automatic notifications and training",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#automatic-notifications-and-training",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Operators can be notified when procedures change, and required to review or re-certify on updated content before using it. This closes the training gap automatically."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"easy-editing-and-collaboration",children:["Easy editing and collaboration",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#easy-editing-and-collaboration",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Subject matter experts can update AR work instructions directly—adding steps, photos, warnings or clarifications—without complex authoring tools. Changes are reviewed, approved and published through a streamlined workflow."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"practical-tips-for-keeping-ar-sops-current",children:["Practical tips for keeping AR SOPs current",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-tips-for-keeping-ar-sops-current",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Keeping digital work instructions up to date requires discipline and process. Here are practical recommendations:"}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"1-assign-ownership",children:["1. Assign ownership",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-assign-ownership",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Every AR SOP should have a clear owner responsible for keeping it current. This is typically a process engineer, supervisor or subject matter expert."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"2-build-updates-into-change-management",children:["2. Build updates into change management",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-build-updates-into-change-management",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Whenever equipment, processes or regulations change, include AR SOP updates as a required step in the change management process."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"3-use-feedback-from-the-floor",children:["3. Use feedback from the floor",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-use-feedback-from-the-floor",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Operators often spot issues or improvements first. Provide a simple way for them to flag content that needs updating, and review this feedback regularly."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"4-schedule-periodic-reviews",children:["4. Schedule periodic reviews",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#4-schedule-periodic-reviews",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Even if no major changes occur, review AR SOPs on a regular schedule (e.g. annually) to catch drift and ensure accuracy."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"5-track-adoption-and-usage",children:["5. Track adoption and usage",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-track-adoption-and-usage",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Monitor how often AR work instructions are used and whether operators complete all steps. Low usage or frequent errors may indicate content that needs improvement."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"real-world-example-managing-regulatory-changes-in-pharma",children:["Real-world example: managing regulatory changes in pharma",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-example-managing-regulatory-changes-in-pharma",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A pharmaceutical manufacturer faced frequent regulatory updates that required changes to production SOPs. With paper-based documentation, each change took weeks to implement and created compliance risk during the transition."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"By moving to digital work instructions, the company achieved:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Same-day publishing of updated procedures following regulatory changes"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Automatic notifications to affected operators, with acknowledgment tracking"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Full audit trail showing which version was active at any time"}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Compliance audit findings related to SOP currency dropped to zero, and time spent on SOP administration fell by over 50%."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"who-benefits-from-digital-sop-management",children:["Who benefits from digital SOP management?",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#who-benefits-from-digital-sop-management",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Keeping SOPs up to date with digital work instructions is relevant for:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Quality managers"})," ensuring procedures reflect current best practices and regulations"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Process engineers"})," responsible for updating procedures as processes evolve"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Operations managers"})," ensuring teams work from accurate, current instructions"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Compliance officers"})," demonstrating audit-ready version control and distribution"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"getting-started",children:["Getting started",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#getting-started",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"If your SOPs struggle to keep pace with change, digital work instructions can help. Start by identifying the procedures that change most frequently or pose the greatest compliance risk. A focused pilot can demonstrate the value of centralised, instantly updatable AR SOPs."}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/ar-work-instructions-corporate-memory",children:"AR work instructions and SOPs to preserve corporate memory"})," or ",n(r.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"contact ActARion"})," to discuss your SOP management challenges."]}),"
",n(r.hr,{}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"go-deeper",children:["Go deeper",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#go-deeper",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"This article is part of our knowledge base on digital work instructions and compliance. For a comprehensive overview, read our whitepaper:"}),"
",i(r.p,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:n(r.a,{href:"/en/whitepapers/digital-work-instructions-ar-sops",children:"Digital work instructions and AR SOPs for standard work and compliance"})})," — Covers how AR SOPs are created, updated, and governed for sustainable compliance."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

",r(t.h3,{id:"begrenzte-sichtbarkeit",children:["Begrenzte Sichtbarkeit",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#begrenzte-sichtbarkeit",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

description: How AR work instructions improve preventive maintenance effectiveness, helping technicians catch issues early and prevent costly equipment failures.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(t){const a={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...t.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"preventive-maintenance-with-ar-work-instructions-catching-issues-before-they-escalate",children:["Preventive maintenance with AR work instructions: catching issues before they escalate",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#preventive-maintenance-with-ar-work-instructions-catching-issues-before-they-escalate",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'Preventive maintenance is designed to catch issues before they become failures. But in practice, many preventive programmes struggle to deliver on this promise. Inspections are rushed, steps are skipped, subtle warning signs are missed. When breakdowns occur, the question often arises: "Didn't we just do maintenance on this?"'}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions transform preventive maintenance from a checkbox exercise into a genuine early-warning system. By guiding technicians through every step and capturing detailed execution data, they ensure issues are identified and addressed before they escalate."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-traditional-preventive-maintenance-misses-issues",children:["Why traditional preventive maintenance misses issues",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-traditional-preventive-maintenance-misses-issues",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Traditional preventive maintenance often falls short of its potential:"}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Different technicians perform the same inspection differently. Some are thorough; others rush through checklists. Critical steps may be skipped or performed superficially."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Technicians may notice something unusual but fail to document it—or document it in a way that is not actionable. Warning signs get lost in handwritten notes or verbal handovers."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"reactive-improvement",children:["Reactive improvement",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#reactive-improvement",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Without data on how maintenance is actually performed, it is hard to improve. Organisations react to failures rather than proactively strengthening their programmes."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-work-instructions-catch-issues-early",children:["How AR work instructions catch issues early",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-work-instructions-catch-issues-early",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"AR overlays guide technicians through every inspection step. Each check is clearly defined, with visual cues showing exactly what to look for and where. Steps cannot be skipped."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"For key checks, AR systems prompt technicians to capture photos, videos or measurements. This creates a visual record of condition—not just a checkmark."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Organisations using AR work instructions for preventive maintenance report significant improvements in early issue detection:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"More anomalies identified:"})," Structured inspections and evidence capture surface issues that were previously missed"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Faster response:"})," Anomalies are documented clearly and routed immediately for action"]}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Better asset reliability:"})," Over time, preventive programmes become more effective at maintaining equipment health"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"real-world-example-turbine-inspections-in-energy",children:["Real-world example: turbine inspections in energy",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#real-world-example-turbine-inspections-in-energy",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"An energy company struggled with turbine inspection consistency. Different technicians focused on different areas, and several unexpected failures traced back to missed warning signs during preventive inspections."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"By implementing AR work instructions:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Every inspection followed the same structured procedure"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Technicians captured photos at defined checkpoints"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Anomalies were documented in a standard format with severity ratings"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Within six months:"}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Anomaly detection rate increased by 45%"}),"

"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"keys-to-success",children:["Keys to success",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#keys-to-success",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"To maximise the issue-catching potential of AR-guided preventive maintenance:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Define clear inspection criteria:"}),' Technicians need to know what "good" and "bad" look like at each checkpoint']}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Require evidence at critical steps:"})," Photo or video capture ensures thorough inspection"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Create anomaly workflows:"})," Documented issues should flow to planners for review and action"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Analyse and act on data:"})," Use execution data to identify trends and improve programmes"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"getting-started",children:["Getting started",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#getting-started",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"If your preventive maintenance programme is not catching issues before they escalate, AR work instructions can help. Start by identifying inspections where early detection matters most, implement AR guidance with evidence capture and build a culture of thorough, data-driven maintenance."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/ar-preventive-maintenance",children:"AR preventive maintenance with data-driven insights"})," or ",n(a.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"contact ActARion"})," to discuss your preventive maintenance challenges."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const s={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(s.h1,{id:"inspektionen-standardisieren-mit-ar-sops-weniger-überraschungen-bessere-daten",children:["Inspektionen standardisieren mit AR-SOPs: weniger Überraschungen, bessere Daten",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#inspektionen-standardisieren-mit-ar-sops-weniger-überraschungen-bessere-daten",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

Das Ergebnis sind variable Daten, die schwer zu vergleichen, zu analysieren oder darauf zu handeln sind."}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"AR-SOPs bieten einen Weg zu standardisierten Inspektionen. Indem sie jeden Techniker auf dieselbe Weise durch dasselbe Verfahren führen, reduzieren sie Variabilität, verbessern Datenqualität und machen Wartungsprogramme vorhersagbarer."}),"

",i(s.h3,{id:"übersehene-probleme",children:["Übersehene Probleme",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#übersehene-probleme",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

title: Standardising inspections with AR SOPs: fewer surprises, better data
description: How AR SOPs standardise inspections across technicians and sites, reducing variability and generating consistent, actionable maintenance data.

image.alt: Standardising inspections with AR SOPs: fewer surprises, better data

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(t){const s={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...t.components};return i(e,{children:[i(s.h1,{id:"standardising-inspections-with-ar-sops-fewer-surprises-better-data",children:["Standardising inspections with AR SOPs: fewer surprises, better data",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#standardising-inspections-with-ar-sops-fewer-surprises-better-data",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Inspection consistency is one of the biggest challenges in maintenance. Different technicians inspect the same equipment differently—focusing on different areas, using different methods, documenting at different levels of detail. The result is variable data that is hard to compare, analyse or act on."}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"AR SOPs offer a path to standardised inspections. By guiding every technician through the same procedure in the same way, they reduce variability, improve data quality and make maintenance programmes more predictable."}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"the-problem-with-inconsistent-inspections",children:["The problem with inconsistent inspections",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-problem-with-inconsistent-inspections",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Inspection inconsistency creates multiple problems:"}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"unreliable-data",children:["Unreliable data",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#unreliable-data",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:'When inspections are performed differently, the resulting data is unreliable. "Pass" from one technician may mean something different than "pass" from another. Trends are hidden in noise.'}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"missed-issues",children:["Missed issues",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#missed-issues",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Variable inspections mean variable coverage. Some components get thorough attention; others are overlooked. Issues that one technician would catch are missed by another."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"difficult-comparisons",children:["Difficult comparisons",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#difficult-comparisons",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Comparing inspection results across technicians, shifts or sites is difficult when methods vary. Benchmarking and best-practice sharing become impossible."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"limited-improvement",children:["Limited improvement",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#limited-improvement",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"Without consistent data, it is hard to improve. Planners cannot identify patterns, optimise schedules or target interventions effectively."}),"
",i(s.h2,{id:"how-ar-sops-standardise-inspections",children:["How AR SOPs standardise inspections",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-sops-standardise-inspections",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"AR SOPs address inspection inconsistency at the root:"}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"same-procedure-every-time",children:["Same procedure, every time",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#same-procedure-every-time",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"AR SOPs define the exact sequence of inspection steps. Every technician follows the same procedure, in the same order, checking the same points. There is no room for individual variation."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"visual-guidance-reduces-interpretation",children:["Visual guidance reduces interpretation",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#visual-guidance-reduces-interpretation",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:'Instead of interpreting written instructions, technicians see visual cues overlaid on the equipment. "Check the seal" becomes "look here, at this angle, for these conditions." Interpretation is minimised.'}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"mandatory-steps-and-checkpoints",children:["Mandatory steps and checkpoints",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#mandatory-steps-and-checkpoints",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"AR systems enforce step completion. Technicians cannot skip ahead without completing each step. Critical checkpoints require explicit confirmation or evidence capture."}),"
",i(s.h3,{id:"consistent-data-capture",children:["Consistent data capture",n(s.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#consistent-data-capture",children:n(s.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(s.p,{children:"AR SOPs define what data to capture at each step—photos, measurements, condition ratings. Every inspection produces the same data fields, making analysis straightforward."}),"

",n(s.p,{children:"Organisations that standardise inspections with AR SOPs report:"}),"
",i(s.ul,{children:["
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Higher consistency:"})," Inspection execution is uniform across technicians, shifts and sites"]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Better data quality:"})," Comparable, structured data enables meaningful analysis"]}),"
",i(s.li,{children:[n(s.strong,{children:"Fewer surprises:"})," Issues are caught more reliably, reducing unexpected failures"]}),"

title: What to measure in AR remote expert support pilots
description: Key metrics and KPIs to track when piloting AR remote expert support, helping you demonstrate value and make informed scale decisions.

image.alt: What to measure in AR remote expert support pilots

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:i,jsxs:n}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(t){const r={a:"a",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...t.components};return n(e,{children:[n(r.h1,{id:"what-to-measure-in-ar-remote-expert-support-pilots",children:["What to measure in AR remote expert support pilots",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-to-measure-in-ar-remote-expert-support-pilots",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Piloting AR remote expert support is the best way to validate its value for your organisation. But to make informed decisions about scaling, you need to measure the right things. Vague impressions are not enough—you need data that demonstrates impact and guides improvement."}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"This article outlines the key metrics and KPIs to track during an AR remote expert support pilot, organised by category."}),"
",n(r.h2,{id:"resolution-metrics",children:["Resolution metrics",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#resolution-metrics",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Resolution metrics measure how effectively AR remote support solves problems."}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"resolution-rate",children:["Resolution rate",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#resolution-rate",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," The percentage of AR support sessions that result in a resolved issue."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," A high resolution rate indicates that AR remote support is effective at solving problems without escalation."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," (Sessions resulting in resolution / Total sessions) × 100"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim for 70–85% resolution rate for most issue types."]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"first-time-right-rate",children:["First Time Right rate",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#first-time-right-rate",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," The percentage of sessions where the issue is resolved on the first attempt, without rework or repeat sessions."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," High First Time Right indicates clear, accurate guidance from experts."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," (Sessions resolved on first attempt / Total resolved sessions) × 100"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim for 65–80% First Time Right."]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"escalation-rate",children:["Escalation rate",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#escalation-rate",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," The percentage of sessions that cannot be resolved remotely and require expert site visits."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Lower escalation means more issues resolved without costly travel."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," (Sessions escalated to site visit / Total sessions) × 100"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim to reduce escalation by 30–50% compared to pre-AR baseline."]}),"
",n(r.h2,{id:"time-metrics",children:["Time metrics",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#time-metrics",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Time metrics measure the speed of support and resolution."}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"response-time",children:["Response time",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#response-time",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," How quickly an expert joins an AR session after a technician requests help."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Fast response reduces technician waiting time and accelerates resolution."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," Average time from session request to expert joining"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim for under 5 minutes for most requests."]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"session-duration",children:["Session duration",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#session-duration",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," How long AR support sessions last."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Shorter sessions indicate efficient guidance; very long sessions may indicate complex issues or inefficiencies."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," Average duration of completed sessions"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Benchmark:"})," Typical sessions range from 10–30 minutes depending on issue complexity."]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"mean-time-to-repair-mttr",children:["Mean Time To Repair (MTTR)",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#mean-time-to-repair-mttr",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," Total time from issue identification to resolution for issues supported via AR."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," MTTR is the ultimate measure of support speed and effectiveness."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," Average time from fault detection to confirmed resolution"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim for 30–50% reduction compared to pre-AR baseline."]}),"
",n(r.h2,{id:"efficiency-metrics",children:["Efficiency metrics",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#efficiency-metrics",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Efficiency metrics measure resource utilisation and cost impact."}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"expert-utilisation",children:["Expert utilisation",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#expert-utilisation",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," How much of available expert time is spent on productive AR sessions."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," High utilisation indicates efficient use of expert capacity; low utilisation may indicate over-staffing or demand issues."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," (Time spent on sessions / Total available expert time) × 100"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Benchmark:"})," Aim for 40–70% utilisation depending on coverage model."]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"site-visits-avoided",children:["Site visits avoided",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#site-visits-avoided",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," The number of expert site visits avoided because issues were resolved remotely."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Avoided site visits represent direct cost savings (travel, time, opportunity cost)."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," Count of issues that would previously have required site visits but were resolved via AR"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim to avoid 30–50% of site visits compared to baseline."]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"cost-per-resolution",children:["Cost per resolution",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#cost-per-resolution",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," The average cost to resolve an issue via AR remote support."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Demonstrates the cost-effectiveness of AR support compared to alternatives."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," Total AR support costs / Number of resolved issues"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Compare to:"})," Cost per resolution via phone support, site visits or other methods."]}),"
",n(r.h2,{id:"quality-and-satisfaction-metrics",children:["Quality and satisfaction metrics",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#quality-and-satisfaction-metrics",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Quality metrics measure the experience and outcomes for technicians and experts."}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"technician-satisfaction",children:["Technician satisfaction",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#technician-satisfaction",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," How satisfied technicians are with the AR support experience."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Satisfied technicians are more likely to use and benefit from AR support."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to measure:"})," Post-session surveys (e.g. 1–5 rating scale) or periodic feedback"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim for 4/5 or higher average satisfaction."]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"expert-feedback",children:["Expert feedback",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#expert-feedback",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," How experts perceive the effectiveness and usability of AR support."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Expert buy-in is essential for sustained success."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to measure:"})," Periodic surveys or feedback sessions"]}),"
",n(r.h3,{id:"knowledge-capture-rate",children:["Knowledge capture rate",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#knowledge-capture-rate",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"What it measures:"})," The percentage of sessions that are recorded and/or converted into reusable knowledge (AR work instructions, documentation)."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Why it matters:"})," Knowledge capture multiplies the value of each session."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"How to calculate:"})," (Sessions captured or converted / Total sessions) × 100"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Target:"})," Aim to capture 80%+ of sessions for potential reuse."]}),"
",n(r.h2,{id:"baseline-comparison",children:["Baseline comparison",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#baseline-comparison",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"All metrics are most meaningful when compared to a baseline. Before starting the pilot, document:"}),"
",n(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:"Current resolution rates, times and escalation levels for target issue types"}),"
",i(r.li,{children:"Current costs for support via phone, site visits or other methods"}),"
",i(r.li,{children:"Current technician satisfaction with remote support"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Use baseline data to demonstrate improvement and calculate ROI."}),"
",n(r.h2,{id:"reporting-and-decision-making",children:["Reporting and decision-making",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#reporting-and-decision-making",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Track metrics throughout the pilot and summarise results at defined intervals (weekly or monthly). Present findings to stakeholders with clear comparisons to baseline."}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"Use pilot data to inform the scale decision:"}),"
",n(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Strong results:"})," Expand AR remote support to additional teams, sites or issue types"]}),"
",n(r.li,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Mixed results:"})," Identify improvement areas, refine processes and consider extended pilot"]}),"
",n(r.li,{children:[i(r.strong,{children:"Weak results:"})," Investigate root causes before further investment"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.h2,{id:"getting-started",children:["Getting started",i(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#getting-started",children:i(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:"If you are planning an AR remote expert support pilot, define your metrics upfront and establish baseline data before launching. Consistent measurement enables confident decisions and demonstrates value."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:["Learn more about ",i(r.a,{href:"/en/ar-remote-expert-support-corrective-maintenance",children:"AR remote expert support for corrective maintenance"})," or ",i(r.a,{href:"/en/contact",children:"contact ActARion"})," to discuss your pilot measurement approach."]})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:n}=e.components||{};return n?i(n,{...e,children:i(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: Why the future of work will change
description: How technology, AI and augmented reality are reshaping work, learning and competitive advantage in technical operations.

image.alt: Why the future of work will change

author: Ortwin Verreck
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h2:"h2",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h2,{id:"the-future-of-work-started-long-before-ai",children:["The future of work started long before AI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-future-of-work-started-long-before-ai",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The future of work did not start with AI."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Technology innovation has always been a continuous process that helps organisations work faster, safer and smarter."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"It started the day we put machines between people and their tasks. Ford’s assembly line transformed car building from a craft into a repeatable, standardised process. From that moment on, “technology-scaled labour” became just as important as human skill."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Over the last century, every major wave of technology did something similar: mechanisation, electrification, computers, robotics, software, and now AI. Each wave changed what “productive work” looks like, and rewarded the organisations that adopted it early."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Today we are at a new turning point. AI, combined with augmented reality (AR), is changing how we:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Capture and reuse corporate knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Train and support technical employees"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Scale expertise across sites, shifts and even countries"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Below I outline four trends that together explain why “faster, safer, smarter” is no longer a nice slogan, but the new baseline."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-1-technology-has-changed-how-we-communicate-and-solve-problems",children:["Trend 1: technology has changed how we communicate and solve problems",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-1-technology-has-changed-how-we-communicate-and-solve-problems",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Most work-related communication no longer runs via the local expert walking over to a machine."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Technicians, planners and engineers now use:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Email and messaging apps"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams/Zoom and remote support tools"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ticketing systems and digital service portals"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Diagnostics that used to be done by a local mechanic are now partly performed by factory analytics systems. The factory learns from usage data, decides when to trigger a recall, and pushes standardised fixes to dealers at scale."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In many companies, more communication with colleagues, suppliers and OEMs runs through digital channels than via face-to-face conversations or phone calls. For complex problems, several experts (often outside the company) need to be involved at the same time."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This has two important effects:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Knowledge scatters"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Expertise spreads over inboxes, chat histories, meeting recordings and external partners. The better you are at capturing and structuring that knowledge, the faster, smarter and safer you can work."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Speed becomes a differentiator"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","The company that can route a question to the right expert in minutes will beat the one that needs days of internal emails and coordination."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["To keep up, organisations need systems that not only connect people, but also ",n(t.strong,{children:"capture and structure what is being said"}),", so it can be reused at scale."]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-2-technology-has-changed-how-we-learn",children:["Trend 2: technology has changed how we learn",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-2-technology-has-changed-how-we-learn",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For decades, learning at work meant classroom training, binders and thick manuals. We learned by reading text."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"We now know that learning improves when multiple senses are involved: seeing, hearing, movement and touch. That helps explain the rise of online video as a preferred learning format."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["YouTube has quietly become one of the largest learning platforms in the world. In one survey, 71% of tech employees said they use YouTube as a learning resource, and more than half of B2B buyers use video, including YouTube, to research purchases before making a decision. :contentReference[oaicite:0]",index=0," Video is also one of the fastest-growing formats for internal training and knowledge sharing. :contentReference[oaicite:1]",index=1]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In other words: traditional manuals are being replaced by searchable, visual, on-demand instructions."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This again has two effects:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Technology enables faster learning"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","People are used to instant access to knowledge. They expect short, visual, contextual explanations instead of long documents. Training that uses more senses helps them learn faster and retain more."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Training becomes more individual"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Employees expect to access exactly the instruction they need, the moment they need it, on the device they have in their hand."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These shifts fit modern learning behaviour, but they introduce a new risk: if you do not structure your own company knowledge, your people will fall back on “random internet advice”. That is a problem for quality, safety and compliance."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-3-technology-adoption-is-accelerating",children:["Trend 3: technology adoption is accelerating",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-3-technology-adoption-is-accelerating",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A third trend is the speed at which new technology spreads."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Historically, it took decades for technologies like the telephone, electricity or television to reach tens of millions of users. Today, this happens in months, sometimes weeks."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["ChatGPT is a clear example. It is estimated to have reached around 100 million users within about two months of launch, making it one of the fastest-growing consumer applications in history. :contentReference[oaicite:2]",index=2]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Why do new tools spread so quickly?"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Digital infrastructure (devices, networks, cloud) is already in place"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"People are used to learning new apps and interfaces"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Business models are designed for rapid global scaling"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Network effects reward early adopters"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For companies, this creates a new operational question:"}),"
",r(t.blockquote,{children:["
",n(t.p,{children:"Are we able to adopt new technology fast enough to keep our competitive position?"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If your organisation needs years to standardise a new way of working, while competitors roll out AI- or AR-based training and procedures in months, you risk falling behind on productivity, safety and quality."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-4-a-new-labour-market-reality",children:["Trend 4: a new labour market reality",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-4-a-new-labour-market-reality",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The workforce itself is changing."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Many experienced technicians and operators are retiring, taking decades of tacit knowledge with them. At the same time, manufacturers and technical sectors across Europe report persistent difficulties in finding qualified staff, especially for technical and engineering roles. :contentReference[oaicite:3]",index=3]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Younger generations entering the labour market bring different expectations:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"They value flexibility, learning opportunities and work-life balance"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"They are more willing to change jobs if they feel unsupported or stuck"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"They are comfortable learning from video and interactive content, and expect modern digital tools"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Demand for skilled technicians is growing (more automation, more regulation, energy transition), while supply is constrained and more mobile than before."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The result:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Tenure in technical roles decreases"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vacancies stay open longer"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Corporate knowledge leaks away as people move on"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"“Hiring more people” or “organising more classroom training” is not enough anymore."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-faster-safer-smarter-is-the-new-baseline",children:["Why faster, safer, smarter is the new baseline",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-faster-safer-smarter-is-the-new-baseline",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If we combine these trends, a clear picture emerges:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Work is more complex and regulated"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Technology cycles are shorter"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Fewer experienced people stay long enough to pass on their knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Learning is just-in-time, mobile and video-first"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In this context, competitive advantage will belong to companies that:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Capture knowledge systematically"})," instead of letting it live in people’s heads, inboxes and chat histories"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Deliver knowledge in context"}),", at the moment of need, in a format that fits the task"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use technology to make average employees perform like experts"})," on complex work"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"That is what “faster, safer, smarter” means in practice:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Faster"}),": employees find and apply the right knowledge immediately"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Safer"}),": instructions are standardised, up-to-date and auditable"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Smarter"}),": the system learns from every task, error and improvement"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-organisations-embrace-ar-and-ai-to-get-there",children:["Why organisations embrace AR and AI to get there",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-organisations-embrace-ar-and-ai-to-get-there",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"All four trends point in the same direction:"}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["We need better ways to ",n(t.strong,{children:"capture, structure and deliver corporate knowledge"})," if we want people to work faster, safer and smarter."]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["This is where the combination of ",n(t.strong,{children:"AI and augmented reality"})," becomes relevant."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"We already see organisations using AR and AI together to:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Turn expert know-how into structured procedures"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Guide people through complex tasks in the real environment"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Support technicians remotely, without flying experts around"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Measure training speed, quality and error patterns across sites"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Adopting new technology has created competitive advantage for decades. Today, adopting AI-driven SOPs and AR-based guidance is simply the next step in that same story."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"turning-new-technology-into-standard-work",children:["Turning new technology into standard work",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#turning-new-technology-into-standard-work",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The key question is not “Should we use AI and AR?” but:"}),"
",r(t.blockquote,{children:["
",n(t.p,{children:"Are we able to turn new technology into standard work, at scale?"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Practically, that means building a repeatable loop:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use AI to draft SOPs and training flows"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Start from existing manuals, videos or expert interviews. Let AI propose the first version of a work instruction or training path."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use AR to guide people through tasks in the field"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Instead of only sending a video or PDF, overlay clear, step-by-step instructions in the real environment. This makes execution more intuitive and reduces interpretation errors."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use analytics to refine and standardise"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Measure how long steps take, where people get stuck, which errors occur and which variants are used. Update the instructions based on real-world usage."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Measure learning speed and performance"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Track how quickly employees reach competence and where additional support is needed. Use these insights to improve both training and process design."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Companies that build this “adaptation muscle” can roll out new processes in months instead of years, and capture more value from AI, automation and new equipment."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"reducing-pressure-on-scarce-experts",children:["Reducing pressure on scarce experts",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#reducing-pressure-on-scarce-experts",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["The shortage of senior experts will not disappear. But we can ",n(t.strong,{children:"change how we use their time"}),"."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI and AR can help by:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Handling routine guidance so experts can focus on truly complex cases"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Allowing mid-level technicians, supported by AR instructions, to safely execute tasks that previously required a specialist"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Embedding remote expert support into AR, so you can “borrow” expertise across sites instead of staffing every location with every skill set"}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["In other words: ",n(t.strong,{children:"AI and AR do not replace experts, they amplify them"}),"."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"You move from “we depend on John who knows this machine” to “we depend on a living knowledge system that John helped create”."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"building-company-knowledge-on-a-global-scale",children:["Building company knowledge on a global scale",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#building-company-knowledge-on-a-global-scale",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Once procedures are captured in a structured digital format, they become:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Searchable"}),": people can find the right step or variant instantly"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Translatable"}),": instructions can be reused across languages and regions"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Measurable"}),": you can see who used which procedure, when, and with what result"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reusable"}),": the same knowledge can support plants, service teams and partners"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For global organisations, this is crucial. You can roll out the same standard to multiple sites, adapt for local regulations, and still compare performance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The knowledge of your best expert becomes available in all languages, 24/7, instead of being tied to one person in one location."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"how-ai-improves-learning-speed-and-reduces-errors",children:["How AI improves learning speed and reduces errors",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-improves-learning-speed-and-reduces-errors",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI capabilities that are already practical today include:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Suggesting the next best instruction step based on similar jobs and histories"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Translating SOPs into other languages"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Turning raw expert video into structured work instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Flagging where errors occur most often, so you can redesign the process or add extra checks"}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Combined with AR, this means a new technician can ",n(t.strong,{children:"learn while doing"}),", guided step by step in the real environment, instead of spending days in a classroom and then trying to remember the manual."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The impact is tangible:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Faster onboarding"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Better retention of knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Fewer mistakes in the field"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Which is exactly where “faster, safer, smarter” becomes visible in day-to-day work."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"what-competitive-advantage-looks-like-in-practice",children:["What competitive advantage looks like in practice",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-competitive-advantage-looks-like-in-practice",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Organisations that get this right typically see advantages in five areas:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Productivity"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","More work done with the same or fewer people, because less time is wasted searching for information or waiting for an expert."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Quality and safety"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Standardised digital instructions reduce variation, error rates and incidents, and make audits more straightforward."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Scalability"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","New lines, plants or services can be launched without needing a full team of senior experts at each location. Knowledge scales faster than headcount."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Talent attraction and retention"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Younger employees prefer employers who offer modern tools and clear learning paths. A strong digital knowledge environment is a real asset in the labour market."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Resilience"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","When key people retire or leave, their knowledge is not lost. It lives in your system and can be improved by the next generation."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"where-actarion-fits-in",children:["Where ActARion fits in",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#where-actarion-fits-in",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"At ActARion, we see these trends every day in manufacturing, logistics and energy."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Together with our partner DeepSight, we help organisations:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Capture expert knowledge once and reuse it across sites"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Turn that knowledge into AI-supported SOPs and AR instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Support technicians in the field with guided workflows and remote experts"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Measure how training and execution actually perform in practice"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Not every company is ready to redesign all their processes at once. Often, the best next step is simple:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Pick one high-impact use case"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Capture the current best way of working"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Turn it into an AR-guided, AI-supported instruction"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Measure the effect on speed, safety and errors"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"From there, you can decide how fast you want to scale."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If you recognise the trends described in this article and want to explore what “faster, safer, smarter” could look like in your own operations, a short discovery workshop or proof of concept is usually the most concrete way to start."})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:r}=e.components||{};return r?n(r,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

title: AR SOPs: The Next Frontier in Manufacturing Excellence
description: Discover how Augmented Reality is revolutionizing Standard Operating Procedures, making them more accessible, safer, and more efficient than ever before.

image.alt: AR SOPs: The Next Frontier in Manufacturing Excellence

author: ActARion Team
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",em:"em",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[n(t.p,{children:"In today's rapidly evolving manufacturing landscape, the traditional approach to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) is being transformed by Augmented Reality technology. At ActARion, we're at the forefront of this revolution, helping companies bridge the gap between procedure and performance."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"the-challenge-with-traditional-sops",children:["The Challenge with Traditional SOPs",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-challenge-with-traditional-sops",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditional SOPs often exist as static documents—PDFs, printed manuals, or digital files that workers must reference during their tasks. This approach has several limitations:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Context switching"}),": Workers must look away from their work to read instructions"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Cognitive load"}),": Processing text while performing complex tasks"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Update delays"}),": Manual updates and distribution of new procedures"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Language barriers"}),": Difficulty in supporting multilingual workforces"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Safety risks"}),": Hands-free operation becomes challenging"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-ar-transforms-sops",children:["How AR Transforms SOPs",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-transforms-sops",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented Reality addresses these challenges by overlaying digital information directly onto the real world, creating an intuitive and interactive experience."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"1-visual-guidance",children:["1. ",n(t.strong,{children:"Visual Guidance"}),n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#1-visual-guidance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR displays step-by-step instructions as visual overlays, showing exactly where to place components, which tools to use, and what to check. This eliminates the need for workers to interpret text-based instructions."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"2-hands-free-operation",children:["2. ",n(t.strong,{children:"Hands-Free Operation"}),n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-hands-free-operation",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"With AR glasses or tablets, workers can access SOPs without using their hands, maintaining safety and efficiency in critical operations."}),"

title: Event recap: The Future of Work with AI and Augmented Reality
description: On 14 November, ActARion hosted an event about smarter, safer and faster work with AI and Augmented Reality. This is what we learned.

author: ActARion Team

",i(t.h2,{id:"why-we-organised-this-event",children:["Why we organised this event",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-we-organised-this-event",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(t.li,{children:"With checks and confirmations embedded in the workflow"}),"
"]}),"

",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:["The combination of ",n(t.strong,{children:"AI + AR"})," feels practical and close to today’s reality"]}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"The use cases made it easier to see where to start in their own organisation"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Safety, quality and training teams see a shared interest in one central platform for work instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Many participants are looking for a phased approach: start small, measure impact, then expand"}),"
"]}),"
